2793.description:
College adventure with killers on campus. There is quicksand early in the game...to avoid the quicksand just follow the included walkthrough.....don't change from kimono to ultimate frisbee chearleader uniform, exit dormitory and the re-enter dorm. Doing so, will cause player to be caught in quicksand upon 2nd time leaving dorm!
Player must attend swim class, study group, computer science club meeting and Halloween Dance to win, while avoiding hidden women killers and other hazards....

Credits

2792.name: Missionary_Position_v.4_J_Bangkok
2792.description:
Guys...here is the link https://file.io/cltOD4elesHR
Business management simulator. Struggling charter airline with a tour business in Tokyo and Akita facing bankruptcy. The player must overcome all obstacles to win...
Kazumi-san, the main character, was a hero pilot in JDF until he was dismissed so he started an airline. At first the venture was profitable but then a competitor lost a bird and 200 passengers in a fiery B757 crash. Adding to pressure, high oil prices.
Kazumi-san must fly and transport arms and mercs, fighter jets, from Tokyo to Paris, La France and then all over Afrique to help his client rescue three lutheran missionaries from St Jehoshaphat Cathedral in Paris. Facing death and cruel
[…]
enemies, Kazumi always is mindful of his kitten and meets loads of mates along the way.
Very difficult game, advanced players only. Some Japanese, kanji, French and German required. Was a GameStop Japan Top Ten game in Sep 2023. This is an english translation from Bangkok. Free game.

Credits

2790.name: In Dip
2790.description:
You're a university student who, as often happens, has to go study at
the university library. Unfortunately, this time something will get in
your way...

Credits

2789.name: Skrex Banmarist and the Kasalowan Conspiracy
2789.description:
Skrex Banmarist - bounty hunter extraordinaire - is faced with a perilous new mission: travel to the prison planet Lorcral and capture the mysterious Queen Locust!
PLAY through a stunningly crafted world of complex character and deep intrigue!
DELVE into the perils of the planet Lorcral!
UNCOVER the mysteries of the Kasalowan Caves, and the planet's true past!
VISIT beautiful Kasalowa Star City!
PREVENT the Queen Locust's plans of conquest and eradication!
SKREX BANMARIST AND THE KASALOWAN CONSPIRACY
is a brand new sci fi comedy Point-and-Click Adventure Game made in Adventure Game Studio by Emma Gundersen. Play it today!

Credits

2788.name: Abducted Intelligence
2788.description:
An unknown entity has taken Cornbankle... But why?
Can he escape their gelatinous and horrifying grasp?
Made for the 2024 $108 Adventure Game Challenge with the theme:
The Dunning-Kruger Effect.
The protagonist must be the smartest person in the game, but everyone
including themselves believes they are the dumbest person.
.. Also made for MAGS September 2024, with the theme ALIENS!
- a gruesome techno-organic nightmare in 8 colours!
- puzzles!
- inventory objects!
- monsters?
- original soundtrack!

Credits

2787.name: Melon Head
2787.description:
I present you Melon Head; a fantastical adventure in a delirious imaginary world!
Story:
In the hedonistic capital of His Majesty's Realm a faceless king commissions a local sculptor, Melon Head, our protagonist whose head is shaped like a melon, to craft an extension to His royal staff.
An extraordinary vision reveals an object of rare composition: A Crystal Iris Distillate. Pursuing the parts needed to craft the object essential in fulfilling the royal request, Melon Head precipitates to a strange adventure across His Majesty's Realm. He must use cunning, questionable morals and sharpness of intellect to succeed in his task and, ultimately, to choose between allegiance to his perceived benefactor and the rising fo
[…]
rces of dissidence seeking to overthrow the balance of power.
Features:
-Strange characters of undefined species.
-Puzzles to intrigue the mind (item puzzles, dialog trees and other stuff).
-A built in hint system if you get stuck.-Exploration of different areas of His Majesty's Realm.
-Three endings depending on choices.
-Colorful and highly saturated pixel art on a 16-color palette (an original art style using the EGA palette).
-Psychedelic visions.
-An out there jazzy original soundtrack.
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING:
This game contains flashing lights that may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.
Player discretion is advised.

Credits

2786.name: Falco - Lighting strike in town festival
2786.description:
Falco is a popular police commissioner of the homicides department who works in the capital city of a certain old country.
After 20 years spent investigating murders, he chose to take a long break to return home, a small hill town in the north of the country where people loves drinking.
He just set foot in town when the mayor promptly
contacted him to ask him for a favour, knowing his affection for drinks and parties, and gave him the task to free up the town party that is supposed to go on all night long.
Indeed, a lot of noisy drunkards gather there for town festivals to have party until late in the night, and no police officer was able to stop them, especially during the festival of Baucco.
Falco is
[…]
happy to accomplish the task as to join the old men to drink with them, but the meeting with an old acquaintance of school times will make the story more interesting.

Credits

2815.name: The Phantom Fellows
2815.description:
The Phantom Fellows is about two best friends who start a paranormal investigation business together, since one of them is already dead.
[spoiler]it\'s a point & click adventure game.[/spoiler]

Credits

2785.name: Gurk in Trouble - A Yip Quest Story
2785.description:
Dive into the cartoon adventure of Gurk, the bumbling kobold who's the personal house servant and eternal laughingstock of the selfish and narcissistic wizard Banannan. As Banannan plots world domination, he sends the hapless Gurk on a task to collect three ingredients to fulfill his evil plan.

Credits

2783.name: Foodie Frenzy ( A1-A2)
2783.description:
Foodie Frenzy is a language learning game, geared at beginners who want to learn Romanian. It has almost 700 voices lines of unique sentences and subtitles in english.
There game  comprises of levels which are sentence generators (you use a word or symbol in your inventory to click on animations on the screen to generate a sentence about it).Other levels are more dialogue driven while others are minigames in their own right.
The game is about setting the table, buying food, making a list of ingredients, staring into the fridge to remember what you need to buy and finally cooking it.
You can download the game here
https://mew-mew16.itch.io/foodie-frenzy-romanian-a1

Credits

2781.name: Hydra's Head 3
2781.description:
Hydra's Head 3 is the latest instalment in this point and click adventure game.It's a fantasy game which can be downloaded for Windows .Rated: 12 and upDisclaimer: It has some moderate foul language.No nudity, no violence (just implied)Credits: music is based on songs composed by Dimitrie CantemirThe polished version will have voice actors.

Credits

2780.name: Simon the Sorcerer 1 Demo Text Adventure
2780.description:
This is the original demo version of "Simon the Sorcerer 1", converted into a text adventure, based on my Text Adventure (Zork-style) template.
I wanted to test the logic of my template and looked for a short game to reproduce in it. Since I grew on Simon the Sorcerer and very familiar with its puzzles, I decided to take it as a reference and I'm very pleased with the result.
To give this text adventure more color, I decided to actually make the characters quotes in color, just like in the graphical game, which makes a huge difference compared to a traditional text adventure gameplay. There's also the original demo music in the background and an option to Save and Restore the game.
Changelog
[…]
:
=======
Version 1.0.0.1
Released: 31st July 2024
- Fixed mixed feedback when looking on inventory items.
- Added a new scenario when providing the correct password when entering the mine before actually discovering it.
Version 1.0.0.0
Released: 2nd September 2024
- Initial release.

Credits

2778.name: Zalgo Hotstar in The Trailer
2778.description:
Zalgo Hotstar is a paranormal detective for hire, and an eldritch being, who just happen to have an easy but annoying job of freeing a ghost by finding it's anchor.A one week-one room project.

Credits

2777.name: Stop
2777.description:
************
Stop
************
This isn't really a game.  It's a chance to relax.
There are no puzzles or controls to worry about.  You can click through my words or just take your hand off the mouse.
I'm inviting you to hang out on the mountaintop as long as you want.  Breathe for a bit.  Think about nothing.
************
A ten minute relaxation session, made by HyperAnimated in Adventure Game Studio.  Sound on recommended.

Credits

2775.name: Sarimento on Hyperborean Island
2775.description:
A game I made for, and about, Sarimento (a friend on Gaia Online).
Sarimento crashlands on the wintry Hyperboreon Island, and underneath the peaceful exterior, people are in fear.  Help Sarimento restore people's faith in their fellow man, and deal with those who are causing trouble to them.
This game uses a verb coin.  Left click on certain targets will bring up the verb coin, or if there's an item in use, will interact with the item.  Right click will bring up the inventory or, if the cursor is currently an item, will revert it back to the regular cursor.  Click on the computer button on the upper right of the screen to bring up the system menu to change the volume or game speed; save, load, etc.
[…]
/>
Full screen mode is recommended.

Credits

2774.name: Brownie's Adventure 2
2774.description:
A continuation of the exploits of Brownie. After a reasonable court outcome (on trial for crimes against the state from the first game) Brownie is on his way to magic school! What could go wrong? All the things. That's what.

Credits

2773.name: Hoopoe's Inferno
2773.description:
You play a Hoopoe (a bird), far from its home but thrust into
adventure when a fire breaks out in the forest.
Meet many animals, collect numerous food items, find hidden items... and.. possibly... save the day!
With a unique single-item inventory box, and 'drop-able' inventory items!
Made for MAGS July 2024 with the theme "Nature."

Credits

2772.name: Becalmed
2772.description:
A sailing ship is becalmed hundreds of miles from shore.
As a new and inexperienced captain, how will you encourage the wind to blow and save your crew?
A short point-and-click adventure game created in one month for MAGS July 2024 - Nature.

Credits

2771.name: Dobutsu no Costco
2771.description:
In a Costco where all the employees are various animals, one funny monkey just wants to slack off and eat a banana. As the player, it’s your duty to help this monkey on their noble quest to not do their job. You’ll have to face down The Boss, a workplace romantic drama, and more than a few puzzles along the way.

Credits

2770.name: Teeth of Glass
2770.description:
It begins with one cut.
You play as Doctor Joshua Hagstrom, as he finds himself trapped in an
otherworldly fever dream. Just who is the mysterious patient? How can
Dr Hagstrom escape? And will he live to see his family again?
Teeth of Glass is a short point & click horror fever dream, with two different endings.

Credits

2769.name: Echoes in the Static
2769.description:
A short horror , point n' click that takes you to a spooky old house in the countryside where things get a bit weird. Solve puzzles, dig up secrets, and try to outsmart the mysterious thing that's got you stuck there before it's too late!

Credits

2768.name: Carnival of Shadows
2768.description:
A group of four unlikely companions arrives at an abandoned amusement park, drawn by the promise of a unique experience. They quickly discover that thA group of four unlikely companions arrives at an abandoned amusement park, drawn by the promise of a unique experience. They quickly discover that the park is haunted by the restless spirits of those who perished in a tragic accident. To escape, they must solve puzzles, confront supernatural threats, and uncover the park's dark history.e park is haunted by the restless spirits of those who perished in a tragic accident. To escape, they must solve puzzles, confront supernatural threats, and uncover the park's dark history.

Credits

2767.name: The Zoo
2767.description:
You are Samual Conrad, currently a resident of the Twilight Zone. You've been given a chance to escape. Can you do it?

Credits

2766.name: Hydra's Head 2
2766.description:
Hydra's Head 2 is the next installment of the series.In this episode Iancu arrives in Klint, where he meets a cast of new characters.Help him carry out his missions inside the town.
It's mostly done, but if you guys encounter bugs please let me know! I'll be working on improving it during the next week.
Warnings: Some cursing but overall SFW. Appropriate for 12 and up.Game play time: About 20 minutesGenre: Adventure, Fantasy, Story-based Point and click

Credits

2765.name: The Stew of Las Moras
2765.description:
There's trouble brewing at the oldest stew in the world, and it is up to you to help Moby figure out how to fix it all!

Credits

2763.name: Day of the Hamster
2763.description:
Lucas is just about ready to embark on an epic adventure with his friends. Unfortunately fate has other plans. Trusty sidekick Cryo the Hamster is being attacked by a murderous cat. Due to a terrible mishap, Lucas is locked in the basement before he can react.
Help Lucas find a way to solve the many issues and finally exit the vault in Day of the Hamster.
Classic pixel art graphics and real Roland MT-32 music recordings are used to lend an authentic retro vibe to the game.

Credits

2760.name: Hydra's Head Episode 1
2760.description:
Iancu is a boy who lost his mother to an angry mob, led by Zolef. Now Iancu has to find what remains of his family in another city. He has five days to get there on time.While fleeing through the forest, he crosses paths with two shady assassins. How will he find his way now?
Play on website link in browser or download for windows

Credits

2758.name: JaKo Quest
2758.description:
The game is situated in a small town close to a medieval castle and it is surrounded by far-reaching woods and high mountains. The hero is Roger, who used to visit his grandparents in the village. He has inherited grandparent's house, but he wasn't interested in it during university studies. Roger has come back into the small town (after a first job experience) to try to figure out what to do with his life.
[spoiler]Roger has funded clues to a forgotten mystery, in his house. By following the clues, he is going to find a discovery, which is important for the whole small town. Also, one tourist is going to visit the small town and his story is going to be revealed in this game.[/spoiler]

Credits

2757.name: In Our Midst
2757.description:
In Our Midst
is a short point'n'click adventure game paying homage to the popular game Among Us. You play an alien being that has infiltrated a space ship, disguising itself as one of the crew members. You now have to eliminate the remaining crew so that you can seize control of the ship.
The game was originally intended for the September 2022 MAGS competition theme "Sometimes Evil Wins", but wasn't finished in time. It was resumed and finally released for the April 2024 MAGS competition "Finish Your MAGS Game" which it went on to win.
Version 1.0 is now available which fixes a few bugs and adds in a little more polish that was left out of the MAGS version due to lack of time. The original MAGS (0.9) versi
[…]
on can still be downloaded from the first link if you are interested.
Comments and ratings are appreciated!

Credits

2756.name: Day of the Sandwich
2756.description:
It's a pleasant night. Delphine is fast asleep resting for tomorrows adventures. Her dreams are filled with a glorious bacon sandwich. Delphine, not one to ignore portents and omens is determined to recreate that bacon sandwich before leaving on her adventures.
Help Delphine find a way to solve the many issues and finally make the ultimate bacon sandwich in
Day of the Sandwich
.
Classic pixel art graphics and real Roland MT-32 music recordings are used to lend an authentic retro vibe to the game.
Inspired by the likes of Day of the Tentacle, this game was made in a short 2 week project to learn AGS. It's a short adventure that will last 10-20 minutes or so.
[…]
>

Credits

2755.name: Steeplejack
2755.description:
Fred and Albert are steeplejacks trying to demolish a chimney. Does everthing go to plan?
No. No it doesn't.
A traditional point and click adventure game made by GOC Games in one month for MAGS April 2024.

Credits

2753.name: The Last Bus
2753.description:
The last bus was scheduled to depart 20 minutes ago.
It did not.
Play it online: https://richardpires.itch.io/the-last-bus

Credits

2752.name: The Play of Life
2752.description:
Play as David who wakes up from the dead. Discover the reason behind your return.

Credits

2751.name: Horror, Naturally
2751.description:
In a desperate need to connect to nature, unbeknownst to the awaiting danger...
Game prepared for MAGS, July 2023

Credits

2750.name: Splendor Solis (demo)
2750.description:
Poland after a nuclear catastrophe. You will play as three characters (only one in demo version), inhabitants of the Guild. The Guild, ruled by the Governor is falling apart. The Governor is sick and he brings his people down with him. This is not the only problem, as foreigners inflirtate and watch the Guild. You will need to uncover the secrets of the falling ruler as Raula, his woman. You will need to defend your people as Damian, Hyena, a scavenger, and last but not least you will need to battle cowardice and uncover the secret plans of the foreigners as Jacob, a Rat.
Entry for: MAGS February “Make a Demo”

Credits

2749.name: Sesari
2749.description:
BENEATH THE SAND, SESARI AWAKENS...
At a gas station in the middle of the desert, two women suddenly and completely lose their memory. It gets worse (and weirder) from there.
This is part 1 of Sesari. Sesari is a haunted science-fiction adventure game, to be released one death at a time, forever.

Credits

2748.name: Brownie's Adventure
2748.description:
A fantasy point and click adventure in traditional 1990s style. Dark
humour, player choices that have impact on your outcome and hours of
daft shenanigans.

Credits

2747.name: ANOPHTOS
2747.description:
"I haven't slept at night for months now.
Every time I dream I come back to this place.
I don't want to go back there anymore.
Every night I lie awake, trying to process
something I can't fathom the depths of.
A bottomless emptiness. A black hole.
It's morning again. Someone just left.
The house is quiet. My eyes are so heavy.
I can't go back there. I'm not going back.
Please take this away from me.
I'm
█
█
█
█
█
█
█
done with it. I need to move on.
I need to sleep. I'm so tired."
[…]
m>
ANOPHTOS
is a short point and click horror game.
There are 2 slightly different endings.
PDF booklet included.

Credits

2746.name: Beyond Dream and Time
2746.description:
We are in Dream Cat City, a place beyond dreams and time.
An old book from the field of dream studies is in a terrible state: tattered pages, faded letters - not even the title of the book can be reconstructed. Librarian Mia-Pergamenta is forced to take action.
So she travels to the constellation of the cat's head to confront the Dream Cats' council of elders with this problem. Because as soon as a work of dream lore is lost forever, that ancient feline civilization threatens to collapse. But perhaps helpful clues can be found and a replacement copy can be placed in its paws?
In this little but unusual adventure, Mia meets numerous cats who help her in her search and gains insights into the party scene
[…]
of Dream Cat City, among other things.

Credits

2745.name: The Green & Red
2745.description:
Explore the forest, identifying  plants and overcoming obstacles as you discover your ancient heritage!
Are you alone?
What treasure and mysteries could you discover!?

Credits

2744.name: Breakfast Requiem
2744.description:
On the far edges of the universe, a temple has gone silent. Having
failed to make their normal reports, and unresponsive to all attempts to communicate, Acolyte Cornbankle has been dispatched to investigate.
What strange dangers lurk beneath the temple?
Can Cornbankle unravel the mystery, escape with his life, sanity... and enjoy a choice selection of syrups?

Credits

2743.name: Pod Dwellers
2743.description:
A game I made for MAGS March 2024. Escape the doomed Starship Voidlight before it is split asunder by a giant asteroid. Then try to survive, and perhaps escape from, the hardships and dangers of an uncharted alien world.

Credits

2742.name: De-ARRGH!dre & Shaquisha: Get milk.
2742.description:
Hey there! Have you ever wanted to play a game from me! probally! so uh its a point and click adventure. You can you that little rolling thing in the middle of the mouse to cycle through interactions and left click to use the interaction. This game is about two cavemen siblings who need to invent something... so they invented MILK! It's a very short game so don't have a heart-attack. ok? good.

Credits

2741.name: Flow Problem
2741.description:
Flow Problem
is a simple but challenging retro puzzle game where you have to try and guide as much water as possible down to the bottom of the screen. Hindering you are obstacles such as rocks, fire rocks and blocks of ice, which each affect the water in different ways, You also have the effects of sand to deal with.

Credits

2740.name: Romanian Beginner
2740.description:
Your name is Chris Spade and you inherited your grandparents' apartment. You decide to try your fortune by moving back to Romania and your goal is to relearn the language.It's an exploration game, where sentences are heard by clicking on various objects.
The speech is all in Romanian, but you do get English translation next to the phrases in Romanian.
It's not a complex game and there are no puzzles.
Enjoy!

Credits

2739.name: My Siblings, The Stones
2739.description:
In
My Siblings, the Stones
, a dropout mage
finds herself stranded in an unfamiliar village, and must help the
locals solve a thorny problem in order to find her way home. Explore a
history-infused settlement, discover unexpected clues, and learn who can
help you as you navigate a damaged land. And maybe, with persistence,
begin to learn magic.
Playtime
: 30-45 minutes

Credits

2738.name: Brian Eggs Is Lost In The Woods
2738.description:
The first stand-alone adventure game by my acquaintance, and self-proclaimed 'video game auteur', Brian Eggs. He says it's based on a true story, but then he says a lot of things.
Brian asked me to upload this game for him. He let me fix a few game-breaking bugs, but unfortunately he wouldn't listen to any of my suggestions about the rest of it because it would, and I quote, "ruin my artistic vision".
You have been warned.
Winner of the February 2024 MAGS competition "Into the Woods" by noblonski.

Credits

2813.name: Use It All (Or Forget Your Ball)
2813.description:
Once upon a time, there lived a young princess, pure at heart. One day,
she went into the forest and alas, her precious golden ball, the
treasure of her kingdom, was seized by a monstrous amphibian that dwells
inside an ancient well!
You are the princess. You're a bit too lippy
for your job's standards, but as long as your prince charming (who is
yet to show up) can't hear you, all is good. You can pretend. It's even
less about the stupid ball now, because things got personal. You need to
go and show the frog who's the boss around these woods.

Credits

2737.name: The Last One
2737.description:
Awake in a pixelated room, surrounded by the distinct abundance of the same four shades of green. It harks back nostalgically to those '90s games.
Is this just another cliché where everything turns out to be a dream? Or is there something more behind the mysterious creatures seemingly lurking in the forest?
Don't give up even when all seems lost. Restarting the game might be the key to saving more than one lost soul.
The Last One is a brief and simple adventure paying homage to the classic GameBoy aesthetic.

Credits

2735.name: GHOSTLAND
2735.description:
ENGLISH
Point & click adventure game
in
the style of Lucasfilms, with a
tipical
menu of verbs.
The
full version is available free.
Hesai is a young teenager like any other, except for the fact that she is a ghost. Because she has lost part of her memory, she will need to explore her surroundings in search of answers. How did she get there? What happened in the last days of her life? Where are all her loved ones? She will meet old mates and new friends who will help her understand the events that led to her current situation.
**********************************************
ES
[…]
PAÑOL
:
Aventura gráfica tipo
“
Point & click“ al estilo de lucasfilms, con
su
típico
menú de verbos.
Está disponible la
versión completa de manera libre y gratuita.
Hesai es una joven adolescente como cualquier otra, excepto
por el hecho de ser un fantasma. Debido a que ha perdido parte de su memoria, necesitará explorar su entorno en busca de respuestas.¿Cómo llegó hasta allí?¿Qué ocurrió en sus últimos días de vida? ¿Dónde están todos sus seres queridos? Se encontrará con viejos conocidos y nuevos amigos que le ayudarán a comprender los hechos que le llevaron a su situación actual.

Credits

2818.name: The Adventures of The Black Hawk
2818.description:
France, Spring 1789.
Social tension rises while nobility, in their convenient and
accommodated position, enslaves the common people with their taxes. Meanwhile,
Jean Pierre de Saint-Cove, a noble aristocrat, secretly hides behind his mask
to fight injustice and inequality, and to give back to the people what they
rightfully deserve.
Use your full cleverness to solve the different situations
along the way until you fulfill your purpose. Both your sword and eloquence
will be your most trusted allies, without forgetting the help of your loyal
friend Mathieu and beautiful Violette Hulot, who will get you out of trouble
more than once and witho
[…]
ut whom you would never be able to top this adventure.
Confront aristocracy and the Deputy Chief of police, Baron
LeComeau, to overthrow the Old Regime by finding out about the best hidden
secrets of nobility, and using them to your advantage.
Persist in your eagerness to achieve your goal! Be brave,
smart and hilariously crazy to achieve victory!

Credits

2733.name: A doll in a dream
2733.description:
You take on the role of a doll, summoned into the nightmare of a young child in order to dispel the shadow threatening to overtake her mind.
This game was made for MAGS January 2024.
MAGS January “Trippy” (OPEN) (adventuregamestudio.co.uk)

Credits

2732.name: The Legend of Skye
2732.description:
We will step into the shoes of a young druid who will be called upon by her tribe to undertake an important mission. After some events in her village, she will have to leave behind the safety of the forest and venture into a world full of dangers. The fate of the grove will be in her hands.

Credits

2731.name: 2080 Wall City Lockdown
2731.description:
The story is set in a not so distant future. The main characters is a young man striving to survive in a Mega City in the middle of civil unrest. Not too original settings, but unfortunately, that could be the truth for millions of people as conflicts escalate and climate deteriorates.
The game is an original story created by using many free assets.
Read the readme.txt file in th game's folder to read the notes on the development of the game.

Credits

2730.name: Apfelmännchen
2730.description:
Did you drink from your Klein bottle again? How else did you end up as Apfelmännchen* in a world full of mathematical references? But now that you are here, you can just as well take over the world.
Made for MAGS January 2024, theme "Trippy"
*) literally "little apple man", a German name for the Mandelbrot set

Credits

2729.name: Dead Phones (Final Version)
2729.description:
You're meeting your girlfriend later and she asked you to bring her headphones. No problem. Right?
Now, where are they???
Use the tracking app on your phone and retrieve those headphones.
Can you find all 5 possible ways to finish this game?
This is the highly polished version of the MAGS December 2023 Winner

Credits

2728.name: Prison Escape
2728.description:
It's a single room puzzle game in the style on monkey island. It's crude and stupid and I hope you like it.

Credits

2727.name: 44 The Jail
2727.description:
Five people wake up in a prison for unknown reasons. In there they have to make a choice: Reveal their deepest secret or pay the highest price taking the truth with them.
You are in the shoes of
Elias Di Lorenzo
in this point & click mystery adventure, set in Argentina in the 2010 decade. Meet the other prisoners and escape from the prison.

Credits

2726.name: Melon Head Demo
2726.description:
Melon Head
is a quirky and surreal point and click adventure game set in a fantastical imaginary world. You will step into the shoes (though he's barefooted) of Melon Head who is an artisan in the feudally governed Cyan City.
Story
:
In the hedonistic capital of His Majesty's Realm a faceless king commissions a local sculptor, Melon Head, our protagonist whose head is shaped like a melon, to craft an extension to His royal staff.
An extraordinary vision reveals an object of rare composition: A Crystal Iris Distillate. Pursuing the parts needed to craft the object essential in fulfilling the royal request, Melon Head precipitates to a strange adventure across His Majesty's Realm. He
[…]
must use cunning, questionable morals and sharpness of intellect to succeed in his task and, ultimately, to choose between his allegiance to his perceived benefactor and the rising forces of dissidence seeking to overthrow the balance of power.
PHOTOSENSITIVITY WARNING:
This game contains flashing lights that may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.
Player discretion is advised.

Credits

2725.name: Bob's Quest
2725.description:
The game was made as part of a AGS 3.6.0 tutorial series.
Help Bob find his car keys so he can go on a vacation.
(I could not add the screens. You can check the Youtube link for more info)
Gameplay Video (Spoiler !):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DjUtbt-zOoM
More information about the tutorials you can find here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SpxMdWTaW2s&list=PLdlsMVDmowzSkFXAwnV_dOXjrSqYsjU15
Enjoy.

Credits

2724.name: Corpo Connections
2724.description:
Can you make the connection and make it out of your new job alive?
Good career opportunities comes from good connections! Start your new job- and find out what it is at the same time!
Link field reports to anomaly photos, pass the security check and make it out alive. 2 unique endings: good ending/bad ending.

Credits

2723.name: Stair Quest Winter 2023
2723.description:
The inevitable march of Wintrification has come to Stair Quest!
This holiday variant of Stair Quest was a surprise release at the end of 2023.

Credits

2722.name: Midnight Madness at Moon Forest
2722.description:
Embark on a thrilling adventure with Tom and his loyal companion, Cook, as they find themselves marooned in the mysterious Moon Forest following a car crash. In their quest for assistance, they stumble upon a group of campers grappling with their own problems. Together, Tom, Cook, and the campers unite to navigate the forest and unravel the dark secrets that lie hidden within. Join the journey and see if you can make it back alive...

Credits

2721.name: Dead Phones [MAGS December 23 Edition]
2721.description:
You're meeting your Girlfriend later and she wants you to bring her headphones.
No problem, right?
Right?
Where are those headphones??

Credits

2720.name: Tony's Spaghetti
2720.description:
In this game you are a cop going undercover as a restaurant chef in order to plant a bugging device on some mafia guys. Made for the itch.io $107 Adventure Game Challenge

Credits

2719.name: Murder Cases(Demo)
2719.description:
You find yourself locked in your own home, in the middle of a crime scene, and without your recent memories. In this horror scenario, you will find a stranger wandering the house and making your escape unlikely. Solve all the puzzles, find out what happened, and recover your missing memories.

Credits

2718.name: Stormwater (Early Access)
2718.description:
Welcome to Stormwater, now in Early Access.
Now in exile, the only work left for Prussy the Sailor is at a parish in the haunted countryside of a foreign land. With his old friend Priest Grail, together they must guide the spirit of their town and lift the many curses that plague the continent- or else fall, packed down into dark earth.
Stormwater Fuses the genres of Classic Shooting Games with Point and Click Adventure.
- Develop relationships with the strangers of the continent, as you strive to fulfill your duty for the church, guarding the spiritual welfare of the town of Perinthia.
- Investigate dark curses that range from spirits haunting forgotten homes, to the crue
[…]
l possessions of entire towns, and even the ineffable horrors buried deep beneath the earth.
- Slay hordes of darkness. Whatever comes their way, Priest Grail and Prussy the Sailor are always ready to shoot,  kick, burn, slice,  and rip to pieces their enemies. Curses or otherwise.
There is also a free demo for this game available, which features several hours of content.

Credits

2716.name: Hey Der Undy 2
2716.description:
A game about a man trying to give his friends presents.
How hard can that be?

Credits

2713.name: Worlds Literally Collide
2713.description:
A short game made for MAGS November 2023!
You are a planet who found his own little patch of space and just wants some PEACE and QUIET!
Unfortunately, loud and annoying jerks are invading your quadrant. Find them and get rid of them any way you can.
Content Warning: Some light comedic swearing, comedic violence, and suggestive sexual dialogue between astral bodies.
Note: There is no sound or music because you can't hear those things in space, guy. You can't. Planets can. It makes sense. (Also I ran out of time.)
Controls:
- Right click to change cursors.
- Left click to fly/look/interact/talk or COLLIDE! (And space is vast. Click WASD's to start movin
[…]
g, click again to stop.)
- (Collide looks like two tiny planets smashing together.)
- Right click or ESC to skip cutscenes.
- TAB for Inventory, F5 to save, F7 to load, F9 to restart, CTRL + Q to quit.
Enjoy!

Credits

2711.name: America 2000
2711.description:
In the year 2000 the American way of life is a reality: flying cars,
robots, computers, jobs whose days only last two hours in which you have
to press some buttons. Happiness is the priority. How is this utopia
possible?

Credits

2710.name: Vizita
2710.description:
The story is about a man visiting an old friend who has a misbehaving child.
The action is set in the late 1800s.
It's mostly story based so there won't be any puzzles just simple interactions with various objects.
The game will be very short: a 7-8 minute runtime.

Credits

2709.name: Magret and Facedebouc
2709.description:
Inspector Magret,
a fine, refined duck who has been put on the back burner, will have to take over a criminal investigation, accompanied by a new partner imposed by his Police Captain, who is his opposite:
FaceDeBouc
, a shameless, temperamental goat!
The two of them will have to get to know each other and, above all, work together to investigate and solve the mystery of the crime of Mr Couane, a shopkeeper's pig cut up and turned into sausage in his coffee shop.

Credits

2708.name: METRO CITY: Night Shift
2708.description:
A short Sci-Fi Adventure game with puzzles and minigames. Discover Metro City and it's people, and a story about a message and an uncertain future.

Credits

2705.name: The Weird Thing Under The Bed
2705.description:
A game I made for a MAG contest following the philosophy of the late Slasher where every bit of created content would just be in the game no matter what. No turning back. That's how he made so many games and always released them on time.
CONTENT WARNING: [spoiler]Suicide and Domestic Violence themes[/spoiler]

Credits

2704.name: Iskra igra
2704.description:
ISKRA IGRA This is a game with few instructions. It's a small open-world game where
you can skate around and find adventure. There are also 10 arcade mini-games
made just for fun.
It's my first game, so please leave some suggestions. ?
Controls:
Movement: WASD, Middle mouse button
Interact: Left Mouse Button
Inventory: Tab/ESC
Mini-Game Guide:
Different game modes have distinct controls,
and some may require multiple players. To play a mini-game, click on an arcade
game machine. The tutorial button beneath the machine will guide you through
the controls

Credits

2703.name: Pirate Theme Park - A Short Adventure
2703.description:
An adventure game comedy... a boy wanders through a pirate theme park, under a mysterious spell. Help him break the spell and escape the theme park!

Credits

2702.name: Super Author Simulator 2023
2702.description:
Can you survive the glamorous (or grammar-ous) life of a professional author? Navigate the pitfalls and horrors of writing with randomly-combined sentences, dangerous power-ups, discouraging criticism, and sheer endurance. Being an author is not fun! But maybe, just maybe... you can do it.

Credits

2701.name: Painted Hills
2701.description:
A simple Point & Click adventure game that takes place in a small town in northern Canada.

Credits

2700.name: Lost & Found
2700.description:
Run the lost & found service of a big town in the absence of your boss.
Made for the Monthly Adventure Game Studio competition of September 2023 on the theme: 'No talking, please' (most of the art was drawn before though).

Credits

2699.name: Night Hag Syndrome
2699.description:
Summary
A first-person occult horror point-and-click adventure. The player is trapped in the twisted nightmare of the Hag. To escape, one must play through the Hag's ritual to ascend.
Approximate play-time
10 min
Resolution
320x180
Content Warning
Blood and Gore

Credits

2697.name: Yip Quest
2697.description:
Play Raga, Ram and Kog, three kobolds who wants to steal the treasures from the castle, but have to find a way to fool the guard in order to get entrance to the treasury.
This was a game made for the 2 weeks $107 Adventure Challenge.

Credits

2696.name: The Books of Knowledge
2696.description:
The Books of Knowledge is a short game made in two weeks for the $107 Adventure Game Challenge. You are an alien sent to earth to obtain knowledge about the planet. Aided by your budget AI (Karl) you set out on your task.
Assets used
Art:
Limezu (Modern and Exterior Art Packs)
https://limezu.itch.io/

Freesound - "Woods ambience in Missouri, some birds singing and soft breeze." by felix.blume
[…]
>

2694.name: D-List Diva
2694.description:
Until recently, Davina Diamondes was a superstar. But ever since her ‘controversy’, the venues have been getting smaller, the crowds thinner, and the budget tighter. She’s lost her entourage, and the record label has assigned you, a booze-swilling, animal-hating misanthrope named Bill, to be her new tour manager.
In this free comedy point-and-click adventure – created in two weeks for the $107 Adventure Game Challenge – help Bill gather everything he needs to meet the fallen celebrity’s watered-down rider demands, while failing to mask his contempt for everyone he meets along the way.

Credits

2693.name: Why the Wrong Face?
2693.description:
A game jam entry in which you must wear a disguise in order to do a heist.  But is there more to the story?

Credits

2690.name: Outlaw's Gold
2690.description:
This is a very, VERY short game where my biggest aim was to create something with a completely different visual style from my other games.

Credits

2689.name: Chaluul's Curse (Remake)
2689.description:
Howard Carter, archaeologist and hobby detective, is asked for help by his friend and museum director Dr. Horatio Neuenblad. It's about the secret of an ancient Knight Templar sword, which is said to have a fatal curse on it. It's up to Howard Carter to try and solve the mystery of the cursed Templar sword.
For mirror downloads visit https://brocantygames.itch.io/chaluuls-curse-remake

Credits

2687.name: The long August longing
2687.description:
After a little century, our hero wakes up and hopes to see her friends soon. But first she needs to send the invitation out and make sure her servant has the castle tip top.
Very short game created for MAGS August 2023 with the theme "Distance/Separation".
Game res.: 1024x640 (16:10)
AGS version: 3.5.1.10

Credits

2686.name: The Distant Door
2686.description:
This project that was made for the August 2023 AGS MAGS competition. This month's theme is distance. You are a night shift worker who has just moved into a new apartment building. While getting ready for work, you hear your neighbor having a terrible coughing fit.
Assets used:
Duat Font One | Pixel Art 8 Bits Font | Free by LeonMSaia (itch.io)

v" by WavJunction.com

2685.name: Tunnel Vision
2685.description:
Trapped on a sabotaged train speeding toward a tunnel with a bomb, an heiress struggles to stop the train in time. Save the passengers and escape the train car before it's too late! A first-person game with nostalgic  low-res CGA 4-color graphics.

Credits

2684.name: Hey Der, Undy!
2684.description:
A point and click adventure about a man just trying to get to table tennis.
A game based on the decadent play-world in which streamer xxxindyxxx dwells.
This is a Monkey Island-style game in which Undy is just trying to get to table tennis. There is definitely nothing else going on. At all.
Definitely.
n.b. There are two versions available.
V1.3 has no voicing, but has more textured graphics, a better user interface and a "jokeatron".
V1.2 has the old AI voicing and older, simpler graphics.

Credits

2683.name: Tales From A Forgotten Tavern (MAGS)
2683.description:
Dark Ages of EverCraft
was the most popular MMORPG of its day. But that day was more than twenty years ago. It has long been eclipsed by other, newer, more popular games. Now the once teeming masses of its online population of players has dwindled down to almost nothing. No NPC in the game has seen a true "newbie" for years uncounted. But this evening, on the last remaining server still providing access to the old game, a level one character has stumbled out of the Newbie Garden, battered and exhausted, seeking a place to rest in a forgotten tavern on an untraveled road.
What awaits her inside? Download and find out!
Made for MAGS, July 2023. Theme: "Last One."

Credits

2682.name: Going Home
2682.description:
"Going Home" is a very short point-and-click adventure game, with full speech acting and a funny plot:
You're Roger. When the game starts you find yourself in an unknown place, somewhere in the universe. But, you're not alone - there's someone else there with you! Will you dare and check who that is and find a way to get back home? Or maybe this is not even about you!
I made this game during learning my way in the AGS engine. The idea was to re-create the Sierra-style AGS template from a complete scratch, to learn bit-by-bit how it is made, and then to take it from there and make an actual mini game that includes full speech acting and a funny plot. I hope you'll like it the same as I had making it. :)
Many t
[…]
hanks to the AGS community for their kindness helping me out with all my queries. This game wasn't possible without your assistance, and I look forward that it will be one of many from my future creations.
*The game has been also fully translated to Hebrew. To set it to Hebrew, run the winsetup.exe from the game folder. Then from under the "Gameplay settings -> Game language" set the option to Hebrew.

Credits

2678.name: The Errand
2678.description:
There's something you've been meaning to do. It's time to take a trip. A journey to remember... and to forget.

Credits

2677.name: The RoadTrip
2677.description:
On a back road, out of gas, and your phone is dead.Can you find a way to get moving again before it's too late?

Credits

2676.name: Mad Jack: Breakdown Shakedown
2676.description:
MAD JACK: BREAKDOWN SHAKEDOWN is an action comedy achievement-based puzzle game.
In
a post-apocalyptic free-for-all desert wasteland where everyone still
somehow has gasoline (a world not remotely like that of a beloved film
franchise) Mad Jack's muscle car breaks down. Using only items from a
junkyard, Jack must find a way to escape being stranded and continue his
thrilling, heartwarming journey to his destiny (presumably somewhere
else in the desert).

Credits

2673.name: The Sleeping Castle
2673.description:
The Sleeping Castle is a
point-and-click adventure based upon the Sleeping Beauty legend.  You
have to guide a bold Knight through the Thorny Maze surrounding The
Sleeping Castle, and find a way into the castle to rescue the
sleeping princess.  There are hazards to avoid and challenges to
overcome.
A User Guide with hints and solutions
can be downloaded from my website.

Credits

2671.name: Elevation
2671.description:
A short adventure survival game. Help a small robot
trapped in a space-elevator shaft find rescue.  All original art, fonts,
and music.
Built with Adventure Game Studio 3.5.1.
Playtime: 20-60 min.

Credits

2670.name: How to: Witchcraft Cuisine
2670.description:
Do you like cooking? Do you like witchcraft?
GREAT!
Then this is the game for you! Use your magical skills to prepare three wonderful meals for the witches' Sabbath, with the help of your magical sentient cook book!

Credits

2669.name: Broken Windows - Chapter 4
2669.description:
You are Jack Burton, an inexperienced police constable and now even more inexperienced fugitive.
Finding yourself on the run, only you and your motley set of associates can find the truth, prevent further murders and clear your names.
This is the final episode of a humorous four-part point and click adventure game inspired by the Police Quest series (albeit with no dead ends). You CAN die in this one though, so saving is advisable.
Broken Windows Chapter 1 was chosen as a Pick of the Month on the AGS website for March 2020 and nominated for Best Game and Best Puzzles at the 2020 AGS Awards.
Broken Windows Chapter 2 was nominated for Best Freeware Game in the 2020 AGS Awards.
Broken
[…]
Windows Chapter 3 was nominated for Best Freeware Game in the 2022 AGS Awards.
Hope you enjoy it and thank you for sticking with them!

Credits

2667.name: Sorrow of a Furry Father
2667.description:
A story of family love, reconciliation, and getting transformed into a fox.

Credits

2666.name: Captain Disaster and The Two Worlds of Riskara DEMO
2666.description:
A new Captain Disaster adventure; this time he is more of a hero than a disaster! ... Or is he? A point and click adventure game with cartoony graphics, epic storyline and more bad jokes than you can possibly imagine. Buy this game.
This demo contains the first part of the game sans voicing and achievements.

Credits

2665.name: Karelian bath steam house (Finnish)
2665.description:
Original game name in Finnish: "Karjalan Sauna". This short fun game is essentially a simulation of a northern steam room. Steaming in a bath is a classic culture of northern peoples such as Karelians, Finns, Laplanders. The point of the game is to score as many points as possible. Try not to lower the temperature in the bath below 50 degrees Celsius. Also, the player's health status ends due to high temperature and humidity. Drink cool bread kvass in order to support the player for as long as possible. For a certain number of points, another bottle of drink is added. Game in Finnish.

Credits

2664.name: Police Quest 4 SCI(ish) Demo
2664.description:
A playable demo of Police Quest 4: Open Season re-made in the style of PQ2. Made in one month for the February 2023 MAGS competition.
Someone's on a killing spree and it's up to you to solve a string of seemingly random murders. Some clues may lead you to the killer. Some lead down blind alleys. You must find the killer before he strikes again. Play it by the book and you might just stay alive. Make a mistake and you could be the next victim.

Credits

2663.name: Melrin: The Dragon Menace - 20 year anniversary remake
2663.description:
Melrin returns and in this adventure game, he is sent out to investigate a rumor that a dragon has returned after two centuries and is now pestering the countryside.When the game starts Melrin already has three different items in his inventory, his book of magic in which you can read how to create various spells, his cauldron in which you mix ingredients to make the spells, and a magic map on which a new location automatically appears as soon as you've heard of it and you can instantly then travel between different locations. You have to collect various items spread around the land and often combine different items to create new ones.

Credits

2661.name: Menial; a Utopian Bagel Simulator
2661.description:
Welcome to
Menial; the utopian bagel simulator.
I'd quickly
describe
Menial
as a restaurant simulator and a visual novel, with some light point 'n' click puzzling in a comic pixel art style very much inspired by the NES.
More broadly
Menial
is a game about making bagels and living in the City State of Ineria, a fully automated utopia. You step into the shoes of Maria, who's lifelong passion has been the (perhaps modest) art of making bagels. What does the following of your passion entail in a world of myriad possibilities? What pressures and attitudes must Maria endure from her surroundings? What is the utopian state of Ineria like and who lives there?
[…]
r />
In Menial you:
Make and serve your clients the best bagels using the Bagel Simulator, or just don't give them what they want; you don't have to worry about income, after all.
Learn about Ineria and it's citizens by discussing with your clients: get into arguments, help a man remember his fantastic travels, befriend a hiking botanist and her girlfriend.
Travel around the city to different bagel stands.
Help Maria start her day and open the bagel stand with some light puzzles.Gamble that hard earned cash or go shopping.
Read the news or take a nap and dream after a hard days work.
Have fun playing!

Credits

2660.name: Melrin:The Disciple Ordeal - 20 year anniversary remake
2660.description:
Melrin: The Disciple OrdealA downloadable gameDownload NowName your own priceMelrin: The disciple ordeal, 20 years anniversary remake.In this game, you play as Melrin a magician disciple. When the game starts Melrin finds himself in a strange place, he has no idea where he is or how he got there. In fact, he has totally lost his memory.After you've met the Guardian, you will be told that you have magically been transferred to this world to go through the test. A test to see if you are worthy of becoming a full-fledged magician. You need to find the four crystals of the elements and to do that you have to use all your magic skills, the problem is that you've lost your memory and, because of that, lost all your knowledge about the art of magi
[…]
c. Your magical power has been stored in some spheres that have been spread throughout the land. So you'll need to find them first. You must also find and talk to the Fairy of the Heart, she will guide you throw your adventure.

2658.name: The Devil's Teeth
2658.description:
The Devil's Teeth
As you enjoy a twilight pipe by the sea wall, you watch the surf break over the treacherous submerged rocks known as the Devil's Teeth.
You are looking forward to batoning-down the hatches and spending the evening beside your hearth with a warming tot of rum.
However, as a tea clipper hoves into view over the horizon, your evening is about to take a very different turn...
A traditional point and click adventure game made by GOC Games in one month for Adventure Games Studio MAGS January 2023.

Credits

2656.name: Grandad and The Quest for The Holey Vest
2656.description:
In this adventure game, Grandad, who is rather old, has a habit of placing things in strange places and then forget where he has put them. One morning he wakes up and discovers
that there is a bit of a nip in the air. He decides that he'll need to put on his string vest but he can't remember where it is. You have to help grandad find it.
Guide grandad around his house, gather items, talk to people, solve puzzles and unlock doors while also trying to avoid certain deadly situations...

Credits

2655.name: Santa Quest
2655.description:
Father Christmas arrives at the orphanage with a sack full of presents.
Unfortuntely, he's spilled sherry on the page of his list that tells him whose is whose!
He'll have to turn detective to save Christmas!
A short game made by GOC Games in 10 days for Adventure Games Studio MAGS December 2022.
Controls
Left click interact/lookLeft click skips a line of dialogue.Any key to skip cut-scenes.

Credits

2654.name: There's Something in the Pipes
2654.description:
You are the owner of a movie rental store. You have one hour until your shift. You need a shower. The shower is full of blood. Go figure.
A short (5~25 minute) character study initially created for MAGS November 2022. Light on the puzzles and on the spooks.

Credits

2652.name: Alien Prison Escape
2652.description:
Jason has found himself in prison and recognizes that prison life isn't cut out for him. Luckily, an alien crashes into his cell with an offer. Help the alien fix their spaceship and it'll help you escape.
Credits:
Most of the stuff: Bulbapuck
Music:Leaving home, Bass Walker, Spy glass: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Sound effects from Freesound.org, all under public domain

Credits

2650.name: Graceward - Complete Edition
2650.description:
On the run for her life, expelled from a dying city into haunted country, Renee has no choice but to befriend whomever she can- and kill everyone else. In Graceward, all things finish packed down in dark earth.
Fusing the styles of Classic Point and Click Adventure with Side-Scrolling Shooter- Graceward creates a fresh experience, steeped in old school design.
Featuring from the Shooter side of the family:
• Hand-designed levels with dozens of hidden secrets, calling-back to 90s FPS's.
• A heavy original score full of industrial sound, heavy metal, and haunting melodies.
• And several hundred gallons of enemy blood.
And from the Adventure Gam
[…]
e side:
• Form relationships and choose which companions will accompany you.
• Learn skills to solve familiar and unfamiliar puzzles and mysteries.
• And make tough decisions which will twist and turn the narrative.

Credits

2649.name: Grandma Badass
2649.description:
Grandma Badass
is a 2D cartoon adventure game.
This
point and click video game
puts you in the shoes of GrandMa, an old woman who is going to work to find her black cat Marius, who has disappeared and probably been kidnapped.

Credits

2648.name: SPHONX
2648.description:
Sphonx lets you discover scientifically advanced technology and antique
artifacts on an archaeological expedition in an ancient Egyptian
pyramid. You are Ignacio "Iggy" Dias, a young and interested
archaeologist in the near future. He helps Dr. Allan Nowicz, an
experienced scientist and archaeologist who was involved in the
development of some of the most advanced technological breakthroughs in
recent archaeology. He is leading the current research on the dig site
and he's also managing the bureaucratic side of the expedition in Egypt
today. Dr Nowicz is very proud to have a Death Erasing Multispectral
Ultrawave Mummified Material Igniter Ray Device with him on this site.
[…]
It's purpose is to revive even partially conserved cells in old, very
old and even ancient Egyptian tissue and give it back its previous human
form.
Of course, such advanced technology needs careful use and planned
application. So Dr Nowicz wants to wait for Dr Sebranovic to arrive, the
spiritual and logical father of the very advanced tissue reviving
device. Ignacio Dias, a studious but a bit clumsy apprentice working for
Dr Nowicz instead wants to finally see results and start the live study
of ancient life with support of the DEMUMMI-RAY rather yesterday than
waiting even longer.
Tension between the two clashing opinions
escalates and late at night Iggy sneaks into the excavation / laboratory
deep inside the darkest parts of the age-old pyramid only to get
involved in a centuries spanning adventure.

Credits

2647.name: Two little ghosts of that house: the missing toy
2647.description:
Help Mel the ghost to find Bianka's toy.
(12-11-2022) A new version is out

Credits

2646.name: Highland Spirit
2646.description:
Highland Spirit
Becky Speed is an aspiring novelist who is seeking to break her writer's block with a relaxing solo trip to the Scottish Highlands.
However, Becky is about to discover that in her idyllic cottage, she is not alone at all...
A traditional point and click adventure game made by GOC Games in one month for Adventure Games Studio MAGS November 2022.

Credits

2645.name: Azazel's Christmas Fable
2645.description:
A wacky 8-bit retro-style point and click Christmas adventure, reminiscent of '90s classics. Explore Santa's village as a devilish imp with a mischievous knack for getting into trouble. Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries while meeting some peculiar characters along the way.

Credits

2644.name: Autumn of Death: Black Friday II
2644.description:
The sequel to my point and click adventure game, Black Friday.It's been twenty years since the incident, but the killer scarecrow has finally come back. Will this brand new group of five teenagers be able to accomplish what their predecessors failed to do, and rid the world of this pumpkin-headed scarecrow once and for all, or will they end up barely surviving a traumatizing event that will haunt them for the rest of their lives?A homage to the slasher movies of the 80s in the form of a point and click adventure game, with some gameplay elements reminiscent of the Clock Tower series. With multiple endings, longer puzzles, and a deeper story, this is sure to please any fan of adventure games, horror, or slasher movies in general.

Credits

2642.name: Tres Acordes
2642.description:
Game based on the "Tres Acordes" series Youtube animation. This game is only spanish languaje.

Credits

2641.name: Signal & Echo: Iris is Missing (demo)
2641.description:
A point-and-click adventure with a unique text parser system, designed to enable real detective work.
Help Ollie, a fledgling reporter on his first day at the Signal & Echo newspaper, to solve the mystery behind schoolgirl Iris Wood's recent disappearance.
Created by a former journalist. About an hour of gameplay.

Credits

2640.name: Darkness and Denim (MAGS)
2640.description:
Canada. 1992.
A mythological monster has begun to terrorize the residents of an ancient forest. In desperation, they turn to a stranger for help. Can he defeat the monster? Will he find enough spare change to afford gas for his truck? Will he ever change his mullet for a more modern hairstyle? Download and find out!

Credits

2638.name: Menial; a Utopian Bagel Simulator (demo)
2638.description:
Welcome to
Menial; the utopian bagel simulator.
This isn't a traditional adventure game I should inform! :)
I'd quickly
describe
Menial
as a restaurant simulator and a visual novel, with some light point 'n' click puzzling in a comic pixel art style very much inspired by the NES.
More broadly
Menial
is a game about making bagels and living in the City State of Ineria, a fully automated utopia. You step into the shoes of Maria, who's lifelong passion has been the (perhaps modest) art of making bagels. What does the following of your passion entail in a world of myriad possibilities? What pressures and attitudes must Maria endure from her surro
[…]
undings? What is the utopian state of Ineria like and who lives there?
In Menial you:
Make and serve your clients the best bagels using the Bagel Simulator, or just don't give them what they want; you don't have to worry about income, after all.
Learn about Ineria and it's citizens by discussing with your clients: get into arguments, help a man remember his fantastic travels, befriend a hiking botanist and her girlfriend.
Travel around the city to different bagel stands.
Help Maria start her day and open the bagel stand with some light puzzles.Gamble that hard earned cash or go shopping.
Read the news or take a nap and dream after a hard days work.
Have fun playing!

Credits

2635.name: Unfair
2635.description:
You're a young lawyer, offered a last-minute murder case to defend you can't reject... or win...

Credits

2634.name: rock travis - camilla's case
2634.description:
My first game...1920x1080
3 endings
Rock Travis... Detective. Charged of the case of Camilla. A prostitute found dead in a back alley.
Who killed her?
Why?

Credits

2633.name: Siren
2633.description:
It's nighttime in the City of Angels. Two cops approach end of watch on a busy night shift. Then there's one last call...
A short point and click adventure game made by GOC Games in one month for Adventure Games Studio MAGS September 2022.

Credits

2632.name: The Stinker
2632.description:
The Stinker
4 Chapters of damage and chaos!
"It is said, that evil comes from within the heart of man himself."
"Albert Tinker is known in Sleepyville as 'The Stinker'. Townfolks played pranks on him and made his life a misery chanting 'Tinker Stinker! Tinker Stinker!"
"Now that Albert is very rich and is a key member of SWAMP he wants to extract revenge on all of Sleepyville."
Revenge can sometimes be sweet.....
Made for Sep MAG 2022...

Credits

2631.name: Where Did the Humans Go?
2631.description:
A pilot descends on a planet where something strange is going on.
When he arrives at a scientist's camp, there's no trace of humans. Only
robots are left and their behaviour is strange. Where did the humans go?
Made in
two weeks
for the
Adventure Game Challenge
.

Credits

2436.name: Space Quest: A Son of Xenon - Full Version (2022)
2436.description:
Remember the star generator from Sierra’s “Space Quest I”?
In this vintage stylish prequel (look and feel of Space Quest III), naive engineer not-yet-janitor Roger Wilco learns why the sun of Xenon had to die in the first place.
Download this free full length classic adventure game (80 pictures) and travel to strange new planets, puzzle your way through parallel worlds, and discover new species from across the galaxy, all of whom want to kill you. And they WILL kill you!
Think you’ve already played this game back in 2020? You have NOT! That was just a draft of the first act to see if people from Terra III were looking for another Roger Wilco adventure. Turns out they were.
[…]
>

Credits

2629.name: The Potion Master (MAGS version)
2629.description:
Markus, the young apprentice of a local potion master, has barely started his apprenticeship when trouble began - his master, Zabella, was found lifeless (but not quite dead) on the floor of her own underground lab. The local doctor can only do so much, leaving it up to Markus to investigate his master's mysterious collapse and -hopefully- find a way to cure her.
Made in three weeks for the MAGS competition: Healing. Boldly untested. Save often!

Credits

2628.name: Scram School 3 Challenge 17: "Petezah Time III: Petezah in Space"
2628.description:
You are Moldy Orange Popsicle, a lame wimpy nerd and father to a little pile of mold. You just want to chill on a Friday like any other slowly rotting popsicle, but Scram, the host of Scram School, wants a pizza. So you all get in the egg ship and fly all the way to the Dumbino's space rock to pick the pizza. But oh no, they're all out of ingredients and you have to collect them yourself!
Will you be able to get all of the pizza ingredients and get Scram her pizza? What is your son working on? What is Shield of Yore's taste in music? AND WILL CHIHIRO EVER GET HIS CHEESEBURGER SUPREME TACO PIZZA?
Find out the answers to all these questions in this puzzle-packed challenge entry of Scram School!
--
[…]
-
Resolution: 1280 x 720
If you aren't in the Scram School camp discord server or don't know what an object show is, you're not gonna be aware to tons of lore and in-jokes, sorry.
Also I'm aware it's gonna look and have a couple bugs for a couple reasons. This is the first real game I've made with AGS in 5 years. Plus, I had to make the game on a deadline (before Friday morning) and to make it workable in about three-ish days.
Regardless, please enjoy!

Credits

2627.name: State of Mind
2627.description:
Barry has the sick man blues and has lost his mojo.....He is very depressed and has not gone out, eaten or slept properly for weeks.... Can his friends help him raise his vibrations and get a better state of mind? A journey into healing....
Left Click Interact / Right Click Look at.....
Made for Aug MAG 2022.....

Credits

2626.name: Cutman
2626.description:
"Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the mouth." - Mike Tyson
The Champ is facing his toughest fight yet and you, as his trusted cutman, must patch him back together between rounds. Get it right and glory shall be yours. Get it wrong and he'll be flat on the canvas...and you'll be looking for a new job.
A short game made in two weeks for Adventure Games Studio MAGS August 2022.

Credits

2625.name: GIGANT
2625.description:
The story takes place in Seoul, South Korea.
After losing his job, Da-Hoon finds a part-time occupation that pays suspiciously well.
His employer requires body parts from the giant human-eating creature known as Gigant.
Da-Hoon accepts the dangerous offer, putting his life on the line.
But will he be able to survive the wrath of the Gigant?

Credits

2624.name: Masquerade at the Con
2624.description:
Guess who the mystery persons are, then do some "roleplaying" and defeat the villains!

Credits

2621.name: Challenge of the Tentacle
2621.description:
Challenge of the Tentacle is a free point and click escape room adventure fangame inspired by Maniac Mansion, Day of the Tentacle and Maniac Mansion Mania.
On a beautiful morning with chirping birds and sunshine, it seems a new beautiful day begins for the whole world. But no one knows that a catastrophe could happen that day. An evil, tyrannical, purple tentacle wants to take over the world. On this seemingly wonderful morning, our well-known protagonist, Bernard, renowned physicist and chemist, wakes up muddled. He still doesn't know that on this day he has to prove that he is a genius and has not, like so many others, studied in vain. But he's starting to remember the Purple Tentacle's visit and their argume
[…]
nt about world domination, which ended with a cup of tea, his heavy, drooping eyelids and Purple Tentacle's malicious grin.
He is locked in his bedroom with many puzzles provided by Purple Tentacle to challenge and prevent him.
Help Bernard to solve these challenging puzzles, because with each solved puzzle he gets a little closer to the key that opens the door and thus also to the means created in his laboratory with which he can save the world from conquest. Solve logical, amusing and motivating puzzles that challenge not only Bernard, but YOU as well.
Features
-Inspired by Maniac Mansion, Day of the Tentacle and Maniac Mansion Mania.
-Humorous game that combines point and click adventures with escape room tasks.
-With many allusions to all adventures by LucasArts.
-Various types of puzzles, from classic inventory usage to brain teasers.
-You will find out the result of your performance at the end of the game: very good, good, satisfactory or bad.
-And the best at the end: it costs nothing! It helps curb inflation!

Credits

2620.name: Flash McCoy
2620.description:
Flash McCoy, World War 1 flying ace once soared above the battlefields of France, downing multiple enemies before breakfast.
Now, down on his luck, he delivers the mail in the middle of nowhere and all he downs before breakfast are double whiskies.
However, Flash's quiet existence is about to be turned upside down when a routine delivery turns out to be anything but.
A traditional point-and-click adventure game made by GOC Games for MAGS June 2022.

Credits

2618.name: Machines Have Lucid Dreams
2618.description:
A metaphysical game about finding meaning through 10 objects
Story
Upon arriving in the dream-state of the machines, you're given a strange task to retrieve 10 miscellaneous objects - only to discover from a cast of curious inhabitants that certain combinations unlock secrets hidden in their memories.
The machines have endured a great calamity in this place they call home. While some remained steadfast and persevered, many who once thrived now struggle to remember their
purpose. Others are presumed lost.
Description
Master our unique stacking mechanic to find the missing machines.
Stack, combine, and arrange the found objects int
[…]
o a myriad of combinations to rediscover the history of this world and help those old souls find release at last.
Features
- 10 objects to find
- 120+ object combinations to discover
- 8 talking machines, fully scripted to respond to these combinations, resulting in thousands of lines of possible dialogue
- A supporting cast of colourful machine-like friends
- Consequences for your actions
- Feature-length story (2+ hours of gameplay)
Development
We are a two-person team working in central London. Machines Have Lucid Dreams is our first game, which we started in March 2020.  After 2 years of development it is finally ready for consumption.
MHLD is about finding meaning in the small things... And the abundant options that can exist with only a handful of miscellaneous objects.
We hope you enjoy what was an unexpectedly long, protracted and personal journey for us in the development of this strange world which, starting from humble beginnings, grew and grew the more we added to it...

Credits

2616.name: The Museum
2616.description:
As a security guard, the night shift at the museum is usually quiet. Not tonight.
The Magna Carta has been stolen by an interdimensional master thief and only you can get it back.
Embark upon a chase through the palaces, battlefields and castles of Britain as you solve royal riddles in pursuit of your quarry.
A spiritual successor to Unlicensed to Kill, The Museum was created in 1 month for AGS MAGS May 2022.

Credits

2615.name: Another Museum
2615.description:
A little first person point n' click adventure made for
MAGS May 2022 "Museums".
A Monstuano suddenly comes to the Non-Living Entities Redirection Office. And that means... troubles. The eternal intern of the office will try to get some specific items to complete the ritual that will lead the Monstuano to his respective paradise.
What does all this have to do with a museum?
Well, where can you get a Roman
Patera
, an Inca
Quero
and a Chinese
Ding
?

Credits

2614.name: Outbreak: The warehouse
2614.description:
Based on the first "Resident Evil3" stage. A horde of zombies has chased you into a warehouse. Find your way through the place and escape the city.

Credits

2613.name: Gongbot
2613.description:
Gongbot is an educational game, for Greek children aged 6-12. I developed it in association with a team of educators, hoping that it will prove to be a fun learning experience and that it will allow me to teach children what an adventure game is. Featuring an original story that draws children's attention, elegant colorful graphics, puzzles that will put their minds to test and a large sum of questions from their school's curriculum, the game helps the children learn while they're too busy having fun to realize it.
The story begins on a distant planet, where two alien scientists are summoned to a council of wise beings. We learn that they consider their homeland to be too boring and barren, and they wish to begin a search for a
[…]
colorful planet. The two scientists, the heroes of our story, will lead this expedition aided by an all-purpose robot called Gongbot. Unfortunately for them, their spaceship malfunctions right before they crash-land on Earth, and their robot is shattered to pieces.
Gongbot plays like a classic 3rd person point & click adventure game. You walk around the area, click on hotspots to get a description, interact with your environment and pick up any object you can. You can switch between the male and female character at any point, at the press of a button. The game features professional voice acting recorded at a studio, as well as musical scores specifically hand picked to match the theme and appeal to children of that age.

Credits

2612.name: Rock 'n' Roll Will Never Die!
2612.description:
Hair metal's not dead, it just smells funny! Get your denim vest, bandana and makeup, and dive into a point-and-click adventure as a middle-aged teddy bear planning a comeback with his old glam metal band – in a world where glam metal has been dead and buried for decades.

Credits

2611.name: Superego, Chapter 1+2
2611.description:
A game about making games and the existential crisis that comes with it, an essay about the limits of the genre, a rare and personal jewel i've been working on for more than five years.These chapters are part of a greater story that will be unfolding on the following months with more chapters, but they are already games on their own, with hours of gameplay and a self-contained plot.
You can play it on Mac and other platforms using SCUMMVM.

Credits

2609.name: Unlicensed to Kill
2609.description:
As a famous secret agent you must follow a trail of clues around the globe to foil Blofeld's scheme to destroy a famous world city. But which one? Only you can find out.
Made in 1 week for MAGS April 2022.

Credits

2608.name: Clotilde Soffritti in: Never Double Park your Spaceship
2608.description:
After being stuck on an asteroid with a decrepit, gabby hermit for a week, Clotilde has had enough!
She must find a way to call for help and hitch-hike a ride out of there!
Will she manage to escape the asteroid?! Only one way to find out! Or maybe two.

Credits

2607.name: Beat the Buzzer
2607.description:
A tape trader acquires a copy of an unaired quiz show episode. Is it just her imagination, or is it changing with each rewatch...?
A pseudo-trivia game created in seven days for the Dread XP Found Footage jam.

Credits

2606.name: Maniac Metalhead Mania II -The Heavy Metal Rescue Mission-
2606.description:
It's Friday somewhere in Northern Germany.
Normally there was nothing special about this Friday,
the Commander of the Metal-Kompanie 666 was about to go back to his cozy bed when his beloved brother called him on his mobile phone.
Full of panic and fear, he tells that he was kidnapped by the "Cheap Pop Music Mafia" and urgently needs our help.
Will we be able to free our brother from the clutches of the Cheap Pop Music Mafia?
Is this game even dumber than its bad predecessor, Maniac Metalhead Mania?
Find out and play
Maniac Metalhead Mania II -The Heavy Metal Rescue Mission-
the free adventure game of
the Metal-Kompanie 666!
[…]
vetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12.48px; background-color: rgb(231, 234, 239);">
The following great features await you:

Credits

2605.name: Perfect Tides
2605.description:
Perfect Tides is a point and click adventure game about the agony and anticipation of being a teen. Set in the year 2000, you play as Mara, an internet-obsessed young writer who lives on a so-called island paradise. Following 4 seasons of the year, you experience through Mara the beauty and silence of the island, the turmoil of family life and mainland public school, and an ever-evolving quest for love, friendship and experience.

Credits

2604.name: Saturday Night is the Loneliest Night of the Week
2604.description:
A quick little adventure game created for the February MAGS game jam.  You wash up on some faraway beach.  Did you party too hard or did you just listen to the wrong Woody Herman cassette tape?  Find out in this light-hearted romp and you may find yourself embroiled in a real adventure!

Credits

2603.name: Huggles Goes On A Trip!
2603.description:
An Easter themed Point & Click adventure
Huggles and his mum are rabbits that are living peacefully in a bunny meadow. But when they try to sell their eggs this year, they run into a snag. Huggles needs to rise above himself to save the day…
* Break a strange lock!
* Outwit a strict guard!
* Help Huggles help his mum to get their eggs sold!

Credits

2602.name: Castle Dornstein - DEMO
2602.description:
A gothic mystery adventure game, Castle Dornstein follows Hemlock, a young scholar hired to translate a mysterious medieval book. When the book goes missing, everyone becomes a suspect and Hemlock must explore a castle where secrets hide in the shadows and a dark history waits to be discovered.

Credits

2601.name: Aida's Bizarre Halloween
2601.description:
A stand-alone follow up to the adventure classic Aida's Strange Christmas!
Story:
Aida is trying to live a normal life after her past adventure in Santaland. But that grows harder as something new draws her away from her home, this time to a land of pumpkins and dark candy.
About:
Most of this game was made about 10 years ago as a gift to my then girlfriend (now wife), but it just ended up collecting dust in a virtual drawer. I recently found the semi-completed project and decided to make a finished version.
I always felt it deserved to be released.
Key points:
- Weird characters to meet.
- Classic point-an
[…]
d-click gameplay.
- A bit of gore.
- Find the spirit of Halloween!

Credits

2600.name: Batman: Prep Time
2600.description:
Alfred, you need to advice Batman about how to spend his prep time.

Credits

2599.name: Getting the Picture
2599.description:
Short quiz game made for MAGS January (although it didn't make the deadline). Includes the usual gags and silliness.

Credits

2598.name: Personal Rocket
2598.description:
An adventure game about paranoia and loneliness, the evils of capitalism and too much web surfing, the material world and the occult universe, with some humor sprinkled throughout. Your typical postmodern blues.
Available on Steam and Itch.io.

Credits

2597.name: Sopor Eterno (Eternal Torpor)
2597.description:
This short game it's about a person who wakes up in the middle of the night, trapped inside the duality between being awake and dreaming (sleep paralysis). They are visited by two entities that are willing to help them get out, one way or another.
This mini point and click game was made in the context of the Global Game Jam 2022 in just one week. The theme was:
Duality
(The game default language is Spanish, to set English language you must click on "winsetup" and select "English" in Game Language section)

Credits

2596.name: Little Leonardo
2596.description:
Its a really boring afternoon. You are a young boy with an enthusiasm for art and looking for a new project. What could be more worthwhile than emulating one of the greatest masters of all time?
This is a little game that was made for MAGS January 2022. It contains almost no speech, making it a good game to play with kids too.
For anybody stuck, I have posted a walkthrough:
