Fortunately, Fred's uncle Edenezer is that rich he wouldn't mind lending them the money. Or isn't it?
- 3 playable characters with individual abilities
- a huge and completely new location
- countless references to Maniac Mansion, other episodes, other games, movies, series, music and much more.

Credits

2433.name: Detective Boiled-Hard Mini Case
2433.description:
A short, one room, free download.

Credits

2432.name: Space Cat vs Virus
2432.description:
A Space Cat flew to Earth to save it from being infected by a dangerous virus. The cat has a magic weapon that shoots with a water antiseptic. It is necessary to destroy 99 viruses. Spare cartridges and first aid kits appear from time to time. Humanity hopes for salvation. Let's win!

Credits

2431.name: Suli Fallen Harmony
2431.description:
Welcome on Harmony !
Here, on this island, birds and humans live together in peace. It’s on the fishermen’s village that our hero, Suli, lives happily. As the elder’s assistant, the young bird works in the temple. One stormy night, he discovers a dark prophecy that will change his life forever.
You incarnate Suli. It is your job to help him discover the island, interact with colorful characters, explore various places, solve many puzzles and bring back peace on Harmony !
What to expect :
A classical point and click game playable mainly with your mouse.An original 2D game with soft colors and hand painted backgrounds.
Supported languages : French and English
A map to help you fas
[…]
t travel around the island.
Some cutscenes with voice over.
A story with many twists.
20 trophies to unlock along the game.
Funny dialogs and endearing characters.
A cute and mischievous hero to incarnate.
Some mini games.
Some easter eggs for P&C games fans.

Credits

2430.name: Neos Aires 2070: Sunday Comes First
2430.description:
A comedy filled cyberpunk detective adventure, heavily inspired by Snatcher and Metal Gear

Credits

2429.name: Skyfall
2429.description:
Made for MAG April 2020
Yazz Aldrin is a NASA astronaut and has volunteered for a two week mission to the moon, a few months after his wife walked out on him, to collect moon samples.
Estranged from his wife he drifts alone in the dark, lonely voids of space.
He never stops thinking about his wife and how she walked out on him.
What were her reasons? He asks himself time and time again: Why?
200,000 kms into his moon mission and his rocket begins to fail. First the thrusters, then the main power, then the rocket's AI computer'SAL' and now it's getting worse because he has lost all contact with earth!
Unless he can repair the rocket he will loop endlessly in space like a spiral in a ci
[…]
rcle... forever! His Jet pack is running low on power.
Can Yazz make it to the moon and collect the moon samples he has been instructed to get?
Uses my new Sierra Style Template. Left Click Interact, Right Click Examine........

Credits

2427.name: Nous, les Mortifer
2427.description:
!!! THIS GAME IS
NOT
RELATED IN ANY WAY WITH ELECTRONIC ARTS !!!
This is a free game using "The Sims 4" as graphic base for fun and entertainment only.
************************************************
FRENCH ONLY - uniquement en français.
Adventure game made with "The Sims 4", in the universe of "Katura". Play as three vampire children in their quest to save the life of their father who has been poisoned by a witch !
Jeu d’aventure en Point & Click, créé avec Adventure Game Studio. Graphismes créés avec
Les Sims 4
.
Basé sur l’univers des Chroniques de Katura.
Les événements se déroulent peu de temps avant ceu
[…]
x racontés dans la BD « La Légende d’Eikos ».
Contrôlez  les trois enfants Mortifer, jeunes vampires aussi délurés qu’assoiffés  de sang, qui doivent trouver un remède pour sauver leur père victime  d’un maléfice ! Explorez la ville et la campagne environnante, demandez  de l’aide à vos amis vampires et loups-garous, et faites payer la vile sorcière pour son crime !
Instructions et solution jointes dans le fichier ZIP.

Credits

2425.name: Detective Boiled-Hard - Case File: Death of the Space Dino Hunter!
2425.description:
Play as Detective Boiled-Hard to get the truth and solve the case in this short point and click adventure game!
- Dialogue Focused
- Ask stupid questions
- Flirt with, or insult people
- Irritate people with several inventory items such as a decapitated hand!
- Crude humour and pop culture references
- Fully Voiced by one guy
- Yeah, even the woman

Credits

2424.name: Dangerous Derek's Livestream
2424.description:
Winner of MAGS March 2020
Dangerous Derek hosts the most outrageous livestream on the internet, and today he's been given an extra-spectacular task to complete! Will Derek be successful, and more importantly, how many viewers will he have when he attempts the stunt?

Credits

2423.name: The Mind [MAGS March 2020]
2423.description:
Based on the card game by the same name.
https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/244992/mind
You and your dog Elska must play for your freedom!

Credits

2421.name: Whack-A-Soul
2421.description:
Welcome to Whack-A-Soul, a comedy carnival-style game made for MAGS March 2020, Death Defying theme!  Save souls from Death by whacking them with your Hammer of Reincarnation!
04/28/23: Broken download link updated!

Credits

2420.name: Good God!
2420.description:
Story:
If there is one thing Zosia really hates about her younger brother, Bartek, it would be the fact that he always copies everything she does. Every time she picks up a new hobby, you can be sure that a couple of days later her brother will do the same. Can you imagine how frustrating it must be? A couple of days ago, Zosia’s grandfather sparked her interest in Slavic Mythology which she absolutely fell in love with.
Although Bartek doesn’t know anything about Slavic Mythology, it’s just a matter of time when he comes to Zosia claiming to be an expert on the subject. When that happens, Zosia might need your help...
About:
Good God! is a short adventure game developed in AGS. It offers
[…]
up to an hour long gameplay and features a Game Boy-inspired artstyle, although the mechanics and controls are of a point'n'click game.
Note:
the game uses Slavic paganism as one of its main themes but it's not meant to be treated seriously or as a reliable source of information.
Note 2:
the game originally was supposed to be submitted in the October 2019 MAGS, but we simply ran out of time : )

Credits

2419.name: Play Xylophone
2419.description:
Mini-game for children. We learn music on a xylophone and enjoy a singing cat.

Credits

2417.name: The Office (not that one)
2417.description:
Your Mission?
The same as every other office worker.
Go home early.
Featuring a secret room, secret music, secret endings, hell, a secret intro. So many secrets. So much content you will never ever find.
Look, push and bother
everything
.
Special feature: The main menu features a pleasant honking sound! Just click "Not that one".
Also features a tutorial for those that work in offices that have never played a computer game before. You guys should probably steer clear!
Background information.
This whole thing started as a mini project to build my first ever adventure game room. Exciting. I was talking
[…]
about it with my boss at work and asked him if he wanted to be in that room and a game popped out of it by mistake. Play-tested by the people within the game a lighthearted tongue in cheek adventure game popped out of this silly idea.
Please enjoy and sorry about the ceiling song.

Credits

2416.name: The Ancient Art of Staying Alive
2416.description:
You have one aim in this game - to STAY ALIVE!
Sadly the Crimson Tide Consortium are, for no apparent reason, out to get you.
Unashamedly retro in every aspect, if you want amazing visuals then look elsewhere, but if you want a simple, challenging game that's randomised every time you play it, you might just find this to be your cup of tea.
Features:
- Steam achievements
- 3 Global Leaderboards
- Works with Linux using Proton in Steam
- Play individual levels or "Challenge Mode", where you try to defeat all 20 levels in order
- In Challenge Mode, every 5th level is a Boss
- Highly customisable for all skill levels
- Right or left-handed keyboard
[…]
controls

Credits

2415.name: Sandi Knievel: Stunt Rider
2415.description:
Sandi Knievel: Stunt Rider.
Made for March 2020 MAG
You are Sandi Knievel, stunt rider ranked 3rd in the world and have entered the 2020 Stunt Rider Championship.
You love the thrill of kissing the grim reaper and dicing with danger!
You are up against some stiff rivals that include Johnny Kidd, Greaser Bill, Fast Eddie and the dreaded Razor Smith: ranked 4th in the world. Razor Smith is a nasty piece of work at the best of times. He once poisoned a blindman's dog and stole his cane!
You are smart and have the best stunt bike mechanics in the business, but are they enough to beat the other rivals and win the 2020 Stunt Rider Championship?
The correct speed, and th
[…]
e right equipment for each stunt are key factors and it is the fastest time that wins.
Be careful you don't fall off and have an accident and end up being carted off in an ambulance before trying the stunt again.
Hints after accidents give a clue as to why you failed that stunt.
Choose equipment and set your speed for each stunt.
Stunts include:
* Hair-raising jumps
* Bed of nails
* Flaming hoops
* Buses
* Choose a breakfast before a Barrel race
* ....And more
Stunt Rider's results are displayed at the end.. Will you become the 2020 Stunt Rider Champion?

Credits

2414.name: A Curious Pastime
2414.description:
A comedic romp through the vaguely fantasy-ish camp of the Fir Cruthen (a band of mighty warriors, druids, and bards)

Credits

2413.name: Kill Yourself
2413.description:
What a wonderful day to end your life!
Your boss fired you. Your wife left you. The fridge is empty, you have no friends, and your only necktie looks awful. The only way out is the sweet embrace of the Grim Reaper.Relieve the poor protagonist of his miserable existence in this old-school point and click misadventure game! Gather and combine objects to unlock all possible endings, or die trying!

Credits

2412.name: The Frozen Shore
2412.description:
Winner of MAGS February 2020
Harry lives a simple life. Every morning he wakes up and takes his little boat out fishing. This morning however, he awakens to find that the whole coastline has been covered in snow! Will he still be able to take his boat out of the harbour for his daily fishing trip?

Credits

2411.name: Frozen Kingdom
2411.description:
Made for Jan 2020 MAG competition....
Synopsis:
A sudden freeze has frozen the Kingdom of Malonia and everything is perishing! Queen Fallona has instructed her soldiers to help the villagers with extra blankets and food.
The queen has also appointed Rogerick, the seventh son of the earl of Brassock to investigate the cause.
Who is responsible for causing the frozen kingdom? Was it a witch, a sorceress or something else?
Talk to people, obtain useful items and complete tasks. Can Rogerick save the kingdom of Malonia from the clutches of evil?
Uses the Bass template with the two click handler... Custom one Save, Save Restore, Save Delete. Also incorporates game Pause /
[…]
unPause.
Download includes Linux build...

Credits

2410.name: Mind Rape: Duress
2410.description:
An experience so sinister and ghastly, I refuse to believe it is over.
This is the only way how can I make it at least partially comprehensible to the public - a story of a broken mind and a shattered identity trapped in a world that is no longer relevant.
It would be nourishing if you went through it as well, so I can get a fraction of your sanity while you shall lose it. But no worries, such a minimal loss won't affect you.
And if you still ask what is this game about - it is about reaching one's minimal amount of sanity through forced introspection combined with constant self-destruction and self-construction.

Credits

2406.name: Paper Planes
2406.description:
A polished version of my entry for the MAGS October 2019 "Kids" competition.
Relying on Last & Furious source code by Crimson Wizard

Credits

2405.name: **** in Trump's Bed
2405.description:
Game updated and uploaded on itch.oi. Contains sound, music and crap on the telly.
Go to America!
See the sights!
Visit the white house!
You can figure out the rest. Also sorry.
A short LucasArts adventure featuring a cab driver in a fantastic hat, the ability to have a good peek at things and you can even pick up a stick. It's pointy. Cool, right.
Controls
Left click to walk. Click the edge of screen to leave the room. Right click to LOOK or TALK. Inventory at the top of the screen.
Thanks to Abstauber for the brilliant Thimbleweed Park template.
Thanks to Selmiak for the youtube video. Neat.
Good luck and happy hu
[…]
nting.

Credits

2404.name: Black Sect 2: The Cursed Crypt (PnC Remake)
2404.description:
A 1st-person perspective point 'n click graphic adventure.
It's a remake of the original 1991 version of Black Sect 2, called 'La Crypte Des Maudits'
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Story:
After stealing the magical book of spells in La Secte Noire (Black Sect 1), the Black Sect has returned to terrorize the population. They are gathering in a nearby crypt, below the dark rooms of the castle of Golin the Gnome, and you have ventured into it.
Find your way to the crypt through the castle filled with passages blocked by gates, doors and chests to be opened, buttons to be pressed, levers to be pulled, and se
[…]
cret rooms...
Can you annihilate this evil sect once and for all?
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Windows & Linux versions available.

Credits

2403.name: Fritz
2403.description:
Winner of Jan 2020 MAG...
Fritz is a cat that wants to play with the other cats but they say he is too fat to be in their gang and that he is a misfit.
Feeling like a misfit Fritz is determined to lose weight and be able to get through his cat-flap into the garden with the other cats!
Help Fritz loose weight.
Can Fritz become a non-misfit?
There is a moral to this story of conforming issues that is reflected the world over.
Uses the Bass Template.

Credits

2402.name: A Christmas Ghost
2402.description:
A MAGS Game for the December 2019 Challenge 'Create your own Christmas'.
Help the little ghost find his Christmas adventure and maybe make friends along the way.
It is more of an interactive story than an adventure game. Make your own decisions, there are 6 endings to this short story. Enjoy!

Credits

2401.name: Broken Windows - Chapter 1
2401.description:
Frownthorpe is an unremarkable town in an unremarkable county.
You are probationary police constable Jack Burton, fresh out of training and eager to succeed.
This is just as well because something very remarkable is about to happen in this unremarkable town.
The first episode of a point and click adventure game inspired by the Police Quest series (albeit with no dead ends or deaths!)
Hope you enjoy it.

Credits

2400.name: Path of the skinwalker FULL GAME
2400.description:
\\Here is the full game. It is not a perfect game but its fun. It is a fairly simple game. Fixed the bugs and made some changes to the opening screens  All original music By AKB Records

Credits

2399.name: Sabotage on Noegato-Bas
2399.description:
Planet NOEGATO-BAS is controlled by FUELZ, a giant corporation. FUELZ has pipelines all over the planet and controls around 90% of the trade on the planet. Recently FUELZ shortened workers' wages on planet Noegato-Bas and also introduced a currency they pay it out in, that is only accepted in Rocket Town, the capital and spaceport of Noegato-Bas.
Dim is part of a lose cell of workers united unter the name of
MOLOTOV. Their plan is to disrupt business of the FUELZ company and especially to destroy one of their pipelines in the southern district.
You play as Dim and your task is to help him reach MOLOTOV's goals!
This game was originally made in a week for the Cyberpunkjam 2019. After the jam wa
[…]
s over it evolved into this!

Credits

2398.name: A Christmas Nightmare
2398.description:
A kid meets Santa and wishes for a present... but nothing is what it seems.
Why are the days repeating? Who is Greg?! What is Santa hiding?!?
Help Eddy in uncovering the truth and reaching the Good Ending in this
Groundhog Day
meets point and click adventure!
Updated: 26/12/2020 Version 1.2

Credits

2397.name: AGS Awards Ceremony 2018
2397.description:
THIS CLIENT IS *ONLY* FOR THE 2018 CEREMONY
You can still run the client and enter the online event hall, but since it was a one-time, live event, there won't be much interesting to do in there.
The 2018 AGS Awards celebrate AGS games released in 2018.
In an online, in-game ceremony (held 30. March, 2019), AGSers from all over the world met up to learn which games had won in the different categories.
Read more about the AGS Awards:
http://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/wiki/AGS_Awards
(The client will be open-sourced, just haven't got around to sorting out all the licensing data yet.)

Credits

2396.name: Headbanger's Heaven - A Rock & Roll Adventure
2396.description:
Jason Miller is a typical teenage rocker.  Loves to stay up all night and sleep all day.  And of course, headbang to his favourite music.
When he enters a competition in Kerplow Rock Magazine, he never dreamed he would actually win first prize!
But won, he has.  And now he gets to spend the afternoon with his favourite band, Uptempo Maniacs, and get a private performance of their new song.
He is SO excited!  He still can't believe it, even when the limo driver drops him off at the band's mansion.
He has his autograph book, all ready to get autographs from all 6 of the band members.  And he CANNOT WAIT for the special private performance.
[…]
/>
But if he thinks he's in for an easy afternoon, he's got another think coming.

Credits

2395.name: Dreams of Winter Mass
2395.description:
The woods near your ancestral home are not safe. Nobody was ever sure why. You've returned to your ancestral home after several years abroad and feel unease around them. Your grandfather died of a mysterious illness. He once told you there was a demon in those woods. That it lived there since the day God kicked Adam and Eve out of Eden. The symbol of the cross kept him out for so long, but its waning has made it strong. He was never a superstitious man, but whatever lived there made him afraid. Your family is glad to see your return, but a strange white hart has gored your mother, just before your arrival. In rage, you grab one of your grandfather's hunting rifles to end this demon's life once and for all.

Credits

2394.name: ZAK - repixeled
2394.description:
Zak McKracken - repixeled
Version 0.3.2
This is a repixeled version of the game's beginnig of Zak
McKracken. It includes the intro and the first couple of rooms in San
Francisco in redone retro pixel graphic.
It's made with love and with respect for the beloved point and click classic.
The original game was released by Lucasfilm Games in 1988.
Enjoy.
Remark: This is not a comlplete remake of Zak McKracken. You can't finish the game. But there are all the interactions from the original one.
Update November 2020:
- added the 14th Avenue incl. LOU'S LOANS - Let's do some shopping!!
- bug fixes and tweaks
[…]
/>
- now with possibility to let Zak die

Credits

2393.name: Fashion Girl
2393.description:
My granddaughter Lexie, who is 7 often plays games on my laptop. She loves playing Fashion games where she can change a models' clothes and add accessories. So I thought I would make her a fashion game al la ags style!
You enter a Fashion Girl contest and you must dress to impress the judges. Change your Hair, Makeup and choose some Clothes and Accessories like Hats and Handbags. This is your big chance to become the 'Fashion Girl' of the year.
Enter Fashion Girl as YOUR name.
A snapshot image of you winning the 'Fashion Girl' of the year and receiving a certificate is in your Saved Games Folder (Fashion Girl).
Great for young kids.

Credits

2391.name: Create Your Own Game: Your Dreamy Christmas
2391.description:
Create your own game: Your dreamy Christmas. (regularly updated)
You create your own game-play by your actions and choices throughout the game. You can even play with your name.
You are displeased with your Christmas presents and decide to talk with your granddad. Your granddad tells some exciting stories of adventures.
Whilst taking to your granddad you are suddenly transported into a dream.
Sinbad the sailor is searching the Seven Seas for the greenest tree for Christmas after the King of Persia tells Sinbad that Persia does not have a tree for Christmas that year and the King is very sad, so he asks Sinbad for his help.
Do you remember as a kid how you used to fant
[…]
asies and role play as an adventurer, like Sinbad the sailor: Prince of Persia?
Well, now you can go back to those days of dreamy times of swashbuckling, monsters and genies.
Become Sinbad again and become an adventurer and sail the Seven Seas.
This time Sinbad must search an island to find the greenest Christmas tree for the King of Persia.
Of course it is not all plain sailing.
You will need to make choices from options, interact with items... Multiple paths...
This game is in the form of an interactive story book.
There is only one cursor (arrow) and there is no conventional Inventory, though you always have your trusted Shamshir sword.
This is pure adventure and there are times where you will need to have a think, or just chance it.
Yes, you could once again become Sinbad, hero of the Seven Seas along with his crew: Pegleg Bill and Shorty Sam.
How long can one dream for?
Made for Dec 2019 MAG.

Credits

2389.name: Brothers & Wreckers (demo)
2389.description:
Poor Vince and Gus. Their parents have been abducted by pirates!
Features:
- Pretty pixels!
- three small episodes with different types of gameplay.
- Unfinished business (demo).
- Glorious 8bit chiptunes.
- voice over: speech-to-text by 15.ai.
- No inventory. Don't waste your time looking for it.

Credits

2388.name: Falling Dark
2388.description:
Welcome to the game ‘Falling Dark’.
This is my seventh game, and I’m not sure if it’s a love story with political undertones, or a political story with romantic undertones. So, If anyone figures that out, hit me up.
“The year is 1999. The underground culture of the nineties is coming to an end. It is being replaced by a corporate-driven growth of technology and a culture of distraction. In the last dark streets of the city, people stand against this change to preserve their own ways of life. However, as entities start to sell it out, it becomes only a matter of time before the underground is divided and conquered.
In the midst of this, is Taylor. A simple person of an older time, struggling to keep
[…]
their head above water as they’re sucked deep into the heart of this conflict, and this division.”
‘Falling Dark’ is a point and click adventure game with RPG elements, featuring:
• Several branching narrative paths.
• A blend of 'Point and Click' puzzle solving and combat.
• A variety of hidden side-quests and encounters.
• And an original soundtrack.

Credits

2387.name: Jake's Very Last Journey
2387.description:
Jake has an unfortunate mishap on his way home, a mishap that lands him right in the clouds. He needs to find his way to the Pearly Gates and into heaven. But to make that happen, he needs
your
help.
Encounter, and counter, a preachy neighbour and an ill-tempered ghost in a wild and wonderful journey!

Credits

2386.name: Rogue
2386.description:
Rollie Davison is investigating the next big story for his EcoSpy blog when he stumbles into a world he never knew existed. Help Rollie solve the mystery of the rogue... and maybe catch himself a man in the meantime!
Rogue features male/male situations.
Rogue is a short and sweet point-and-click adventure game in the style of LucasArts classic games. It was developed as a Bara Jam 2019 submission, using Adventure Game Studio.
Note on content rating: By default, Censored mode is enabled. In censored mode, there is no nudity and the stronger language is edited.

Credits

2385.name: Doctor Who: Time Snare
2385.description:
Fangame about Fourth Dr Who

Credits

2384.name: Space Quest Visual Novel
2384.description:
English version
Remake to Space Quest 1 in Anime style. Almost... :)

Credits

2383.name: Audio Quest
2383.description:
Russian language only
Adventure without pictures. Only voices

Credits

2382.name: Sliders Quest
2382.description:
Russian language
Little adventure about Sliders series

Credits

2381.name: Donkey.Bas (AGS Remake)
2381.description:
Remake to Bill Gates's game 'Donkey.Bas'

Credits

2379.name: Night Witches: Women of the clouds
2379.description:
This game was made for Novembers' MAG Topic:  'Clouds'
Updated; 30/11/2019
In late 1944 - Russia invades German forces, attacking into East Prussia.
Stalin has assembled an elite flight squadron of women: he calls the 'Night Witches' to destroy targets vital to the German army and stop them advancing into his Soviet Union.
The Night Witches are known for their bravery and their 'hide in the clouds under the cover of darkness' tactic.
Join in the thrills and spills of World War II action as Stalin enlists he's elite squadron of women fighter pilots, know as the 'Night Witches' to destroy the German advancement into his beloved Soviet Union.
Feel the adrenaline rush and yo
[…]
ur heart beating fast, as the action heats up as the Germans fire everything they have at you!
Avoid being hit by anti-aircraft shells, Fokker machine guns and bumping into sky bombs as you try to destroy targets that are vital to the German army.
Use your bombs and machine guns to take out targets and destroy the advancing German forces.
Will Stalin's Night Witches mission be successful?
A game that really puts you in the 'cockpit' of action!
Drop a Bomb: Keypress Z
Fire Machine gun: Keypress X
Change Plane direction/altitude: use Mouse.. Left click in Fly mode

Credits

2378.name: The Secrets of Jesus
2378.description:
The Secrets of Jesus is a classic point & click adventure game, which tells an old tale in a completely new manner.
What if Jesus had been able to escape his crucifixion? Would he escape the Romans, who are still bent on enforcing their death sentence? Or maybe even start a family with his great love? Just slip into his role and figure it out!
But before it is time to settle down with his beloved lady, there is still a lot to do. There are a lot of riddles to be solved and secrets to be revealed while searching for a missing person.
Delve into the atmosphere of the first century. Experience a fascinating adventure filled with biblical quotes, allusions to the Holy Scripture, and a lot of
[…]
black humor. Play detective and decide at the end of the game for yourself which version of the historical narrative you want to believe in.

Credits

2377.name: Clotilde Soffritti in: Never Buy a Used Spaceship
2377.description:
Thinking about buying a used spaceship? Think again!
In this cautionary tale of great emotional impact (?), our heroine Clotilde finds herself stuck on an old spaceship, directed towards the sun!
Only you can save the ship! Oh, and her life too.

Credits

2376.name: Desmond: The 'Thing' from another world!
2376.description:
Desmond:The 'Thing' from another world! was made for October 2019 MAG.  Topic Kids.
It was a hot summers' evening and the stars were very bright. So bright that nobody noticed streaks of light flying across the night sky. Peter and Jimmy are out playing, as they often are, oblivious to what was just about to occur.
A sci-fi adventure begins for kids Peter and Jimmy when something out-of-this-world lands only feet away!
What is it? Why is it here? What does it want?
Find out in this Kid's sci-fi epic..
.

Credits

2375.name: Cyberpunk '97 -Episode 1-
2375.description:
A claustrophobic cyberpunk adventure.  Play as someone trying to get back on their feet in a new city after narrowly surviving a cataclysmic earthquake in a future where nothing is promised and everything is owned by a corporation.  Inspired by media like Shadowrun, Blade Runner, Johnny Mnemonic and more!

Credits

2374.name: The Village [MAGS]
2374.description:
This is a village management game made for the MAGS game jam of August 2019. Theme: Huts or Hats.
I ran over the time limit but finished a playable version anyway.
Increase your population to increase the available labour and resource gathering. There is a win condition when you reach 100 people, but it can be played beyond this.
CONTROLS:
Move the map with the mouse, mouse wheel to zoom.
W A S D can also be used to move the map, Q and Z to zoom.
F5 for save and load.

Credits

2373.name: Reality-in-the-Norm
2373.description:
Reality-on-the-Norm is a game series where anyone can make a game. This is my installment.
Set in a slightly different dimension to the other RON games, Reality-in-the-Norm follows David Jones at the end of a treasure hunt. See completely different versions of old characters, as well some new ones, as you get to witness a completely different take of Reality.
Now with voice acting, courtesy of the text-to-speech synthesis program 15.ai

Credits

2372.name: Maelstrom Obscura:  Case 1
2372.description:
Maelstrom Obscura is an intriguing adventure game delving into the misty veils of conspiracies, myths and legends. Talk to theorists, debunkers, locals, witnesses, agencies and the military. Gather information and discover for yourself if some conspiracies, myths or legends are true or false, or what you believe them to be.
Case 1: The Legend of the Loch Ness monster ..
Can you conclude the Legend behind the Loch Ness monster?
Is the Legend true or an elaborate hoax?
6 cases in the full game....
Multiple endings...
Game Updated 8th September 2019
Your comments can help us make improvements...

Credits

2371.name: Tropic Jim's Sweet Island Adventure
2371.description:
Have you ever wanted to vacation on an island where nothing will go wrong?  Where there aren't any plans involving you and two others who came to this island? Where there are no mandatory sunscreen checks?
Tropic Jim's Sweet Island Adventure is a short-ish point and click made in adventure game studio. Read notes, solve puzzles, and uncover what's happening on this totally very unassuming island.

Credits

2370.name: Paul Romano

2367.name: He Came Through the Door
2367.description:
You have no recollection how you got in that dark room, who is
that unconscious man beside you or why you have a surgical dressing on
your head. But you know this: you've witnessed something horrifying and
now you need to escape.

Credits

2366.name: Birdy Birdy
2366.description:
Play as a sparrow... I'm not sure how to describe the game without spoiling the story and the few puzzles...
Made for MAGS July 2019, themed "Animal protagonists".
Point&Click Adventure game
New LINUX version provided on mirror download link!
Res: 1024x576 32bit colour.
The 3D main character is a placeholder, due to lack of time.

Credits

2365.name: Conifer Skunks: Osvald's Surprise
2365.description:
Help Thyra find out what her husband Osvald is up to.
Originally this was going to be for May 2019 MAGS, but it became obvious it would never be done in time, even with an extension, so this is a stand-alone game.  If anything else, it's a proof of concept.
Sorry for any loud volume.  Once the game starts, go into the System Panel and adjust the volume manually.

Credits

2364.name: Troubling Teleportation
2364.description:
Jerzy’s hat has been stolen! Jerzy is a retired teleportation sheriff and kung-fu master, but for his retirement he wiped his memory to relax, uploading those stressful memories to a hat.  But now that Mad Willy has that hat, all Jerzy’s secret knowledge and kung-fu mastery are in the hands of an evil villain!
This is made with assets from 3d Movie Maker: images, sound effects, and music.  This is sort of a practice game, to develop a workflow and learn AGS before attempting something more ambitious with original assets.

Credits

2363.name: The World is Weird
2363.description:
It's just before midnight, and your clock has stopped ticking. Maybe you can find some new batteries for it.

Credits

2362.name: GNRBLEX (Final Version)
2362.description:
Take on the challenge and preserve both the species, and humanity's fragile sense of self-worth, in this retro-inspired point and click adventure game.
Features
:
- Traditional point'n'click game-play
- Retro-inspired visuals and art
- New, original soundtrack by http://jothmusic.com/
- Full voice acting by four talented voice actors
- A dark sense of humour
- Math!
- Extra wriggling
Now also available on itch.io:
https://wham.itch.io/gnrblex-2019-final-version/

Credits

2360.name: The Castle
2360.description:
Evil has taken over a small town. But a group of courageous adventurers has decided to organize an expedition to end the feared vampire.
Choose your favorite characters to get to the end of this adventure:
Peter - expedition leader
Sister Angela - demon hunter
Roger - the nerd
Agent L - expert in paranormal activities
Gogo - martial arts master
Alice - the pretty girl
Bob - a guy that has nothing to do with all this, but he was passing by
There are 5 different endings! Easy, moderate and hard...
And keep watch over the castle guards ...

Credits

2359.name: Mamma mia! Winter Ice Cream Mayhem
2359.description:
Winner of the MAGS competition for June 2019.
Help a hungry customer get an ice cream!
Germans crave for ice cream as soon as the sun is shining -- even when
it is freezing and there is snow in the streets. Or so it is said (maybe
without justification). :)
This is the story of a hungry German that must battle:
* an Italian ice cream vendor,
* a crazy helicopter mum
* and outlandish machinery
to get his beloved cone.
Features DIY voice acting: If you want to hear what's being said, then read the captions aloud!
Note: Contains Italian swearing; protective Italian parents might want to cover their children's ears, er eyes.
[…]
/>

Credits

2358.name: Harry Potter RPG
2358.description:
Français :
Découvrez ma page Tipeee ! :) https://fr.tipeee.com/marion-poinsot
Jeu de rôles créé avec Adventure Game Studio.
Décors et personnages créés avec
Les Sims
.
Basé sur l’univers de
Harry Potter
par J.K. Rowling.
Créez votre étudiant à Poudlard : choisissez son apparence et sa
Maison, et c’est parti pour une année d’étude à Poudlard ! Certaines
libertés ont été prises par rapport aux livres, le jeu ne suit pas avec
exactitude la chronologie du monde sorcier racontée dans la saga.
Augmentez
vos compétences, choisissez votre camp, vous êtes libre de faire tout
ce que
[…]
vous voulez dans les différents lieux décrits dans l’univers de
Harry Potter
: Poudlard, Pré au Lard, le Chemin de Traverse, etc !
Quel destin vous attend au terme de vos études ? Vous seul en déciderez !
******************
English
:
Role Playing Game made with Adventure Game Studio.
Backgrounds and characters made with "The Sims".
Based on "Harry Potter" by J.K. Rowling.
Create your Hogwarts student, his look, his House, and let's go for a year in the magical school ! The game does not follow exactly the books.
Increase your skills, choose your side, you are free to do what you want and go in all the places of the saga : Hogwarts, Hogsmead, London, wizard's houses, etc !
What will be your witch ou wizard's fate ? You choose !
Launch Winsetip.exe the choose the English language.
***
Things you have to do in order to go onbard the Hogwarts Express at the beginning :
- Go to the Diagon Alley through the tavern, then go to the bank to get your money.
- Once you have money, go to the shops in order to buy everything from the list your get (except from the pet, that is not available) : a cauldron, a feather, scrolls, an ink pot, and a wand.
- Then return to the street in front of the tavern and go to the train station. Buy a ticket.
- When you are on the train station, take the ticket and use it on yourself.
- The Hogwarts Express will arirve and your adventure can begin !

Credits

2357.name: Personal Rocket - DEMO
2357.description:
"Paranoids are not paranoids because they're paranoid, but because they keep putting themselves, fucking idiots, deliberately into paranoid situations."
--Thomas Pynchon, Gravity’s Rainbow
THE STORY
Six months ago, Cole Fisher was fired from his job as a computer engineer at Cosmic X, a corporation devoted to the betterment of the human race, the pursuit of world peace and eventual space conquest. The reason? He found out what they’re really up to. It’s quite obvious, you know. They’re trying to take over the world.
Since then, Cole has been holed up in his apartment hacking his way through endless labyrinthine connections, gathering as much data as he could to expose the
[…]
biggest conspiracy in human history.
And now, Cole has had a surreal vision, a religious experience, a
close encounter, call it what you like. A Mysterious Messenger has told him it’s time to act and bring down Cosmic X once and for all. Or at least that’s his take on it.
"Personal Rocket" is a tale of paranoia and loneliness, the evils of capitalism and too much web surfing, the material world and the Occult universe. Your typical postmodern blues.

Credits

2356.name: The Secret of Hutton Church of England Grammar School: VGA Edition
2356.description:
After a night of rigorous cleaning, you discover a mysterious cult has been operating at the school. After 25 years of cleaning up rubbish, you're about to come across a whole bunch of trouble.

Credits

2354.name: The One That Remains
2354.description:
The Space station "The Northwest passage" has suffered from a catastrophic accident. As a robot, it is your duty to aid the one remaining human on board the station.

Credits

2353.name: Tales From The Outer Zone: Fleshworms
2353.description:
A catastrophic tale of hubris and oversized leeches.
First you fly..
Then you crash..
And finally you deal with.. THE FLESHWORMS!
Created in two weeks for Adventure Jam 2019.

Credits

2351.name: Political Enemy (demo)
2351.developer: Fabio Forte (Aka Johhny Di Elea), Vincent Cortese
2351.description:
The story is set in an old mansion and sees guests for a political confrontation between two possible candidates for mayor and to examine their proposals. You will take on the role of Norman, a former cop, who now works in private and will have to solve a dark mystery in that mansion as the political challenger has mysteriously disappeared.

Credits

2350.name: Slay the Dragon III Unfinished
2350.description:
This is the unfinished version of the final chapter of the Slay the Dragon series. I lost motivation for working on the game because I believe I was too ambitious for someone with my level of experience. In this version, you can complete the puzzles and reach the dragons in the first two areas. The dragon fights have not been added, however. If I find the interest in the future I may come back and finish it. Thank you to everyone who followed along in the production of this game. I am proud of what I have completed

Credits

2348.name: Cave of Avarice
2348.description:
A former Dahomey Amazon turned mercenary has been hired by two explorers for leading them to a cave said to contain a great treasure. The mercenary has been tasked with guarding the entrance while the two explorers enter, but as gunshots are heard from within only to be followed by silence, the mercenary chooses to investigate...
There is a Linux version of the game.
Made for MAGS May 2019

Credits

2347.name: A Suspicious Date
2347.description:
User Interface:
Right Click - Interact
Left Click - Examine
Q - Quit
You can select multiples items in the item list.
This is a short game. One room only, under 10 minutes of game-play.
Credits for Sourced Assets:
[spoiler]
Merchant Copy Font
by S. John Ross (www.cumberlandgames.com)
Walter Turncoat Font
by Slideshow Principal Design
Snippet of My Way
tune by Usher
Tough Choices tune
by Eric Matyas (www.soundimage.org)
Tire Punching Sound Effect
by https://freesound.org/people/JohnsonBrandEditing/
Mirror Breaking Sound Effect
by by https://freesound.org/people/gladkiy/
[…]
Text Message Sound Effect
by https://freesound.org/people/morrisjm/
[/spoiler]

Credits

2346.name: Sumatra: Fate of Yandi
2346.description:
Sumatra: Fate of Yandi
is a traditional point and click adventure that tells the story of Yandi, a logging worker who gets caught up in a terrible landslide, leaving him lost and alone deep in the jungle. Join him on his quest to find his best friend and coworker Ramdan, and return home to his beloved partner Adiratna.
Complicating things, the regret of recent arguments with Adiratna loom over him. The desire to make amends will drive him forward as he makes his way through vast expanses of unexplored forest and desolate wasteland, where many dangers and secrets will be revealed...
Will Yandi reunite with his friend Ramdan? Will he make it home to his beloved Adiratna? Will he even make it out ali
[…]
ve?
FEATURES:
- An old-school point and click adventure aesthetic with many puzzles and an intriguing storyline.
- A range of interesting characters to encounter along the way... both human and animal, friend and foe.
- A variety of subtly unfolding mysteries to keep Yandi on his toes.
- A nostalgic style that harks back to the early classics of the genre, with some unique and modern twists.
- Original soundtrack featuring 30 tracks.
- Approximately 3-5 hours of gameplay with a rich and vibrant world to explore.
INSPIRATIONS?
- The classic point and click adventures of the '80s and '90s.
- The nature and legends of Indonesia.
- The Lost World by Arthur Conan Doyle.

Credits

2345.name: Another Hero - First Look Demo
2345.description:
Set in a medieval fantasy world, Sir George wakes up to find his knave has disappeared with all his belongings. He sets out to find out the truth behind this betrayal.
This is a short first look demo to give a taste for setting, story, and puzzle design.
INSTRUCTIONS:
Left click - Interact
Right click - Look
Inventory and menu bar at the top

Credits

2344.name: Guard Duty
2344.description:
Guard Duty is a “Pythonesque” comedy adventure that spans two radically different time periods -- the cobbled streets of medieval Wrinklewood and the future dystopia of Neo London -- replete with cheeky humour, stylised cartoon pixel art, and a story that blurs the lines between fantasy and sci-fi.

Credits

2343.name: Heroes of Wyrdale [MAGS]
2343.description:
This is an action/adventure with most of the adventure components removed due to time constraints.
The Central Union Council has been placed in a weaker position, and as adventurers you have come to this planet to take advantage of that fact to directly take on the council and the robots protecting them.
CONTROL:
Movement: Right-click
Use, examine, etc: Left-click
Hint: The energy bar recharges faster when above 50%

Credits

2342.name: The Era-Gone Trail MAGS
2342.description:
You play a group of tiny mammals trying to evade the destruction of the meteor impact that killed off the dinosaurs.
If you can make it to the end of the era you will be able to evolve and possibly thrive (in the full version).
This is the MAGS version of this game and only includes limited gameplay compared to the full vision of the game.
But it's still kinda fun!

Credits

2341.name: TRAVELERS (Prototype)
2341.description:
Made for MAGS April 2019.
TRAVELERS is a
prototype
. The gameplay
progressively
and
purposely
loses
purpose
the more you
play
.
The game can be played either with the mouse or keyboard.

Credits

2340.name: A Room Without You in it
2340.description:
A first-person, sort-of-escape-the-room, point-and-click adventure
dealing with grief, trauma and depression, and how they can take us to a
place that's very hard to come back from.

Credits

2338.name: Vivarium
2338.description:
Planet exploration simulator. A game that runs by itself. Quietly... in the background... if you like...

Credits

2337.name: Suspicious mind
2337.description:
You're trapped with an amnesic psychopath.
Can you fool his suspicious mind?

Credits

2335.name: HYDRATE
2335.description:
You are Shar, the last remaining engineer on a heavily damaged mining station in deep space. Many are dead, water supplies are gone, the last high ranking officer is drunk out of his face, what will you do?!
A quick and easy point and click made for MAGS March 2019.
The theme is GLASS OF WATER.
The Linux data file is bundled with it, no idea what you do with that!
Music by Eric Matyas.
Special thanks to Cassiebsg.
Have a good time! Love Retro Wolf.

Credits

2334.name: The Greenroom - An Escape Room Adventure
2334.description:
Your classic adventure game scenario: You wake up locked in a room with no recollection of how you got there. It is up to your puzzle solving skills to escape this unfortunate situation.

Credits

2333.name: Herby
2333.description:
Search the maze for keys and treasure! John 'DRJ' Vanderaart is one of the first published game designers from the Netherlands, best known for "Eindeloos". Herby was his first game on the C64, which I played as a child. This is also my first game, as I did a remake in BASIC back then. Decades later I found out I still had the source code, so I decided to update it to more modern systems, aided by Elissa for the art. And dedicated to one of the people who (although we never met personally) inspired me to take up game design!
Featuring one maze by DRJ, one by myself, and a random maze generator; and the famous Popcorn as background music. Unlike the originals, this one has save points and an automap. Enjoy!

Credits

2332.name: Thrymly disguised
2332.description:
Thor's hammer has been stolen by the evil giant Thrym, and so Thor must team up with Loki to retrieve it.
This game was made for MAGS in February 2019 with the theme
Dressing up.

Credits

2331.name: New Kid Gotta Steal Somethin'
2331.description:
The new kid on the block gets bullied into stealing a costume from a theater-actor's home.
This game was made for MAGS in February of 2019.

Credits

2330.name: Mage's Initiation: Reign of the Elements
2330.description:
D'arc is sixteen years old. He has trained extensively in the Elemental arts for the past decade, under the discerning eyes of the Mage Masters of Iginor. Confined to an existence of academics and magical mastery in their tower, the inquisitive Initiate often wonders what it would be like to explore the secluded outside world.
D'arc's moment of reckoning arrives and his Masters put him to the test. The young Initiate is tasked with retrieving three items, which will test his magical and mental strength to full capacity:
A lock of hair from a powerful Enchantress.
The unspoiled shell of Griffon's egg.
The three-pronged horn of the legendary Trinicorn.
Join D'arc on
[…]
a perilous journey across the medieval-styled land of Iginor. Brave the perilous Bloodbark forest where the Redcap goblins stalk. Trek across a barren desert wasteland rife with lawless Bandits and fierce Burrowers. Navigate over a vast lake where evil masquerades as beauty. And ascend beyond the lofty mountain peaks where the mysterious and hostile Flyterians dwell, suspicious of all outsiders. It is time for D'arc to prove himself.
Three quests. One chance. Will D'arc succeed and take his place among his fellow Mages?

Credits

2329.name: Trails and Traces: The Tomb of Thomas Tew
2329.description:
In 1695, Tew and his
fellow pirates pursued a Mughal ship. His ship, The Amity, attacked the
ship, the Fateh Muhammed. Tew was disemboweled by a cannon shot, and
died instantly. Or did he?
Present day. Private Detective James
Labbett takes a missing persons case, which unexpectedly leads to an
adventure of discovering the truth of what happened to the pirate Thomas
Tew, but he isn't the only one who has an interest..
- Inspired by the Broken Sword games, but with an extra dose of humour.
- An interactive jukebox with a few tunes by Because Because!
- 1-2 Hours of Gameplay, depending on whether you like to just solve the puzzles,
o
[…]
r look at everything and do crazy stuff like trying to use a megaphone on unsuspecting people.
- Tested on Windows 7, 8 and 10.

Credits

2328.name: An Entertaining Speech (A Manhunt for a Serial Killer)
2328.description:
It is a demo version. Few things appear out of place. Please bear with it.
A manhunt for a serial killer.
A person who is being attacked by a strange man calls emergency services for help.  Who is this strange man? Who is the person under attack? What is this all about?  Can you save him?
If you are unable to solve the puzzle, wait for a few minutes, a clue GUI will appear on the screen. Or you can PM(personal message) me. I'll be happy to assist you.
Credits:
Music by Lobo Loco
"Most Delightful Ever"
www.musikbrause.de
Creative Commons License(BY-NC-ND)
(Youtube - Sandsofa - Lobo Loco - Musikbrause)
Sounds
[…]
- www.musicradar.com
(SampleRadar: 502 free noise, hiss, and crackle samples)
Fonts - (www.dafont.com)
Pixel Operator by Jayvee Enaguas
Free Pixel by levelb

Credits

2327.name: The Manuscripts of Samaryanha
2327.description:
A first person point and click game where you must unravel a mystery concerning your family that then expands to the world.

Credits

2326.name: Alice in Maniacland
2326.description:
A crossover between Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and Maniac Mansion.Alice follows the Purple Tentacle through the rabbit hole and ends up outside the Edison's family Mansion. She is very curious to know what's going on inside the house and must find a way in.Made for MAGS January 2019: "Crossover".

Credits

2325.name: Space Cross: The BSG-Team
2325.developer: Sandra T. Almeida & Morgan E. Willcock
2325.description:
Starbuck's crash of the week takes him to a planet where he meets some odd people. Take control while he tries to fix his viper and return to the fleet.
Mags entry under the theme: Crossover
Game res: 960x600 32bit Full color!
Download link: MediaFire(Windows) | Mirror link: MediaFire (Linux)
MAGS winner! :)
Update:
12-01-2020: Version 1.3 fixes loading file when no save game exists.
25-02-2019: Version 1.2 fixes some typos and small cosmetic stuff. Plus adds Viper credit, that I had forgotten. :o

Credits

2324.name: Ego in Planet of the Apes
2324.description:
Made for MAGS in January of 2019,
Ego in Planet of the Apes
is a short and tasteless point-and-click adventure with profanity, sexual "jokes", and crude "humor".

Credits

2323.name: Bohemian Yard
2323.description:
Riddle solving adventure in a gloomy mansion with 50+ rooms and 5 different endings

Credits

2320.name: 3 GEEKS
2320.description:
Playable free demo of the full chapter 1 !
Full Game avaible on http://www.adipson.com

Credits

2318.name: Bittersweet
2318.description:
Less funny than the last one.

Credits

2317.name: The Shaft
2317.description:
Sgt. Reed has been tasked with descending into an abandoned underground
facility, activating the power generator and opening the main entrance.
But
things did not exactly work as planned, leaving Reed stranded
underground with no means of communication, most of the gear lost and
very little idea of what went wrong in the first place and, most
importantly, what lies at the bottom of the shaft...

Credits

2316.name: Cornelius Cat in: How the Cat Saved Christmas
2316.description:
Someone was naughty and stole the Christmas decoration! Now it is up to Cornelius and Mortimer to bring it back and save Christmas.
Meet old and new characters, enjoy Dr. Seuss style rhymes and solve festive puzzles in a cotton wool landscape.
Created for MAGS December 2018
F5 to save
F6 to restore
Ctrl+q to quit
There is a German translation available.
You can run the game on your Android phone using the official launcher app: https://github.com/adventuregamestudio/ags/releases/download/v.3.5.0.22/AGS-3.5.0.22-debug.apk

Credits

2315.name: The Dollhouse: Episode 1 - Plaything
2315.description:
Synopsis: Some crazy kook has locked you up and is forcing you to do adventure game puzzles for his entertainment! Can you navigate his dungeon and escape?
The Game:
The Dollhouse is my first ever game project with AGS. In many ways it's "Baby's first game" and was used mainly as a jumping board to teach myself about the engine.
I'm adding the subtitle - Chapter 1, since I may return to the Dungeon in the future with a new set of puzzles.
Features:
Point-and-click interface just like Ron used to make it.
Several minutes of gameplay!
Programmer art and questionable use of colour!
3 Frames of exciting background animation!
BEES!

Credits

2314.name: Tales From The Outer Zone: The Goat Crone
2314.description:
An occult yule tale of responsibility and dark rituals.
Alma has to prepare the yule ham while her father is out in the forest.
But the nightmarish myth of The Goat Crone haunts her and her baby brother.
The Goat Crone is the second episode of Tales From The Outer Zone. The first episode is "Cyborg Seppuku".
This game was made in three weeks for MAGS December 2018.

Credits

2313.name: This City at Night
2313.description:
Tracey hates her humdrum job at Insurance International, but it turns out there is more going on there than meets the eye. An unknown organisation is plotting a coup that will have catastrophic global consequences, and unless it can be stopped in time, the world will be brought to its knees...

Credits

2312.name: Bear in Venice
2312.description:
Bear in Venice is a very short adventure game about a teddy bear's desire to ride a gondola.

Credits

2311.name: Santa and the orphanage
2311.description:
Made for Dec's Mag 2018.
Mayor, Ebeneezer Grinch has cut Christmas funding for the Wayward childrens Orphanage and so they are relying on public donations. Santa said he would be more than happy to give the children presents and Christmas dinner this year, much to the dismay of Mayor, Ebeneezer Grinch. So, Mayor Grinch has sent his henchmen to Santas workshop to ruin the orphanages Christmas!
2 click interface..
Children friendly.....

Credits

2309.name: The Wicked Witch of the West
2309.description:
The Wicked Witch of the West has captured Dorothy in her castle.
Will Dorothy be able, with the help of her friends, to get released and defeat her?
Short one-room game made for MAGS November 2018

Credits

2308.name: The Strawman Augment
2308.description:
Made as a part of the monthly MAGS challenge through the Adventure Game Studio community, "The Strawman Augment" was made over the course of November 2018.
The theme for the month was "Scarecrow"
I decided to go full pants-on-head crazy so bring out your "Aliens" memes.
Story:
"While on a relaxing cruise of the galaxy, you break down on a backwater world. To repair your ship, you will have to use a nanomachine controlled body to explore the world and gather the materials needed to leave this backwater dirtball."
Known Issues:
I ran out of time for the contest, so I ended up using the default two-click GUI that's built into AGS... and it looks a little
[…]
funky. If I do a future build I hope to fix it.

Credits

2307.name: Sniper and spotter climbing a tower
2307.description:
Olga and Ivan are a sniper and spotter team fighting in the great patriotic war. When a cheerful war correspondent cross their path both of them see a chance to make a grab for glory...
Sniper and spotter climbing a tower is a standalone sequel to my previous game Sniper and spotter being patriotic, and was made for MAGS in November 2018.

Credits

2306.name: Blooded Fields
2306.description:
There's been a murder in Beckenshire, and you've been called in to solve it.
Hunt down clues, interrogate witnesses and suspects, and form a theory as to who is the murderer, in this point and click adventure with a gameboy-themed palette.

Credits

2305.name: Strawman Bombing Disposal
2305.description:
You are crossing a Washington D.C. road when a truck pulls away revealing something shocking.
This game is not meant to be easy. Only a very few will probably have the patience to complete it.
The game starts and ends suddenly as I wanted it to feel like you are abruptly thrown into a situation and then right back out of it.
You can click to skip a bunch of diaglog and/or cutscenes to cut to the chase, but I would advise you to listen to and watch everything all the way through at least once.
There is no save game function or checkpoints system at this time but once you know how to solve a puzzle it is pretty easy to repeat the solution within a few seconds.
I will b
[…]
e making a Tips And Hints thread of my own for the game so I would appreciate it if noone else does so for now.
DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO SAVE WASHINGTON?!

Credits

2304.name: Black Friday
2304.description:
Somewhere in Maine, five teenagers decided to spend the night at a farm. To goof off and have fun, as teenagers do. But little do they know that they're being watched by an evil entity intent on doing them harm.
Soon they find themselves being killed off, one by one. Will any of them survive?
Black Friday is a homage to slasher movies in the form of a point and click adventure game.

Credits

2303.name: Scarecrow and his quest for a brain
2303.description:
Made for November 2018 MAG competition....
Scarecrow and his quest for a brain....
"Why are you looking so glum, Mr, Scarecrow?"
"I'm fed up! People don't take me seriously."
"They ignore me and think I'm just a stoopid, old scarecrow."
"I could while away the hours"
"Conferrin' with the flowers,"
"If I only had a brain."
"I don't think you're stupid, Mr. Scarecrow."
"Ah, you are just trying to be nice to me, Miss Dorothy."
"No. if I had a brain I could be a someone."
"Someone who is admired, respected."
"A poet or an artist, maybe?"
Meet familiar characters as you follow the yellow brick road.

Credits

2302.name: Dr. Chuckles' miniature world of madness.
2302.description:
Winner of Octobers 2018 MAG Competition....
You are officer Marc Delago. You've been tasked with reopening a cold case leading back to the 80's, involving a string of missing people in the Sleepy Oak area, after new evidence matching the M.O. of the deranged maniac behind the kidnappings came to light.
A heavily wounded and psychologically distressed man claiming to be an escaped victim of the kidnapper has provided a compelling statement that could lead you straight to his captor.
Will you finally bring justice to the homicidal mad man behind these kidnappings?
Are these kidnappings in any way linked to the disappearance of the governor's daughter?
What hidden dangers will y
[…]
ou encounter along the way?
Find out in Dr Chuckles' Miniature World of Madness.
* New Version uploaded and revised often...

Credits

2301.name: My Burden to Keep
2301.description:
It is May 3rd, 1941.
Just as the sun peeks over the horizon on that cold spring morning, a harrowing report comes in to the sheriff's department. The mayor has been murdered in his home.
Solve the murder/Clear your father's name. Two wills struggle on separate paths towards the same goal, to find out what really happened. Who killed mayor James Scott?

Credits

2300.name: Captain Downes and the Pirate Princess
2300.description:
Captain Roderick Downes is sailing the Baltic sea when he is boarded by pirates led by a local princess, and Roderick soon finds himself prisoner on his own ship. Can you help him escape?
This game was made for MAGS in october 2018 with the theme "miniature".

Credits

2299.name: In Bloom
2299.description:
The Infestation is blooming, and time is running out. You have to decide how you will save humanity.
In the far-flung future, the earth is in danger: A malicious bloom has spread through the galaxy and will soon engulf the earth. You will be tasked with saving it, but in the end, you must decide how!
This game was created for the 2018 $102 Adventure jam, in which it attained 6th place! This version has some small improvements and sound effects added.

Credits

2298.name: BlindSweeper
2298.description:
This is my entry to #audiogamejam3
Basically it's a remake of Minesweeper but using only your hearing.
Yes the screen is SUPPOSED to be completely black.  You could even play it with your screen switched off.
Apart from the obvious accessibility benefits of this it suits my graphical abilities! :-D

Credits

2297.name: Subterra (DEMO)
2297.description:
Earth has grown overpopulated and humanity has fought over the last natural resources. As the collapse of civilization becomes apparent, a deep space probe is launched to discover a new world to populate. In the year 2184 information is received regarding an earth-like planet and a starship is launched with a specially selected crew and passengers.

Credits

2295.name: Here Be No Sirens
2295.description:
A siren, half-woman, half-bird is trying to live peacefully on her remote little island.
But how can one hope for some peace and quiet if, for some weird reason, human sailors just won't stop washing ashore?

Credits

2293.name: Jason and the Golden Apple
2293.description:
September's Mag competition 2018
Topic: Mermaids and Sirens
Chosen by Kastchey
Joint winner.
Storyline:
Mesopotamia is on the outbreak of an epidemic of disease and many are dying. The Golden Apple is said to bring peace and cure all disease's. So the Khalif of Baghdad commissions Jason to sail to the island of Ghoul to obtain the Golden Apple that he as been informed of and that it is somewhere on Ghoul island.
Jason sets sail with his loyal crew to the Island of Ghoul. Unbeknownst to Jason Ghoul island is habited by flesh eating Sirens whose beautiful wailing voices drive men insane who crash their ships onto the sharp rocks only to be eaten alive!
Can Jaso
[…]
n make it safely onto the island of Ghoul and find the Golden Apple?
Or will Bob Bones and his cut-throat skeleton crew get it?
At the start you can decide if you want Goddess Hera's help or not. Default is on.
Please leave feedback...

Credits

2283.name: Fists of Murder [MAGS]
2283.description:
A fighting/adventure game hybrid.
Homeless man Joe witnesses a murder and must work with a friend to undo the cover-up and get the truth out.

Credits

2281.name: The Campaign Of Daphne White
2281.description:
Made for MAG competition Aug 2018.
Topic: Censorship by Hobo.
For Windows and Linux.
Storyline:
MP Daphne White is enforcing her censorship policies on her constituent public. The public are outraged that their freedom to choose is being taken away so they march to the 'House' to protest against Daphne White's censorship policies. The 'House' turns down their protests. The constituent public decide to take matters into their own hands by defying Daphne White and going about breaking her censorship policies.
"You all know about the censorship policies I have presented to the House."
"There is far too much sordidness going on within my constituency."
The
[…]
re are four censorship quests (different people) that can be done in any order and you can change quests at any time.
Meet Sally, a friendly Labrador and drive a pink convertible...You may even come across a smelly skunk!
This game presents adult themes.
Gameplay: about an hour.
Cassiebsg: Background contributions.
Constantly revised...

Credits

2280.name: Yago, the Coquerrestrial
2280.description:
When the director of the famous Galactic Geographic magazine calls you to his office, you can't believe how lucky you are. You have been commissioned to produce a new documentary on the habits of the earthlings, only one of which has been made in the entire history of the planet Coque and dates back 40,000 years.
You have the makings of an extracococcal documentary filmmaker and this is your chance to prove you're the best.
However, things don't usually go as well as you want them to.....

Credits

2279.name: Big Trouble in Little Imola [ITA-ENG]
2279.description:
-ENGLISH- You're Joe, a famous Adventurer called in Imola, Italy (do you know? the former venue of the Formula 1 San Marino Grand Prix) to recover a legendary treasure.
During your visit to the town you will come in contact with several unexpected mysteries that may help you (or not...?)
-ITALIANO- "Grosso Guaio a Imola Town". Tu sei Joe, un famoso avventuriero chiamato a Imola (ricordi? dove si correva il Gran Premio di San Marino di Formula 1) per recuperare un tesoro leggendario. Durante la visita alla cittÃ  verrai in contatto con alcuni misteri inaspettati che potranno aiutarti (o no...?)

Credits

2278.name: S.A.M
2278.description:
A short, point n'click, puzzle platformer about a solitary robot on an abandoned planet.

Credits

2277.name: Cola Skunkette: A Bit of Cleanup
2277.description:
For August 2018 MAGS.
Panphila Baniliakola needs help getting rid of some offensive graffiti so her business can be family friendly again.
Note that the sound effects might be a bit faint, so you may need to turn up the volume to hear them.
Also, in-game, I had mistakenly called Blondbraid "Blondbeard".  Oops! :-[

Credits

2276.name: Space Tunneler Deluxe
2276.description:
An updated version of my old MAGS game from December 2015, this is an arcade game with a fairly substantial dose of strategic planning involved.
Available for Windows and Linux (though I have no way of testing the Linux build).

Credits

2275.name: Forms
2275.description:
This is my first game made with AGS.
Forms is a very short abstract game with minimalistic geometrical 2D graphics.
It was intended to be a way for me to begin learning the studio, but not only that, as I also had a basic idea I wanted to implement.
I would like to know if it does the trick on the puzzle side.
So please review. Thanks!

Credits

2274.name: The Lightning Spell
2274.description:
A terrible drought has swept the lands. You are Mark, a wizard's apprentice. Your job is to collect all the ingredients for mana and cast a lightning spell into sky and save the world.

Credits

2273.name: Stories of the unexpected: 'Until further notice'
2273.description:
Stories of the unexpected: Until further notice
Made for July's Mag competition.
Storyline:
Two middle aged guys set out to rob a bank due to their financial circumstances.
Can they infiltrate the bank, find the safe, open the safe, grab the money and end their money troubles?
George Ponsonby: "Bert..."
George: Ponsonby "...haven't even told this to my wife."
George Ponsonby: "Ponsonby Metals is on the verge of bankruptcy."
Controls:
Custom 2 Click mouse: left Click Interact / Right Click Look at.
Tab or GUI Button to open up tools.
Misc:
Clock display.
Frequently updated.
Feedback encour
[…]
aged.

Credits

2272.name: Private Detective
2272.description:
Private Detective is a procedurally generated murder mystery game, where you must solve randomly generated crimes by finding leads, questioning suspects, and gathering evidence from the crime scene to compare with samples found in the homes of the suspects. It plays a lot like an adventure game, but with a lot more deduction and a lot less inventory object puzzles.

Credits

2271.name: My Dear Globalist Agenda
2271.description:
It is my fifth full title, this time about a miserable stock broker and an unemployed musician who while desperately trying to swim out of debt find unlikely answers in the local Ku Klux Klan branch, leading them on an absurd and often comedic adventure.

Credits

2270.name: The Guilt Eternal
2270.description:
The Guilt Eternal is an adventure game in which you play a hero trying to solve a mysterious case of kidnapping.
Norbert is a television fortune-teller tormented by painful memories. When he gets involved in a strange scandal, he decides to do everything to prevent the past from happening again.

Credits

2269.name: Commissar's Contrapasso
2269.description:
Commissar's Contrapasso is a story about an arrogant soviet commissar
who follows the official doctrines of the party with little regard for the simple soldiers beneath him, until he finds himself caught alone behind enemy lines that is.
What follows is a darkly humorous adventure with many strange turns. Whether or not the commissar will make it out alive depends on you, the player.
If you like this game, please also try my earlier game, Sniper and Spotter being patriotic, as it has similar themes and setting!

Credits

2268.name: Don't Ice Your Cool
2268.description:
A tiny EGA game originally made in four days for MAGS June 2018. It has since then been updated with additional animations, puzzles, interactions and an after credits scene. Even with the updates, it's still a very short and simple game, but hopefully offers few minutes of fun and enjoyment.
The original MAGS version can still be downloaded from here: tulevik.eu/ags/mags/DIYC_MAGS.zip

Credits

2267.name: Ice in the Air
2267.description:
Charly has just been told he needs to play outside as long as the weather is good. However what he wants is to go back in and play on his computer, since all his friends are on vacation.
P&C adventure game made in 3 days made for MAGS, hope you have some fun with it. :)
Game length: 5 to 15 minutes
Game res: 320x180, 32bit colour
UPDATE 06Jul2018: Seems there was a bug with the bonfire (you need more than 1 item :o )
15Jul2018: V1.2 Now with less typos thanks to Phemar!

Credits

2265.name: AGS Awards Ceremony 2017
2265.description:
THIS CLIENT IS *ONLY* FOR THE 2017 CEREMONY
You can still run the client and enter the online event hall, but since it was a one-time, live event, there won't be much interesting to do in there.
The 2017 AGS Awards celebrate AGS games released in 2017.
In an online, in-game ceremony (held 24. March, 2018), AGSers from all over the world met up to learn which games had won in the different categories.
Read more about the AGS Awards:
http://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/wiki/AGS_Awards
This game (except for some avatar resources) is open source, and the project is available here:
https://bitbucket.org/agsa/ags-awards-source/commits/tag/2017

Credits

2264.name: AGS Awards Ceremony 2016
2264.description:
THIS CLIENT IS *ONLY* FOR THE 2016 CEREMONYYou can still run the client and enter the online event hall, but since it was a one-time, live event, there won't be much interesting to do in there.
The 2016 AGS Awards celebrate AGS games released in 2016.
In an online, in-game ceremony (held 11. March, 2017), AGSers from all over the world met up to learn which games had won in the different categories.
Read more about the AGS Awards:
http://www.adventuregamestudio.co.uk/wiki/AGS_Awards
This game (except for some avatar resources) is open source, and the project is available here:
https://bitbucket.org/agsa/ags-awards-source/commits/tag/2016_2.1

Credits

2263.name: Absin
2263.description:
Welcome to the initial release of the game "Absin".
It is the most comprehensive title I have yet produced.
Inside this folder is everything you'll need to play the adventure game and help with the game design process.
If you're feeling constructive, inside as well is a .doc file which can be filled out and emailed back to me for feedback.
This is very helpful for me to continue making games.
BEWARE: There is no saving or loading, so be prepared for a full experience of about an hour when you start.
Thank you for playing and please,
Enjoy the game!
-Fransis <3

Credits

2262.name: Rat Playing Game
2262.description:
You play as a sewer rat who, one day, detects a delicious smell coming from a plate of food accidentally left out overnight on a restaurant counter somewhere far above his sewer-pipe lair.
YOU MUST DEVOUR IT!!!
Along the way you will encounter enemies to fight, poisonous bait, a powerful final boss enemy and, hopefully, some moments to make your skin crawl.
Save up your XP and return to your lair to buy upgrades to your stats and skills and maybe eventually you will defeat the final boss enemy and get to the exquisite prize!

Credits

2261.name: Groundhog
2261.description:
Made for June MAG competition 2018.
"Bill Rutherford is an ordinary eight-to-five type guy. He works in a local bank doing a job that he finds rather stuffy. He is single and hopes that one day he will meet the girl of his dreams.
He does not know it yet, but he is about to step into something mysterious that will change his life...forever."
He goes to the Silver Cafe for coffee when he bumps into Carol and it is instant attraction.
The idea of the game is to get to know Carol in as few days as possible. You do this by guessing her favorite things such as drink, food, song etc etc.
You need to get all subject options correct to go to the next scene..... failure of a
[…]
ny subject option will make you relive the day again.
Will Bill get the girl and if so, how many days will he have to relive before he does?

Credits

2260.name: Bigfoot
2260.description:
Your 11 years old and determined to capture Bigfoot - this is my son's first attempt at an AGS game.  (Probably his last too)

Credits

2258.name: Lab Rat Maze!
2258.description:
Ever wondered what a lab rat feels when someone places him into a maze? Well, now you no longer have to wonder! Experience it for your self!
Feel frustrated by the unfair tasks, extreme level of memory and other skills requirements that evil humans put poor rats through!
Point&Click style! And keyboard helper (use keyboard as help certain tasks).
Two levels of difficulty! (Only difference is how you experience the maze, not how hard puzzles are.)
25.06.2018 - Version 1.02: Fixes the "push" mechanism, that is now called "grab".

Credits

2257.name: The Burgomaster
2257.description:
A dark plague is consuming the town. One doctor is left to learn the truth, and try to find a cure.
By Gertrud Bondesson and Morgan Willcock.
Created for MAGS, in May 2018.

Credits

2256.name: The Rat Pack Do Cheesy Castle
2256.description:
Made for May MAG competition 2018.
This game deals with oppression and having the courage to face the oppressor.
It's a kind of Robin Hood story.
Storyline:
There had been years of oppression and cheese starvation under King Rat. One day, after having had enough Del, Rodney and Trigger pluck up the courage to put an end to it and plan taking all of King Rat's cheese and feeding the cheese starved. So they pack their lunchboxes and set off to King Rat's Cheesy Castle. Of course getting there is another story as they have to first make their way through a wood to find Checkpoint Charlie, and so their journey begins.Once they eventually arrive at Cheesy Castle they need to avoid being seen and sneak
[…]
into the castle. If seen they are put into a dungeon. Once inside the castle they must search the tower and take any cheese they can get. Their eventual aim is to get King Rat and his rat soldiers out of the tower and go to the top of the tower where you can take all the cheese that is there which includes melted Camembert running down the walls and a floor of cheddar cheese.
Beware that you don't get caught as King Rat's soldiers are cut-throats that like to skin lesser rats!
Along the way meet Bovis a villager, Clive who is King Rat's jester, Duncan the Donkey who has an injured leg, a wild Coyote and a rat soldier who wants to jazz up his cheese sandwich!
All solutions to problems can be solved with food... Yes, food.
You can switch the main character to Del, Rodney or Trigger during the game. Keep an eye on your 'Cheese-ometer' as it shows the current weight of cheese taken.
Once you get to the castle you may if you so wish abort and go home.
Be aware that there is some humor towards the end that some may find offensive!
You may notice the link connections between the characters and the Topic.

Credits

2254.name: Rainbow Skunk Prism and the Vermin-Truder
2254.description:
Entry for the May 2018 MAGS competition.  Theme: Rats.
Help Prism, a rainbow-furred skunk girl, get rid of a mutant ratman and save her greenhouse.
Updated to include music and sound (courtesy of RPG Maker 2000).

Credits

2253.name: Cedric Shooter (Win/Linux)
2253.description:
In this funfair-style arcade mini-game adaption of Sierra's KQ5 owl named Cedric, you have to kill Cedric as many times as possible!
The owl is the wisest of all birds because the more it sees, the less it talks.  So let's show Cedric some bullets!
Instructions:
* Cedric will randomly and infinitely jump out and back in one of the 8 vases.
* When you kill Cedric, he'll explode and resurrect.
* Left-click is shoot, right-click is switch between pistol and shotgun.
* You get 20 seconds to kill Cedric as many times as you can.
* Hit
to dump a screenshot in the save-game folder.

Credits

2252.name: Grand Kitchen Escape
2252.description:
A cat, a dog or an aching ex party guest with a hangover are locked into Lea's kitchen. They need to get out. Can you help them?

Credits

2251.name: Slay the Dragon II
2251.description:
A dragon has been terrorizing your village. Hunt it down so it can't do any more harm.

Credits

2250.name: When Time Stops
2250.description:
Made for April 2018 Mag Competition.
Reef Rivers: artifact hunter.
Storyline:
After travelling to Glasburgh University, to attend lectures by Professor Higgins you find yourself volunteering for a dangerous quest for Professor Higgins who believes, through ancient scrolls that he has finally found the location of the Ring of Power. He wants you to fly to Assabar, India and enter the secret hidden Temple of Bhindiwara and find and bring back the Ring of Power that can stop time itself!
The Ring of Power was once worn by Shabgur, an evil warlord of India. He turned the seasons to eternal winters and the daylight to nights. During a bloody battle, Shabgur lost his hand with the Ring o
[…]
f Power on and so retreated.
The Bhindiwara's found that they could not smash or melt the Ring so decided to hide it in a secret, hidden temple so that man could never again have the power to stop time.
The Ring of Power has remained in the Temple of Bhindiwara for over two thousand years.
The question is: Are you alone?
* Don't worry if you do something really silly and die...you can't keep a good man down thanks to a Save Game Restore function.
* You are no James Bond and only equip yourself with a rope as you set off on your quest.
* Overcome the most devious obstacles.
* Using Professor Higgins' notes you explore the Chambers in the Temple of Bhindiwara.
* How fast can you complete your quest and return with the Ring of Power?... your time is revealed at the end.
* The fastest time by May 12th (with a screen shot of proof) will be awarded the certificate of 'Legendary artifact hunter' signed by Reef Rivers himself.
Please leave feedback...

Credits

2249.name: Get Squirty! (UPDATED)
2249.description:
Escape your mundane existence and travel to exotic lands in search of your friends party in this musical extravaganza. Now with just one easy click!

Credits

2247.name: Sleeping Beauty
2247.description:
To interact in a satisfactory way, in the absence of inspiration, impossible: a girlfriend who won't wake up, a place that can't be found, characters who know(?) but don't tell, the distant childhood one can't connect with.
A small playground, 4 screens wide. In all 20 challenges to choose from, of which 10 are conversations with NPCs, and of these, any 5, completed, defining the story line. One ending (with different flavors). The menu, a list of keys, brought by a right-click.
enjoy
PS. The archived folder is 580(610)Mb wide.
--- Latest Version ---
The game was updated on Apr, 6 (2018). Please see Update.log for changes.
Important: The intro conversation is
[…]
