977.description:
Little Kate is kidnapped by the evil alien! Help little Mike resque her in this little weird game.
NB: Download link actually leads to the game's homepage (due to upload problems I had to divide the archive into 7 parts)
Upd: Download mirror provided by Dualnames.

Credits

976.name: Me Go 2008!
976.description:
Most likely one of the last games to be released in 2007, the third and currently latest installement in the progressing Me Go Store series... bah, screw that, Evilguy has a poor plan again and you have to stop him! Same background music as Me Go Store II, but less annoying and painful.
As crazy says: "Wow. Epic game. I love the pixel-shaded, bump-mapped, high-definition graphics, the sweeping symphonic soundtrack, and of course, the cutting-edge, ultra-intuitive gameplay." ;)

Credits

975.name: Christmas Quest 3: Santa's Little Help Desk
975.description:
The third installment of the Adventure Gamers staff's yearly Christmas gift-games.

Credits

974.name: A Christmas Blunder
974.description:
Melvin Fartknocker, esteemed nerd, is on a holiday. He has decided to go visit Santa to ask for the Christmas gift of his dreams...only, things unravel in ways he couldn't imagine.

Credits

973.name: Jacob: VA's Cut
973.description:
While on a trip to introduce her spouse to the parents, April smith wakes up in a peculiar looking hotel room with not much memory of what recently happened, she calls out to her boyfriend Jacob, silence comfirms that she is indeed alone...but is she?
NOTE: The mirror now directs to the same game with a faster walking April.
Note: this game could be considered a sequel to the original MAGS game 'Jacob' by ThatOneChick87

Credits

972.name: Quest for Yeti
972.description:
Sir Thaddeus Franzibold Cromwell III has begun his perilous search for the Legendary Snow Creature known as Yeti. Will he finally discover the elusive beast, or will he fail miserably?
(12/31/07: This is now version 2.0, with improvements over the original. Includes ReadMe and Walkthrough.)

Credits

971.name: Alan Saves Christmas
971.description:
When the Ministry of Holidays receive a letter from Santa Claus cancelling his toy delivery for Christmas, they send an accountant named Alan to find out what is going on...
Winner of the MAGS December 2007 competition
You can also download a 2.6 MB version of the game off the main download site. This is the same as the larger game, but without music.

Credits

970.name: Princess Marian XI: Light re-leaf
970.description:
Another compelling drama in the world-renowned Princess Marian series. A fresh young pair of artists have joined the team and brought a whole new level of graphic quality.

Credits

969.name: Unbound
969.description:
The second in a series of three short games, based on the backstory of a planned full-length game..."Wound".
03/04/09: The main download link is back up.
29/03/09: The main download link is currently unavailable. Please use the mirror provided below. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Note: The download is a self-extracting 7zip archive, hence the *.exe. It is NOT an installer. :)

Credits

968.name: The Agency: Part one The Conspiracy
968.description:
In John Kirstein's life everything was normal.  Until an urgent call came from his office about a new building, He was sent there to see what was up but somethings are better left alone. (For screenshots go to in production on the forums) UrGent!!  I apologize but as a password you must type PlAYER to download i am sorry for the inconvience.

Credits

967.name: Barn Runner 2: Wreck The Halls
967.description:
The laziest detective of a retro-futuristic world of tomorrow's apocalypse returns for more holiday hijinks!
When a mysterious figure from his past returns to make his life an unbearable hell of being well liked by his co-workers and facing possible promotions, Prick Peckard, Barn Runner, must seek out the man he once declared legally dead and make him even more deader!
Barn Runner Xmas 2: Wreck The Halls is a short game that will let you (as Detective Prick Peckard, head of the Robot Crimes Division) travel into the  festive (yet non-existent) winter wonderland of the Blue Grass Containment Zone to follow a mysterious signal that may or may not have been set by the very man, ten years missing now, whose
[…]
job you now hold, in an overly elaborate and wildly implausible scheme to trap you in a vile plot so evil that even a run-on sentence like this cannot hope to describe it!
CLICK to download the game and experience the Christmas Spirit in a way you never have before (or will ever want to again)!

Credits

966.name: Quiero Morir (I want to die)
966.description:
You are Max-V2000, a sad robot. This words sound very strange but Max is a special robot. He's a Dr. Polasnk's creation.  Dr. Polansk is a very prestigious scientific. He creates a model of robot with feelings called V2000. But something goes bad when Max-V2000 start to feel only pain. He's a desperate robot and he wants to die. He wants to kill his human soul and he needs to meet the Dr.Polansk. He wants to say to Dr.Polansk his suffering and he travels to Sunset Planet where he lives.
Try to find Dr.Polansk and help to Max-V2000 in his life.
THE GAME IS IN ENGLISH AND SPANISH
----
New Version: bugs fixed and new soundtrack (Mp3)

Credits

965.name: The Seven Doors
965.description:
You find yourself in a long hallway with seven doors.  Your Quest is to find out what your quest is by solving the puzzles behind the doors and whether you will solve them peacefully or otherwise.  There are multiple solutions for many of the tasks.

Credits

964.name: Lone Case 2: Scars
964.description:
After the demise of the planet because of the nuclear blast, what was once pure is now dirty what was alive is now dead , what was blur is now clear , what was courage is now fear.
Dave Dell now , four years later after what happened on Lone Case: Locomotive Breath, finds himself in a camp , where a group of survivors have gathered in an effort to survive. The planet has become a wasteland, people believe that all this was plan of god, and since water has become so rare , there are wars to control it.
7 hours, have been given to Dave to give away his water supplies to a local criminal mind called Van McCoy. The only hope of the team of survivors is to travel to Palm Springs where rumour has it that it's the last hu
[…]
man paradise. Will Dave find some way out of this situation?
Author's Notes:
Apart from the little weird ending this one is of my favorite games.

Credits

963.name: Principles of Evil II
963.description:
Arriving on the other side of the planet, Rogi is drowned by darkness.  Will she find her idol, Babayaga?  Or will she get side-tracked in this strange land, full of fungus, lust and narcotics?

Credits

962.name: World of Warcraft - The IMBA Quest
962.description:
Go on an epic quest to become the most IMBA character ever in a MMOG.

Credits

961.name: Me Go Cannibal Jungle
961.description:
Me Go Cannibal Jungle is a game loosely based on a Cannibal Holocaust movie.
It features:
- Most heroes from the original cast
- Weird dates
- Thanksgiving apocalypse
- Hidden music track and bonus level
By FSi & Akatosh. Hidden track by Carcass.

Credits

960.name: Anti-heroes
960.description:
Winner of the MAGS competition for November 2007.
A parody of the TV show "Heroes".
Join Ethan Patchouli and the other Anti-heroes in his quest to save... well, play the game and you'll find out.

Credits

959.name: Quimby Quest
959.description:
The guitarist for the unpopular rock band, Vote Quimby, has been fired and no one but you would be so stupid as to actually jump through hoops to get the job.
For the record, I finished this game in 2006, but I couldn't ever get it to upload, so I thought I would post it for those of you who never played it. I hope everyone likes it.
By the by, the interface is supposed to be pretty easy, so anyone with ANY experience with old school adventure games can skip the intro sequence. Everything you need to know is included in a pdf file that comes in the zip.

Credits

958.name: Ahmet's AGS Fight Game Remix
958.description:
An enhanced version of Gord10's fighting game that appeared in Barbarian's The Great Stroke-Off
it includes better graphics and it has music added
while some of the bugs from the original stayed but I'd say its a pretty good remake

Credits

956.name: Feuersturm
956.description:
After a 60 years long sleep our hero awakes and notices that the world has changed. The cause has been a mysterious firestorm 6 decades ago. This is an adventure based on a nightmare of the author.

Credits

954.name: Smile or Die Nonplayable Demo
954.description:
I haven't been working on this game in a long time, I started a year ago but haven't worked on it for a year ><;; This is a Reality-on-the-Norm (RON) demo staring Davy Jones. This shows 4 possible ways Davy could have died, but that's all that is included in the demo. It is a bit glitchy but if you find RON games enjoyable you may like this Demo.

Credits

947.name: Me Go Store II - Me Go Away!
947.description:
Yeah...
Normal background tune by a guy who died in 1917 (I think).

Credits

945.name: OpenQuest
945.description:
Want to make a game in AGS? Don't know how to get from the tutorial to a real game? If so, OpenQuest may be for you.
This short demo game is designed to be studied by newcomers looking for ways to construct a non-trivial game in AGS. The original project files are available as well as the finished game itself (https://www.box.com/shared/o6l46lnho1) and can be loaded into version 2.72 of AGS. See the readme.txt file for more information.

Credits

942.name: Jacob
942.description:
Lately, Jacob has been having terrible nightmares. Nightmares that wake him up in cold sweats. Lucky for him, they are only dreams. And when he awakes, everything is back to normal. Atleast
until he and his girlfriend, April, take a long trip. Then, his nightmares start to shift into reality, and Jacob must figure out what is going on before its too late.
This is my first game. Its a short game for Halloween & MAGS: Planes, Trains and Automobiles.

Credits

940.name: Washed Ashore Deluxe
940.description:
You play as the german Zeppelin commander Wilhelm von Hadenberg, and... damn, see for yourself, the game is too short to give away that much information. Now with 500% more cliches about Imperial Germany than the next leading brand.
You might have already seen some instance of this game (like the original mAGS version, which is still floating about, or the original deluxe version, which has been deleted and purged). In that case, you might still want to give this a try since some additional bits of content have been added, like music (by Scott Joplin), sound effects (by myself) and better character sprites (also by myself).

Credits

939.name: Osher Bli Gvulot - Boundless Osher
939.description:
Osher Bli Gvulot ("Boundless Osher") is the first full-length Israeli adventure game created with AGS.  It contains 10 hours of gameplay with 2 hours of original music and voice  speech.
The game's hero is Osher, a 30-yo Israeli guy trying to get elected as Israel's next prime minister.
Note that the game is in HEBREW only at the moment.

Credits

938.name: The 24 Hour Game
938.description:
An ultra-short tech-demo esque game made to use as a promotional tool for York University Adventure Game Soc (The goal of which is to produce a "proper" game 3 times a year). It's filled with in-jokes and the gameplay is very simple, but I was pleased with the result I got .

Credits

937.name: My 40 bullets (v1.1)
937.description:
A little action/war game.
*12 more and more challenging levels.
*4 different kind of enemies.
*5 different weapons.
*A story witch you wont really need.
*These days very popular "Im against USA" atmosphere.

Credits

935.name: Chinese Checkers
935.description:
Based on a traditional board game,
Chinese Checkers or Stern-Halma is a simple, fun, and easy to play.
A perfect game to spend your free time with your family and friends.
You can even play against computer.
Nominated in the Best Non-Adventure Game Created with AGS category in the AGS Awards 2007
Features:
Supports up to 3 players (offline)
Play against computer
Keyboard controls supported
Tutorial included

Credits

934.name: Pimpin on Parakuss
934.description:
This game starts out a little cheesy, but gets better as you progress thru it. I have to admit the artwork is not that good. " I am no artist, but i love ags games. So i decided to make one. Well, here it is!! Pimpin on Parakuss...
The basic plot: try to locate the item of great importance. your adventure will take you to many places, some of which are actual places. but with alternate names to make the game more interesting.
HAVE FUN!!!  its just a game....
Solution-txt. can be found in the program folder.

Credits

933.name: Revelation
933.description:
Entry for MAGS-contest 09/2007
'Revelation' is a stealth/action jump'n'run game. It also allows you to create your own levels easily!

Credits

932.name: Trance-Pacific
932.description:
* Winner of the MAGS favourite of the year ("Maggies") 2007
* Winner of the MAGS competition for September 2007
* Nominated in the Best Short Game category in the AGS Awards of 2007
Vince is a stage hypnotist, and is close friends with Eve, a magician, and Nick, her assistant. They have just completed a long season and are now going on a long cruise to relax.
They soon discover something underhand is going on aboard ship. It's not just the ocean that smells fishy, and the cruise is going to be anything but relaxing...
(Ce jeu inclut une traduction franÃ§aise. Cliquez sur le lien "Visit website" ci-dessous ou "Website:" ci-dessus et lisez les instructions pour la version franÃ§aise
[…]
.)
(Questo gioco include una traduzione italiana. Clicca sul link "Visit website" sotto o "Website:" sopra e leggi le istruzioni per la versione italiana.)

Credits

931.name: I.S.O.S.
931.description:
My name is Marcus Frederick. Im one of the few people still living on the Earth, which now serves as an emergency station for our glorious spaceships. Last night one of them was about to approach us by a hyperspace jump. Well it did... at least what has remained of it... It is my duty to find out what happened. And the I.S.O.S. (internal security operating system) is my only source of informations.

Credits

930.name: Root of all Evil
930.description:
A Reality-on-the-Norm game.
Today is Mika's birthday, and of course this is an excellent reason to throw a party. In a town like this, inviting all your friends is easy. There is just one thing missing...
Money. Parties can be expensive, and Mika is remarkably short on money. Still, it should be possible for an enterprising photographer to make some quick cash...
Featuring pirates, private eyes, archaeologists (well, not really), a fully functional camera, and of course a crazy homeless weirdo.

Credits

929.name: Supernatural: The Terror Trio Demo
929.description:
(ignore the other one) Play as Sam Winchester in this Unofficial Supernatural game based on the CW Network Tv Show of the Same name. this demo was made using still photography so it's very -ahem- abstract. since it is only still photography don't be expecting over the top animation because you won't get it!

Credits

928.name: Supernatural: The Terror Trio
928.description:
Play as Sam Winchester in this Unofficial Supernatural game based on the CW Network Tv Show of the Same name

Credits

927.name: Cayanne Pepper
927.description:
Struggling freelance writer Cayanne Pepper has nothing better to do so she tries to help an old acquaintance who happens to be wanted for murder.
Cayanne Pepper is set in a post-nuclear-war not-too-distant future/alternate present. It's intended as a "part one" kind of game.

Credits

926.name: Plan 10 from MY PANTS!
926.description:
Get Plan10 today!
Two levels of perilous doom, doomy perils, awful plot, story and music (not to mention the photo-quality backgrounds from hell and mindsucking sprites), mega-boss, saving the earth and grrls in the end - what else simple adventurer like me and you could desire? Common sence? Come on, that's so 1920s.
This EXTENDED VERSION features (as compared with DEMO version):
* More cutscenes and story than ever
* One bonus level
* Improved physical engine
Get it now OR ELSE!

Credits

925.name: Amoto's Puf
925.description:
A remake of a game originally released for the ZX Spectrum in 1988.
Use the cursor keys to collect all of the tokens in the maze whilst avoiding the computers motor scooter. The spacebar allows you to move at double speed and is also used to select menu options.

Credits

922.name: Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator Case 6 - Scourge of the Sea People
922.description:
Following Alice's near-fatal poisoning in Japan, the paranormal investigating trio decides a vacation is in order. Traveling to Greece, they find themselves in the remote fishing village  of Agia Anna. However, they soon learn that even while on vacation their work is never done. It seems that ancient creatures of legend known as the Sea People have been emerging from the ocean at night and dragging villagers down to the depths to eat them.
Ben, Simon, and Alice must investigate and stop the SCOURGE OF THE SEA PEOPLE!

Credits

921.name: G. P.'s Lost Adventure
921.description:
G P's Lost Adventure is about a Game Peice (G P) that is swept away from his game and turns up on a desert island. He then has to find his way home and avoid the obstacles that await for him!

Credits

920.name: Time-Space Escape
920.description:
Somehow, you got lost in the time-space continuom.
Somehow, you must escape.
hmm... good thing your suit supports walkotron TSC, or you'd be dead by now. So... no one here... someone must've been here before, because there's this plank here... *sigh* let's just hope you can get out of this...

Credits

919.name: Raven Chapter 1
919.description:
Raven is a fantasy adventure game about a Raven who is given human intelligence by the ogeress Eurybia so he can be her spy. He soon realizes that Eurybia is hatching an evil scheme to take over the Land of Hellenas!

Credits

918.name: rough diamond demo (working link)
918.description:
an idea i had which consequently spanned out into this demo. hope you enjoy it ... it's about kyle who wants to be a rock star. kyle wants to be in a band named rough diamond! why, because diamond is the hardest rock known to man. (but this is not mentioned in the story as of yet.) so check it out, if you like ti i'll finish if not... i'll probably still finish it... that is if i finish it!

Credits

916.name: The Adventures Of Turquoise Mcdonald
916.description:
A man, hit by a car, suddenly finds himself in a strange world. He must use everything he can find in order to escape and get home...

Credits

915.name: Washed Ashore
915.description:
You play as the german Zeppelin commander Wilhelm von Hadenberg, and... well, play for yourself! The game's not very long, so I can't give you much of a description, sorry.
Winner of the mAGS competition of August '07, topic: "Desert Island".

Credits

914.name: HELP! the game
914.description:
Help! the game is an interactive fiction/survival game about man stranded on a desert island. At first, he must find some way to survive, and eventually escape the island.
Features include:
* text-based interface - like in any Interactive Fiction next door
* character statistics to look after - four parameters (Hunger, Thirst, Fatigue and Sanity) on which your life depends
* vast island with various terrain - poke finger on another AGS game with almost 150 rooms!
* a story - don't you think that this game is only about survival? (unavailable in demo) Plot involves alien machinery, engineering puzzles, and, human-sized hamsterballs!
* ROBOT DOG - doesn't everybody love 'em?

Credits

913.name: Odot Tamat On
913.description:
This game was created for MAGS competition 2007-04.
In this short game you play as a private eye who needs to save the world from evil. How very unexpected.
Townfolk are starting to act strange and the evil scientist is behind it again. Private eye Nalle Karhu has to step up and stop this madness.

Credits

912.name: STRANDED
912.description:
This was made for the August 2007 MAGS Competition.  You have to solve puzzles involving a seagull, a talking head, a bunch of talking heads, finding food and water, a shark and building a raft.

Credits

911.name: Mittens Mystery Extravaganza
911.description:
In search of the elusive blue cup.

Credits

910.name: Who Killed Who?
910.description:
You are an ordinary fellow named Twatty McTwatTwat. You're on a walk, and you hear gunshots. Solve the mystery, track down the villain, and save the day.
Note: This game is short, and has some swearing in it. I'm not going to warn kiddies not to download it, just be aware.

Credits

909.name: The Great Casserole Caper
909.description:
It's Easter again... ugh!!!
Three days before Rigatoni and Edna McCracken were to hold their annual Easter dinner, Edna received a mysterious package in the mail.  Inside was a sadistic device fouler than anyone alive could comprehend: The Casserole-O-Matic.
Now, it's up to their nephew, Jeffrey McCracken, to shut the machine down for good, but can he survive a visit to his aunt and uncle's house without dying a grisly death at the hands of his own demented family?
Jeffrey's epic quest through his Aunt Edna and Uncle Rigatoni's house is fraught with perils, including the expansive McCracken family - a massively obese uncle with an IQ of 1
[…]
6, a younger cousin who's so sickeningly sweet it just might kill you, and a grandfather who's under the impression that he could one day become the world's next rap idol - a freaky array of tools n' toys, and a mass of testosterone fueled uncles hell-bent on making sure that Christmas won't be coming for a long, long time! Can you survive this zany adventure?

Credits

908.name: Quest Fighter II
908.description:
Get rrready to rrrumble... again! Not content with Sierra taking the limelight, the LucasArts heroes join the fray!
In the style of Celebrity Deathmatch, the heroes of many adventure games fight a bloody battle for supremacy! Pit Devon's fireballs vs. Bobbin's swan morph! Use Guybrush's pirate voodoo against Sonny's assault gun! And have Larry smash them all with a taxi cab.
Includes a mysterious endgame boss, lots of blood, and fatalities!

Credits

907.name: FSi's Ache Quest
907.description:
Ache Quest is a thrilling story of a boy without name but with Tourette's.
His life was such a hell that when he read about retired wizard Grumpygad hiding from public in the middle of nowhere, in a castle surrounded by crocodile ditch, gargoyles and giant fun fair.
Game was made for MAGS July '07: Fun Fair.

Credits

906.name: Charlie Foxtrot & The Galaxy of Tomorrow
906.description:
A rebel clone meets a zany galaxy in this high-intensity sci-fi parody.  Hundreds of animations, spectacular humour, full sound-track and a bunny's lair worth of easter eggs make this game a must play!
You play Charlie Foxtrot, a clone who rebels against conformity.  Undertaking an intergalactic quest so that he can assert his autonomy, Charlie travels to strange planets inhabited by  dozens of parodied sci-fi characters.  The humour is somewhere between Space Quest and Red Dwarf, but the adventure is beyond comparison.  Download now!

Credits

904.name: SAW 2
904.description:
Alliance has improved the translation. The fix is here:
http://new.bigbluecup.com/yabb/index.php?topic=31843.0
* A new resolution: 800*600
* More stages that in the previous game. 6 news stages
* Argument different of the movie.
* More than 30 animations.
* Videos in 3D
* To be able to see Jigsaw in 3D
* Texts in Spanish, English and French.
* Voices in Spanish with subtitles in English.
* More frequent dialogues.
* New cruxes and riddles.
* Surprising end.
PLOT: The Saw adventure series don't directly follow the plot of the Saw movies. They're loosely based, with different characters, puzzles, and traps. In the first game, we met two
[…]
men trapped in a bathroom. In the second one, we meet two completely different people, locked up and tried for the way they lived their lives.
You play as one of the men, Jason. The other man in the room, Zepp, is chained down, and unable to move much. Under normal circumstances, you could have just left him. However, there is a huge armored door blocking the exit. It is impenetrable, as if the forces of Hell itself were holding it shut. The only way to open the door is to use the hand of your cellmate. But first you must free him from the mass of chains. How will you escape? Will you be one to live, or be one of the ones that condemned themselves? This is YOUR choice, this is YOUR life. Just remember: things are never what they seem...

Credits

903.name: Lone Case: Locomotive Breath
903.description:
Lone Case: Locomotive Breath
STORY:
Dave Dell, once a glamorous detective, is now a dull and bland vision of himself, drinking himself out of his misery in The Swigging Bushman every night. With no friends, he travels to work every day with a scowl on his face and dark bags under his eyes.
Years ago, he put a man named O'Riley in jail. But this man has escaped. And this time he has a nuclear device on a train. Will he be stopped?
Or will the train reach it's location?
Game Features:
1)Runaway 2 like Control Method.
2)Notebook (Discworld Noir).
Official Walkthrough
-------------------------
http://new.bigbluecup.com/yabb/index.php?topic=32113.0
[…]
/>
Author's Notes:
If you can cope with the bad scripted interface you might actually enjoy it.

Credits

900.name: The Crackwell Legacy
900.description:
What up, bitches!
Blowie the Ghost here, to correct an injustice!  That jive turkey Dave Gilbert stole my idea and twisted it around to make his game about that Blackwell bitch!
But the truth is, she wasn't named Blackwell, she was called CRACKWELL!
Here is the true story, and you don't even gotta pay for it!

Credits

899.name: Earl Mansin: The Breakout
899.description:
Help Earl Mansin escape from death row in this fully voiced graphic adventure.
For more information, check out earlmansin.com
Enjoy!
7/15/2007 - Version 1.1 released! Download it now and let 1.0 be die like the foul dog it is.

Credits

898.name: Bernard's Room
898.description:
Based on Maniac Mansion Mania, this is a short game featuring Bernard Bernoulli.
His family locked him upstairs in his room, and while Bernard struggles to get out, he's confronted with a junkie, a bunch of waffles and his own forgetfulness.

Credits

897.name: Purgatorio
897.description:
The game follows Frank O'Shea, A soldier on a peacekeeping mission. He is shot in the line of duty and blacks out. He awakens to find himself wounded and in a strange, but somehow familiar town. You must act as Franks guide as he tries to remember what has brought him here. Welcome to Purgatorioâ€¦

Credits

896.name: Of birds and bees
896.description:
A short game featuring multiple endings. Help a bird find his bee, but can you do it within three minutes?
Actually, each character can get a few different endings, ranging from very bad to very good. You could see them as 2+3+3=8 endings, but I'd sell it as 2*3*3=18 endings. Every puzzle has multiple solutions, which leads to the slightly different endings. Anyway, if you've got the patience you can get them all in three playthroughs. I think it's totally worth it, but I might be biased. They're more like different character epilogues if you want to nitpick. Don't worry about the timer, it just leads to a different ending.

Credits

895.name: Fulkramick's Dreamting Interactive
895.description:
This game was produced to compliment the record and subsequent films by fulkramick   called, "Dreamting". The best effect of the game comes after listening to the music and watching the videos in the release first, to then hear and see them reinterpreted in a simple and abstract adventure game.
20 short films
85 original sound effects & original music
2 characters
Over 20 rooms B&W & Color
Several Puzzles
Fun with sound!
----------------------------------------------------------
STORY
During last night's dream, your new song was stolen. You awake in front of the strange house you'd dreamt of, and the tapes are inside. Your mission is to weave your way through your music and vid
[…]
eos to recompile the song and defeat the being who took it.
-------------------------------------------------------
Again friends, this is in -no- way a difficult game,  it's meant to enhance the musical and cinematic endeavor of fulkramick's 'dreamting' record,  released in the summer of 2007.
You can see all of the videos (plus video game trailer) and hear most of the music at: http://www.myspace.com/stainable
Just a suggestion, not a law.
Thanks for checking out my first game!

Credits

894.name: Trevor Daison in outer space - Chapter one
894.description:
After a long sleep Trevor Daison needs your help to escape from a space station.
Let the real adventure begin . . .

Credits

893.name: William in the USA
893.description:
The game starts in the town of Laurel Springs, NJ, where you play as me in that town and make your first friend. The object is to talk to that friend and pick up some object on the journey. It starts in a house and will expand to a place in Peru. But this is a demo. P.S. The download link is fixed.

Credits

892.name: La Croix Pan
892.description:
June 7th, 1944
A lone American sniper enters the small town of La Croix Pan with the task of defending it by himself. He must face off a group of enemy soldiers, or die trying.

Credits

891.name: CSI Hunt 1
891.description:
A game with no characters, no dialog, no objects and no inventory! This first in a series of games where you can play through the character of CSI Hunt of the Las Vegas Police Department.
You play by going through the crime scene and collecting all the evidence, a score at the end will show you how many you found.
This episode has two styles, one where evidence hotspots are activated when the player clicks on a previous hotspot; the other is active hotspots that are somewhat hard to spot. If you prefer one of these styles to the other, please let me know.

Credits

890.name: Roast Mother Goose
890.description:
Big Red needs to find some food for Granny.
This was a MAGS entry but it didn't win.
It's still great fun to play.
Come play with Big Red.

Credits

889.name: Secrets of Sultan Kanuni 2
889.description:
The story goes on. Ali had captured the golden shoes and destroyed agents' headquarter in Turkey in first game. This time, enemy is more powerful and they will do anything to stop Ali. A surprise ! friend is going to help Ali with his adventure. This time is more exciting, more entertaining.
Official walkthrough : sosk2.coolbluegames.com/walkthrough.htm

Credits

888.name: Owl's Quest: Every Owl has it's Day
888.description:
A King's Quest V Parody.
Help Cedric find his way to the land of the green isles to attend Alexander's and Rosella's Birthday Party. Now has previous bug's fixed.

Credits

887.name: Beyond the horizon ALPHA
887.description:
Join two police detectives in their quest for truth and justice!
You are Spencer Kinley, a somewhat aged policeman, who has benn called to an old warehouse, where drug dealing is supposed to happen.
As always, he's accompanied by his young partner Jake McKormik.
This game has english and german language support, nice background music und 6 different endings!
The way you take your decisions on different problems in the game decides what ending you'll get.
Also featuring:
-Cthulhu
-a genuinely desperate nurse
-black humour
<
[…]
br />
Note: This game is alpha and urgently needs a graphical makeover. So if you want to help out, just contact me!
Make sure to setup the game to 640x480

Credits

886.name: Who Sent Me To Oblivion
886.description:
Shimi is Damon's best friend. Both are former rebels and current starship captains, find themselves on Earth after retirement, and are being forced to deal with their past which still haunts them.
In this part which is described by a frame story, Shimi tells about the first days of Damon on Earth in a mysterious vessel.
[only English Version included]

Credits

884.name: Comrade Citizen Part 1
884.description:
This is an introduction, and a first part to the cyberpunk soviet series which will be known as Comrade Citizen. It is very short, and there isn't much in the area of "human interaction", so to speak. No music yet.

Credits

883.name: David Letterman - the Video Game
883.description:
Now you can play Will It Float at home, browse top ten lists, and even throw stuff at the window!

Credits

882.name: After a Shadow
882.description:
Keith Night woke up in a gutter. Having no idea what he was doing there, he had to trace his steps from last night and find out what he was after. But Keith had no idea of the things to come...

Credits

881.name: 4 of Clubs
881.description:
A Game of Cards / An interactive murder during the WWII.

Credits

880.name: Tropic of Capricorn
880.description:
The admiral has sent a diplomate to solve the problems on one of his ships. The rest of the fleet has sailed, so why is this ship lingering?

Credits

879.name: Me Go Store!
879.description:
This is a mixture of a stylistic experiment, a bad joke game and a "I couldn't finish the real thing in time" mags entry. It's yet to decide whether it'll go in Joke Games or mags games.
And please, don't hit me.
Also, new version.

Credits

878.name: Red Dwarf Demo
878.description:
Does this actually need any introducing?
Warning: you must see at least the first episode of Red Dwarf - "The End" - to understand the plot.
Starring: Lister, Holly, and Rimmer (briefly).
Please, comment and vote, I'd really like opinions on this.

Credits

877.name: Dr. Lutz and the Time Travel Machine
877.description:
Are you ready to find out what happened to the dinosaurs and their extinction?
Then join Dr. Abraham Lutz in his attempt to reach that long passed Jurassic Age using one of his inventions:The time travel machine.
Our Doctor is desperately trying to prove his own theories about why the big reptiles vanished from Earth 65 million years ago and at the same time, make a fool of one of his paleontologists colleagues. And the only way to do that is going to the Jurassic and checking by himself.
Of course, getting there wont be that easy as he thought. Honouring the lasting tradition of adventure games, our old Doctor is going to need a lot of help to bring his journe
[…]
y to a good end.
The story will take place in different spaces and times and will grab a laugh from you here and then (well, that is what I hope) given that the Doctor has a penchant for a cynical humour.

Credits

874.name: Alien Attack
874.description:
An April MAGS entry, help 'Ginnie' defeat the evil Plutonians!
Dedicated to David Wells.

Credits

873.name: Test Rat Escape
873.description:
The Test Rat of the Evil scientist must escape his clutches before tomorrow.

Credits

872.name: Lif and the Treasure of the Tanones
872.description:
Lif the lizard has lived by himself in the Barren Desert of the West peacefully for a long time until he starts having trouble with money. He is forced to find some way to get 5,000 dollars by tomorrow. When he hears of the Treasure of the Tanones, he starts off on his adventure to find it.

Credits

871.name: Scared Stiff
871.description:
This is a short little horror/adventure game.  James finds himself trapped in a haunted castle and has to battle ghosts, skeletons, zombies, spiders and the lovely ghost, Jessica.

Credits

869.name: Paul Quest Gold Edition
869.description:
Help Paul to find the present for his girlfriend on their anniversary and maybe find some surprises. 2 possible finals and a lot of fun. English & Spanish version available.
Thanks to renataqb for the english translation (www.e-rqb.com) and to all the people who help us in the forums. We hope you enjoy this game.

Credits

868.name: Text Parser Game
868.description:
A bit of rushed game for MAGS March'07.
Long ago the grass was greener, the sky was brighter and the games were ruled by text parsers. These days have gone forever... Or are they?
Help Larry Wilco in his epic quest for the Holy Text Parser (and report bugs if necessary) on Earth, Mars and Tibet! Save his family from enslavement. Collect apples. Discuss things. Unveil conspiracies. Guess the verbs. All in one tiny game.
Note: Contains some BLOOM and LENS FLARE.
Note 2: No animations at all, so no epilepsy warnings. Safe as doughnut.
Note 3: Oh, yes, some strong language there. Just for you to know

Credits

867.name: Geometric Shapes 1 - Circleboy
867.description:
Once the world was square, and then the march '07 MAGS came, so I made it more circly. Something is missing, and circleboy, who is actually a ball but less 3d, is there to save the day! Or is he?
With an unique *cough* interface featering only the left mouse button.

Credits

865.name: Hotel Hell
865.description:
Hotel Hell is about a young adult named Adrien Russell who is on the run from the law. He has been accused of committing a terrible crime, but he does not remember doing such a thing. He has fled Perth and is on his way to Melbourne for a fresh start. He stays at a hotel in a small city named Archeron and little does he know what awaits him.
The next morning he finds that he is being held hostage in the hotel by an invisible intelligence. Whatever has him there wants revenge. And it will do anything to get it.
But he is not the only victim. There are others in this hotel and as the numbers drop, and the suspicion grows- this hotel becomes a very dangerous place. Little does Adrien know, his past holds a deadly secret.
[…]
..
This was my first attempt to make a game with AGS. It was abandoned, and only reached the 'demo' stage, but is still a fully playable game.
A walkthrough is available at http://infernal-softworks.wetpaint.com/page/Walkthroughs

Credits

864.name: Sleight of Hand - Demo
864.description:
Simon Hand is an accomplished performance magician. He can do all the card tricks, hat tricks, box tricks, and escapes necessary to stun his audience at every show. But when a mysterious woman shows up backstage after one of Simon's shows and asks for his help, Simon finds himself face to face with people who believe in magic in a very different--and far more deadly--way. He is soon caught up in a kidnapping case and a hundred-year-old feud between two magical cults, both desperate and willing to kill for an artifact that each believes Simon already has in his possession. With very few allies and plenty of enemies, Simon must find a way to diffuse the conflict before it ends with his own early demise.

Credits

863.name: Gesundheit! Demo Version
863.description:
An action-puzzle game in which you help an allergic pig save a city from snot-eating monsters using a clever combination of brains and boogers.
While keeping out of sight, you must lure your enemies through each single-screen level with your delicious nasal discharges. Objects scattered around town provide your pig with different ways of solving each puzzle. The demo contains twelve levels and a tutorial to get you started.
UPDATE (April 4, 2007)
The new version (1.1) has an option for keyboard movement, and there's also a targeting crosshair to take a bit of the frustration out of aiming.

Credits

861.name: Tempus Fugit
861.description:
Your only job is to make a bottle of wine from scratch but you have to travel back and forth in time to do it.

Credits

859.name: Fynewrylst Memories: The Secret of the Golden River
859.description:
Enter the Land of Fynewrylst where magic are real. The magical Golden River has run dry and the land is dying. You have to stop it, save the lands, and reveal the secret of the Golden River..

Credits

858.name: Banana Man - the Video Game
858.description:
You are Andre Andre, a high school nutrition teacher who preaches the importance of potassium while dressed accordingly.
Your first mission is to change into Banana Man and get to the gymnasium to give a speech, but you will be interrupted by your nemesis, Gorilla Guy.  Can you defeat Gorilla Guy and find out who he is?
EDIT: In response to the comments, I thought the demo section was for unifinished games which is why i put it in medium length.  I believe the game is medium length for the full version, and the demo is about ten minutes.

Credits

857.name: PMUVCHVT
857.description:
I did it. I made a working eleven-roomer in 7 hours. Psheeew.
Entry for the MAGS competition February 2007.
This time, you're the villain.
Mirror actually is the Music.vox file - 12 MB, so beware!

Credits

856.name: FSi's CoMATtCEHoSVD
856.description:
FSi's Collection of Most Awful Things that Could Ever Happen on St.Valentine's Day.
You must deliver a Valentine's Day present to your girlfriend. To do that, you just need to cross the street. If only THAT was easy...
Mirror is direct download. kthxbai.

Credits

855.name: Outbreak
855.description:
On December the 24th 2004, the Center for Disease Control and Virological studies, Bolivia was attacked by unknown terrorists, while they were studying the astronomical samples brought by Dr. Roger Quintino.
As Mike Harden wakes up in the aftermath of tha attack, he realizes that all is not what it seems.. An explosive horrific plot is underway, and he is unfortunately a part of it.
Can he solve the mystery, save Dr. Crawford Keen and escape ? Or will he be a sacrifice in this terrible conspiracy ?
Please read HINTS.TXT after downloading

Credits

853.name: Knight Quest for the Golden Ring
853.description:
Short little Adventure game in a somewhat "fantasy" setting with a dash of humor throughout.
You play the role of "Sir Krud", a young Knight who is summoned by King Bob to go on a Quest to retrieve a lost Golden Ring.  Succeed in your Quest, and the King will reward you.  Fail, and you may get turned into a Bar-B-Q crisp.

Credits

852.name: Alpha - X TECH DEMO
852.description:
A demo for the upcoming futuristic mystery, Alpha - X. Includes:
--First person perspective
--Demonstration of art, music, sound FX and GUI
--Usable Alpha - X network terminal. Go to the operations center and use the terminal to learn more about Neo York, or type in the name of one of the characters you meet to learn more about them.
--A demonstration of your DRIFTER's deep scan function. Select the red crosshairs from your GUI and scan away.
--A demonstration of the game's shooting scenes employing the shooting gallery in the operations center. Go there and use the shooting gallery on the back wall. When you are finished, your DRIFTER will assess your performance.
Controls: Right click to s
[…]
witch between movement, interaction (which also doubles as talking and taking), and investigation. Once you get your DRIFTER, click on his image in the bottom right corner for more options. In the shooting gallery, SPACE BAR arms and holsters your gun, and left click fires.

Credits

849.name: The Death of Luke Simpson
849.description:
It was Luke Simpson's birthday. Then, the impossible happened. He died. This is the solemn record of this sad event.

Credits

847.name: Welcome to Dark Lake - DEMO
847.description:
Welcome to Dark Lake
- A psychological mystery adventure game -
By Rob "Milo87" Westbrook
After the suspicious death of our mother, me, Ethan Scott, and my sister Rachel, launched seperate investigations into the cause of our mother's demise.
Disappointed by constant dead ends, I eventually stopped looking for answers, whilst my sister, angered by my giving-up, continued to search for answers.
That was one year ago.
Since then, I've started looking for resolutions to other people's problems with my own PI agency. That is, until my sister turned up with news of a mysterious trip our mother made two weeks before she died. A trip to
[…]
the small town of Dark Lake.
Despite this new revelation, I refused to get caught up in it again, fearing further disappointment. My sister went to Dark Lake alone.
Two days later, I got a phone call. It was Rachel, desperately afraid for her life.
Now Dark Lake is my destination. I may have lost my mother, but I wasn't going to lose my sister too.
Thanks to Increator for the demo upload.

Credits

846.name: Earl Bobby is looking for his Balls
846.description:
This is the second part of the Earl Bobby trilogy.
You should play "Earl Bobby is looking for his Shoes" first to understand everything.
The worlds most famous Scottish Earl continues his quest for the sense of life. And this time he is looking for something even more important than his shoes. This time he is looking for his balls...yes, his balls.
STORY:
After Earl Bobby succeeded in finding his shoes, comb, kilt, golf clubs, car and ultimately the way there, he happily reached the Glenfiddich Golf Club to pursue one of his favorite diversions: Playing golf.
But soon he recognizes that his destiny to lose important items has followed him:
One of his
[…]
balls gets robbed by a bird. When he tries to search for it, he soon gets involved in a complex plot, in which he has to face the famous golf player Tiger Woody in a tournament.
Baron Mucki the millionaire and Lula Hankingfire the young nymphomaniac will surely help him to win the contest. But this isn't enough. He will have to solve lots of weird puzzles to finally find his balls.

Credits

845.name: Armageddon Margaret
845.description:
When mechanized zombies overrun a peaceful English village and countryside, what is a proper young lady to do?
Step up to the challenge and save the day, of course!
Created Feb '04 for a MAGS challenge. 1-21-07: Please read the installation instructions; there is an error in the setup that hasn't been resolved, and requires a slight workaround. Apologies for any inconvenience.
Miss Felicia Delgado knew that it would not be considered at all proper for her to earn her bread serving as a doctor to her beloved village of Isleyshire. It would certainly be more appropriate for her to live the quiet, retired life of a young woman firmly set on the shel
[…]
f. However, living such a life would require money-- which Felicia had not-- so*something* clearly needed to be done. And while she greatly enjoyed the company of the dashing, scientifically-inclined Lord Bright, she was not such a ninnyhammer as to pin any hopes upon him declaring himself in any form at all.
Her time would have been taken up entirely in concerns of that sort, had not a more pressing problem reared its head... in the form of bloodthirsty armoured creatures roaming the countryside, destroying homes and terrorising all in their path. Worse yet, it seems that Lord Bright may be involved-- or even responsible!
Can Felicia solve the mystery of the metallic monsters? Or will she be their next victim?

Credits

844.name: Skippy (Saves The Day)
844.description:
Skippy helps his Master when 3 strangers invade the swimming pool.
Submitted for the Jan. 2007 MAGS contest.

Credits

840.name: Roccio's Quest
840.description:
After coming out of the mall, Roccio finds that his car has been vandalized!  His friend, Stephen, stops by and convinces him to go chick chasing at a local night club to take his mind off of it.
Arriving at the night club, Roccio finds that he needs a membership card to enter.  Darnit!  He just spent his last euro at the mall!
Several languages available:
English
French
Italian
Italian Politically Correct
Russian
Russian (polite)
Spanish
You can download the installer version from main download link
and the bare RAR from the first mirror.

Credits

839.name: A Cure for the Common Cold
839.description:
After spending years as a starving artist, you've managed to catch the eye
of an influential gallery director.  The problem: he wants to see some new
work, and you've got a terrible cold that is draining your creativity.
You'd better find a cure for the common cold--and fast!
Brought to you by Team Strange Potato! :)
An Italian version is now available, thanks to Cinfa :)

Credits

838.name: Wooly Rockbottom and the Quest for the Golden Beard of Thor!
838.description:
Wooly Rockbottom has a problem.  He's a beardless Dwarf, cursed to be made fun of by the people of Glenfurdan.  After learning of the legend of Thor's magical beard, Wooly decides he must have it, but before he can leave he must choose a companion:  Fenwick the Flighty or Bram the Bold.
The game puzzles involve actually inventing objects to solve problems, so be prepared to do more than just inventory manipulations.
This game was made for the OROW 4 competition.

Credits

836.name: MI: Bad Day to be Dead Demo
836.description:
Below you can find the trailer/ Ags game.(it's very short. kind like a trailer made with AGS.)
The story is after the last monkey game(Escape from Monkey Island)
Guybrush is shot by Le Chuck and he is left to be dead. So he starts a quest to find Elaine.
Throughout the game you will experience how people feel about his death. Also INSULT SWORDFIGHTING.
Yeah I know it's good to be dead.
The project HAS been Cancelled Till this Day.

Credits

835.name: Enoworld
835.description:
"Enoworld" is a short game featuring William, the last and the most melancholy knight of Enoworld, as its main protagonist. Help William on his not exactly dangerous, but amusing quest, as he gathers the mysterious holy stones all over Enoworld, in order to destroy the evil, organic-matter-hating robots from outer space, a seemingly great threat to Enoworldians.
To play the game, download the two zipped files below. "Download from Mirror 1" should get you to Enoworld2.zip, which contains the game audio (20.12 MB) and "Download Now" should get you to Enoworld1.zip, which contains everything else (9.78 MB). Don't forget to place all the files you have extracted from Enoworld1.zip and the file you have extracted from Enoworld2.zip
[…]
into a single folder before playing.

Credits

834.name: Blackmail in Brooklyn
834.description:
Created for OROW 3 in just four days, Blackmail in Brooklyn tells the tale of four aging heroes who have come to save Brooklyn from the terror of Slash and his gang of thugs: Pelvis (a parody of Elvis Presley), Bruise (Bruce Lee), Nunchuk (Chuck Norris), and Master T (Mr. T).  The game plays in a traditional, River City Ransom inspired side scrolling action format, where you can punch, kick, jump, and even use special moves.  Due to the time constraints, Bruise, Nunchuk and Master T did not make it into the game, and only one level is playable.
Still, it shows what can be accomplished using only Rawdraw in AGS!

Credits

833.name: Update Quest
833.description:
You're bored. Find something to do.
NOTE: the file available for download here contains a self-extracting archive, it IS NOT the compiled game executable.

Credits

832.name: Asterix and the Roman Underground
832.description:
Asterix wakes up one day to discover the corruption of certain members of the roman army

Credits

828.name: Update Quest Demo
828.description:
The demo for the upcoming Update Quest. In this demo you need to start you website, 'cos you're bored.

Credits

827.name: Sydney Finds Employment
827.description:
Sydney Claywood wakes in his alley one day to discover a new policy set in place by a joint venture between the political parties, churches and big businesses to rid the streets of homelessness and unemployment. There solution is a 'final solution,' of sorts.
Sydney decides that the only way to save himself and his friends is to go directly to the heart of the plan, the CBD, and argue his case. However, in the back of Syd's mind is the constant idea that ˜Maybe I could, you know, just find a REAL job.
There is some suggestive and slightly rude content here. I'd only really recommend it for mature audiences.

Credits

826.name: A Walk in Da Tomb: Final

825.name: KristmasKrisis
825.description:
One of my old shames. Not as bad as KoffeeKrisis, but not good either.
Bugfixed!
Originally an entry for the MAGS December 2006. Full scale war between Father Christmas and his minions!
BUGFIXED! Whoo-hooo!

Credits

824.name: Christmas Quest 2: The Yuletide Flows in
824.description:
This is the sequel to last year's Christmas Quest, made by the Adventure Gamers staff

Credits

823.name: AciDDD Updated
823.description:
Tress McTucker wants to get himself drunk, but he have to convince the barman to sell him some wiskey first.
Freestyle remake of Mostly's "Nihilism" by FSi.
EPILEPTIC ALERT! - may knock you down.
Updated version features brand new non-blinking mode.
MIRROR features NON-UPDATED version (but it works)

Credits

822.name: Emma Roide
822.description:
Emma made a terrifing nightmare, maybe a premonitory dream? Who knows? Strange things happens to her and she wants to solve this mistery...

Credits

821.name: Super Jazz Man
821.description:
This game puts you in the unitard and cape of a musical superhero who waits tables at the Zanzibar restaurant under the cover of night. After playing a weekend concert that revolutionizes the local airwaves, our saxophonist receives a phone call at work.
Super Jazz Man explores the fundamental elements of an adventure, unfolding locations with the progression of the narrative while featuring nostalgic low-color graphics. Play through four unique endings!
For roughly the price of a martini in Manhattan, you can play it today!
The full version is $8.95 USD, and a playable demo is available for download. (click download)

Credits

820.name: Monkey Island: Carnival of the Damned
820.description:
Welcome aboard Captain.
you are about to journey somewhere only one man can be called survivor.And this man is Guybrush Threepwood.
The place? A place of agony, pain , despair, corruption(nope it's not the White House) it's a carnival where you hear screams not of joy but of pain.THE CARNIVAL OF THE DAMNED.
Has greek translation(although I don't think it works)
22/1/2007
Spanish Translation Available thanks to Renataqb (www.e-rqb.com)
Click mirror url.
Brought to you by
Sho-Ryu-Ken corp
27/12/2007
----------------
Changed host from filefront.
This was released, when I was ignorant of computer games design. I'm still t
[…]
hat way.

Credits

819.name: Reactor 09
819.description:
Escaping from a prison is never easy. But doing it with a correctional officer's consent is even harder. Officer Matthew Holmstett is a walking, talking regulation book and has his own set of ideals. Getting him to do what you want won't be an easy task. Don't overdo it, or you may find yourself handcuffed to a radiator very fast. Nobody trusts someone convicted for murder that easily after all...
Recommended for mature audiences only.
The mirror download is a version without the starter compiled with AGS 2.72.

Credits

817.name: Larry Lotter and the Test of Time
817.description:
It's time for the final exams at Magic University, and notorious slacker Larry Lotter is about to flunk all of them because he spent less time studying and more time drinking beer. But there is yet hope! Using a spell to travel back in time, he gets the chance to do his day over again and pull some tricks to pass the exams anyway! And he has to, because it's his Destiny.
Join Rob Greasley, Calliope DeRanger and Professor Mumblemore in this short Harry Potter parody, loosely based on the greatly admired books by J.K. Rowling. Watch the other characters act and interact of their own accord, and spin time back and forth to interfere.
Includes translations into into French, Brazilian Portuguese, German, Hunga
[…]
rian, Dutch, Russian, and Italian.

Credits

816.name: The Big Bad Wolf and The Three Little Pigs
816.description:
Now it's time for the Big Bad Wolf to finally catch the pigs!
The storyline is similiar to the Disney's Zeke Wolf stories, almost...

Credits

814.name: SkyTower Rescue Demo
814.description:
Join Alynn as he goes upon his epic quest to save the Skytower and it's contents againt a band of n00bs.
The game features the latest in bad puns, sexual innuendos, Geeky humor, and other stuff that I just find funny.

Credits

813.name: Heartland Deluxe
813.description:
The deluxe version of my OROW game Heartland.
Nominated for two AGS Awards (2007).
03/04/09: The main download link is back up.
29/03/09: The main download link is currently unavailable. Please use the mirror provided below. Sorry for the inconvenience.
The game is compressed as a self-extracting 7-Zip archive, hence the *.exe of the filename. It is NOT an installer :)

Credits

811.name: Don Spillacy's Conspiracy Quest
811.description:
Don was bored of doing nothing while on sick leave from work.
A misunderstanding with a pie vendor starts his quest to uncover a terrible secret.....
Winner of the september 2006 MAGS competition, theme of Conspiracy, 16 colours and odd inventory items.

Credits

810.name: Party
810.description:
Welcome to the party. This game takes place in a dream. Your mission is simple, get some popcorn for Ingrid Bergman, the Swedish actress. As a reward she will show you what her coat is hiding... The game has 8 different endings, can you get them all?

Credits

809.name: Ryan's Day Out
809.description:
Chronicles the Day out of Ryan on a supreme journey into a Coca-Cola van.

Credits

807.name: Halloween Horror
807.description:
Play as Fred Fredburger from "The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy" who has won a Mansion. After being locked in Fred finds he may not be the only one in the house.
This is my first game ever, made for the October 2006 MAGS Competition. The game has 2 playable characters, many old favorite cartoon characters and a short zany story. Hopefully this is fully glitch free and will run smoothly.
I've hopefully fixed the glitch, a new version called Halloween 1.1 is in the download, and the mirror is the patch to fix the old version if you have it.

Credits

806.name: Kinky Island DEMO
806.description:
You play Joey Cormack in this short playable demo, as he arrives under very strange circumstances at an island which he (and you) will never forget! Solve a few puzzles, check out some boobies, wait for the full-game!! This is an LEC style adventure with a strange GUI :D PLEASE, this is a game for adult players 18+ so respect that! NOMINATED FOR BEST AGS DEMO 2006 (cheers! whoever bothered to do that!!! :p ) - THIS IS KINKY ISLAND!!!
2011: The full game is in production!

Credits

805.name: Tales of Chickenry
805.description:
This is the first game that I  made. Its about a knight of Chickenry who has to resque Princess Henrietta who has been kidnapped by the wolves of Dogdruff.
- Keyboard-controlled character movement
- Characters voiced by various actors/ No narrator
- Installer version

Credits

804.name: Nedy's Adventure: The curse of Vera Deluxe
804.description:
The Carbon captain has kidnapped you to have someone to resolve the cursed island mistery, she makes you jump from the airplane with your parachute, and then you must guide Nedy to escape from the island.
You'll get into trouble and it won't be easy to escape...
With relaxing music!!!
Available IN ENGLISH, and spanish.
Screenie: http://joecarlhr.googlepages.com/SCR2.PNG

Credits

803.name: FSi's Vacuum Cleaner Gone Mad!
803.description:
It's twentyminutesgame.
It features a song by me.
The song is nice, all other things are NOT.

Credits

802.name: Voodoo Dave & the Tablecloth Mystery
802.description:
VDTM is a game about guy whose girlfriend sent him to hell... And he went there.
Oh, how I'm sick and tired of writing these words! So here's some new ones for ye:
1. It is a The Seventh Guest ripoff (though it's 2D and there is no AI in puzzles... in this version)
2. It has lots of bad humour of mine.
3. It has VERY tragical ending.
So, check it out! It's the second game I'm proud of making!
Use mirror for direct download.

"Existence...
I did hate the existences. If I could; I would want to destroy everything, all the universe. It would be the best for all of us. But I knew it was impossible.
So, the thing I was trying to do (and probably the best thing to do) was reating something new instead of destruction. Building a new world...
Just for me...
And her...
She made me happy and be with me; in one of the worst terms of my short l
[…]
ife. And when I find her, I would build a new world for us.
All your moral rules were nothing for me... And I would never mind any danger that could happen to me. But its real reason was neither my over-courage or stupidness, nor the fact I had got nothing to lose. Only reason was the narrowness of my imagination. An imagination far away from the worst nightmares. It was absent in my mind. The thing I didn't know was that; the truth is much wider and painful than our imaginary."
Now we are going to the Karabalta as Berkay Efekan, a teenager boy who had got almost nothing to lose in his life. His father had gone bankrupt and committed suicide a long time ago, and his all the communication between his mother and friends are cut. In this worse term of life, Berkay gets friend with Kardelen, his pretty classmate. They get very close friends together; but someday Kardelen disappears without any clue. Nobody knows where she and her grandmother, who looks after Kardelen since her childhood.
One night, Berkay has a serious argument with his mother, and leaves his home shutting the door. Now he has got only purpose that avoids him to end his own life.
Building a new world...

For three years have the demons followed Daniel. When he meets a mysterious girl in the tavern named The Last Harvest, he decides to defeat the evil spirits, that hunt him.
EDIT: Version 1.1 is out now, that should fix some bugs.

Credits

711.name: Bog's Adventures in the Underworld
711.description:
Poor hen pecked Bog tries his best to please Clod, his wife, but when he tries to improve on her famous 'Mushy Mush' recipe, things don't go according to plan and Bog ends up in Hell, the Underworld. Help Bog to find his way back to Clod and patch up their relationship.
There are two possible main endings and a little extra bit for anyone that manages to achieve the maximum score.
Stats:
115 Rooms, 110 Inventory items, 40 NPCs and almost 50,000 lines of scripting!

Credits

710.name: The Long Trip
710.description:
You play Bobey Marl, a young man, worth for nothing, who has only nonsense in his mind. The game starts with his arrestment and the final goal is - surely - to save the world.

Credits

709.name: Chicken VS. Road
709.description:
Update 10/31/20: Sorry for the temporarily broken link, the game is back up and ready for download! :)
http://www.mediafire.com/file/21jw39zoxdyt8ns/CvR.zip/file
At long last, Clucksworth has the chance to escape from the desert cactus farm he's been living in his whole life.  Only one thing stands in the way - the Road.  It's a short, cartoony game with a few unusual puzzles to solve.  There are tons of interactions with items and backgrounds, so look, touch and talk to everything (especially if you're bored :).  And a built-in hint system if you get stuck or can't figure out what the heck I was thinking!  Hope you enjoy it, it's my first released AGS game and I welcome any and all constructive critique.  Happy ga
[…]
ming!

Credits

708.name: the farm episode one
708.description:
You  the character noname in a society where it is illegal to be fat.
One night the NHS come to take you away, you wake up in a cell with no idea where you are or why. you have to escape!

Credits

707.name: Bog's Adventure in Easy3D
707.description:
This is just a short (7 rooms) game to test out (okay, I admit it, show off!) my Easy3D module, inspired by the fabled WMGS engine. All the rooms in the game are built in AGS as normal playable 2D rooms, with objects, characters, hotspots, walkable areas, and regions as normal. Then by initiating the module, with just one function call, the display switches to 3D and the same room can be played in 3D. The module also provides 3D parallax areas that can be added to standard 2D rooms. Anyway check it out. It is very processor intensive so at least a 2Ghz computer is recommended.

Credits

706.name: Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator Case 5 - Land of the Rising Dead
706.description:
After the events in London, Ben Jordan returns home for a much needed rest. One day, he receives a conference call from his friends Simon Booth and Alice Wilkins. Simon has heard of a series of murders in Osaka, Japan, and thinks there is some sort of paranormal activity involved. Ben, Simon, and Alice travel to Japan, but soon find there is much more to the story than they first thought...

Credits

705.name: Quest Fighter
705.description:
Get rrready to rrrumble! In the style of Celebrity Deathmatch, the heroes of classical Quest games duke it out to decide once and for all which of them is the best and greatest! Will Graham's royal rage lead him to victory over Larry's cheap wine? Can Roger's plasma shield save the day? Or will agent Bonds simply arrest the lot of them? You can make the difference! Download now... if you dare!
(Moves list available at the website, http://www.geocities.com/wombatgray/qfmoves.htm )

Credits

703.name: WaterQuest v1.0
703.description:
ADVENTURE GAME
STORY LINE.
Our hero, is successful in his field of employment , but tends to run in a bit of trouble when
it comes to the fundimentals.He is thirsty.Have you ever felt the need to drink of a glass
of thirst quenching water but haven't been able to find any suitable for consumption??
His QUEST is to find some water!

Credits

702.name: Fallen Angel
702.description:
Once upon a time, on the island of Nithrm,
their inhabitants noticed an unusual white light in the sky.
As its size increased, they started to perceive a sharper form.
After a while it became obvious that white light was winged!
Before they could realize how important this fact was,
something landed (or rather crashed) with a dry sound.
The nearest person to the crash site, as curious as every human creature is, went to check at once.
This person was no other than Helmer, a neither too powerful nor too rich inhabitant of the island, simply put, a game maker.
When he arrived, he couldn't believe his eyes.
There was a tall figure lying on the stone floor in white clothes, human-
[…]
like but with wings on its back.
It was an angel.
Won MAGS March 2006

Credits

700.name: Death of an Angel
700.description:
The city of Angels is located in the clouds. Noone has left it for 500 years. But now, one of the Angels, Simon, is missing. Where is he? What happened to him?

Credits

698.name: Cake & Smurphy Puzzle Battle!
698.description:
Stupid 1 or 2 players block-breaking game...(game and readme in french, english version coming soon!)
Note: The file is split in 3 parts (20MB each)...
Part 1:
http://kbz.shini.free.fr/cspb/cspb.part1.rar
Part 2:
http://kbz.shini.free.fr/cspb/cspb.part2.rar
Part 3:
http://kbz.shini.free.fr/cspb/cspb.part3.rar
Enjoy! And don't forget to vote! ;)

Credits

697.name: Piratess
697.description:
A short game about a female pirate who stumbles upon a bit of bad fortune. This game was intended to be medium-long, but I didn't have the time to make it. I tidied it up, fixed the bugs and made a quick end. It is released up to and including where I reached within production, with an ending slapped on.
EDIT: Updated Links and Screen 22/07/07

Credits

696.name: Where did Sam go?
696.description:
Max has been waiting in the car for ages and is starting to worry about Sam.
He decides to go inside to look after him.
And YOU have to help him find Sam.
ALL graphic (except inventory items, GUIs, cursors) and music is ripped off LucasArts games and is copyright (c) LucasArts.

Credits

694.name: Automation
694.description:
Winner of the first OROW competition, this game was created in 1 week and is set in 1 room. A scientist looses his robot down a hole in the floor and must get it back using the environment around him.

Credits

693.name: Dangerous Lands (RPG/Strategy)
693.description:
Dangerous Lands new fantasy step-by-step strategy with elements RPG and Adventure
In fantasy castle Rovendale there was a trouble princess Lussi have stolen, on her searches king sends the younger son.
To find the sister to prince it is necessary to pass a long way through woods, deserts, the rivers, mountains, a vault and a lava.
Your friends become fine elfes and mighty dwarfes, together with them you will be fight against orcs, goblins, ogrs, dracons, vampires, drows and other spiteful and strong opponents
Click: {download full version of game...}
Features of game:
Fights in a step-by-step mode 10*10
More than 70 fights (missions)
More than 40 kinds of monsters
M
[…]
ore than 20 kinds of items
More than 20 kinds of spells
More than 25 kinds of player unit
New version Dangerous Lands - Dangerous Lands Tournament released!!!
The main changes:
Second mode of game,+ new campaign consisting of 16 consistently carried out missions is added
In it is not necessary to go on a map the hero, to suspect whom a misfortune and whom to employ in army on the received money, only fights!!
New version Dangerous Lands: Tournament+RPG it is accessible to uploading
Mode RPG while only demonstration, 22 characters, new kinds of monsters are accessible on a choice before the beginning of game
Come and swing more quickly a site it is alive
