http://depositfiles.com/files/xnu8y11vo

Credits

692.name: Clip goes to town
692.description:
Clip is a guy, who has to go to the carshop and buy some car-shampoo. On his way to the shop he gets into adventures.
[edit 2011] download link fixed!

Credits

691.name: JWB Games Demo Game
691.description:
Demo Game is the first original game by JWB Games. It was put together very fast and is, unfortunately, very bad. It is a quick, fairly fun game, though, with mildly funny messages that result from using look, touch, and talk on the different objects. Future games from JWBG will be much better!

Credits

689.name: AGS-Invaders
689.description:
Old Style Shoot'em Up Game,
builded with the shoot'em up module i developed for the coding contest.
If you interested in the module or the complete game-sources, you can download this files here -> http://www.virtual-illusion.com/board/index.php?topic=8.0

Credits

687.name: 1213 Episode 2
687.description:
With more questions raised than answered, 1213 explores further areas of his prison and begins to learn the truth about his genesis.

Credits

686.name: Stan Ames, Private Eye - Episode 1 - Murder Incorporated
686.description:
Stan Ames, PI (for short), is the first in a series of episodes following the exploits of a seemingly washed-up detective. Each episode will put Ames on dangerous worldwide missions of conspiracy and intrigue.
The pilot episode “Murder Incorporated”, introduces Stan Ames as a lowlife PI who's good for nothing more than snapping photos of cheating husbands and cleaning up what the cops leave behind. Then, a mysterious call from a woman in distress, leads him on a journey through a demented corporations evil schemes. Upon uncovering a shocking conspiracy, Ames finds himself in much deeper than he has ever been before.

Credits

685.name: Cosmos Quest I
685.description:
Year: Far in the future. Location: Yellow Fog Galaxy, somewhere on the bridge between Rhomul System and the peripheral rings of the Federation. The Sun slowly fade out under submission of a black hole that no one knew before. Executing your duties as an engineer in a crew that observes the temperature of the Sun, you (Apo Lanski) notice a small problem with the shuttle when you just started your night shift. Landing on a small planet called Zhena was a wise move, because your shuttle is an old 3rd generation machineâ€¦

Credits

684.name: Maniac Mansion Mania Episode 2 - Commotion
684.description:
In the middle of the night, Bernard is disturbed in his slumber by strange noises coming from the attic.
After changing his undies, he sets out to explore...

Credits

683.name: Heart of Abraxas
683.description:
One Room, One Week competition game in which you find yourself trapped in a basement, unsure of who you are or what you are doing there. The strange arcane symbol on the floor at your feet seems to restrict your movement, and the menacing darkness around you can only be broken by the light of discovery. Who are you? Why are you here, and who has done this to you? Will you live long enough to find out?

Credits

682.name: Bad Luck
682.description:
This game was created for the "One Room, One Week" competition.
Everybody hates winter.  It's always the time when things get difficult and tiresome.  Just when you thought things couldn't get any worse,  you find yourself stuck in your backyard shed.
*This version of the game contains a few modifications from the competition's version.
(The game is finally back online!  Enjoy!)

Credits

681.name: Mordy 2: The Mirror of Truth
681.description:
This is a full length game featuring pre-rendered 3d graphics and over 70 rooms, with a complete original music track.
Help Mordy Find his way back to his main planet.
Unfortunately this game is no longer available, due to the large download. I will hopefully put it back on in the future once i have my own webspace. at the moment, i don't think it is worth asking someone to host such a large game for 1 download every second month. :)
edit: there seems to be a few sites still hosting the games, though i'm not sure if they have the latest version, and might still contain some of the old bugs. they are all in languages i don't understand. haha.  download at your own risk. ;)

Credits

680.name: Tomb of the Moon
680.description:
Entry for the third One Room, One Week competition featuring cartoony graphics, innovativeish scripting and original story and soundtrack.

Credits

679.name: 24 Hours
679.description:
A short game made for the third One Room One Week Competition. In this game you have 24 hours to write an essay for school.

Credits

678.name: A Day with Michael
678.description:
This is a game I made for my son for a Christmas present.  It wasn't done then but close. It's done now... At least the low res version.  I hope you enjoy.

Credits

677.name: A.L.I.
677.description:
Ali finds himself in a room.
Just play the demo and see...

Credits

676.name: Loom II
676.description:
A sequel to the epic adventure of LucasArts.
In this demo you can cast spells, learn drafts,
examine objects by double click and meet
our old friends and enemies.
Protagonist: Bobbin Threadbare.

Credits

674.name: Santa's Sidekick
674.description:
Its a game about boy who get too late to school and starts to wonder aroun school till break. altough he discovers a crash-landed santa and decides to help him.
NB! in mirror download speech is non-skipable

Credits

672.name: Lonely Night
672.description:
An old man lives in a lonly house. His wife has died some years ago.
One night he thinks that there's a burglar in his house.

Credits

671.name: The Chronicles of the Shoe: Part 1 DEMO (V1.3)
671.description:
The chronicles of the shoe are three games that tell the tale of an epic quest undertaken by 3 people that is all to return a shoe to it's owner.  In part 1 you play as Jirb, a strange man obsessed with cerial.
This Demo includes the intro and chapter 1, "the Slip".
NOTE: This is now version 1.3.  Additions include:
-Bug fixes in almost every room, and various changes in events, speech and gameplay.
-The correct starting room.
-Game now goes slightly into chapter 2, at which point it's advisable to stop playing, as it is probably quite buggy and unfinished (I haven't got around to properly testing it).
-Scaling changed to continuous in various rooms.
-rough patch
[…]
es tidied up
-Increased the walk speed of the main character.

Credits

670.name: Christmas Quest
670.description:
This game was created by the Adventure Gamers staff as a seasonal gift to their readers.

Credits

669.name: Rude Awakening!
669.description:
Have you ever thought you woke up but you were still dreaming.  Humorous one room game.

Credits

667.name: Petrakov: Inexperienced Assassin
667.description:
Petrakov is sent to a small town for an easy job.  When he bungles  and fails to assassinate his target, his client Sonny Saint gives him one last chance to live.
*Note:  Do not attempt to solve any puzzles.  No events were scripted, thus this is simply a "walk around and look" demo.  The music is irritating as is the inconsistent dialogue.  I apologize!  Luckily all the game files were lost and this project has been abandoned.

Credits

666.name: Life of D. Duck
666.description:
When D. Duck is born, he comes out of the egg with a clear vision in his mind: To win Andecity (Duckburg) marathon! Full of anticipation he asks Grandmother Duck what he must do to become a champion. The solution? Making oat porridge.
Take control over D. Duck in his quest to make oat porridge in this interactive adventure game developed by Audunsoft in close cooperation with aspiring artist BjÃ¸rnar B.

Credits

665.name: Veteran shootout
665.description:
A very short shooter that I made overnight for the 01/2006 MAGS, the topic was old people.
You play a WW2 veteran who is fed up with kids playing on his lawn, and pulls out his shotty.

Credits

123.name: Larrywilco: Paradise Lost
123.description:
You play Larrywilco, stranded in paradise after a plane crash.
You have to find a way to get home but along the way you want to have a bit of fun.
As there is no immediate way home you might as well have a few drinks and try to pick up chicks.
Success is up to you.
Released 24th October 2002

Credits

664.name: 1213 Episode 1
664.description:
A man lies in a darkened cell, consumed by pain and sickness. He does not know where he is. He does not know how he came to be there. He does not even know his own name. All he knows is that he is being tortured by a bizarre, bespectacled man, who addresses him only as a number - Twelve-Thirteen.
Unofficial Russian translation available at: http://sledgy.narod.ru/

Credits

662.name: ELFO:Rescue Craby
662.description:
One day Craby the crab go early to visit its friends, but nonreturn...
Spanish  & English Translations.

Credits

660.name: Elf Motors Inc.
660.description:
A mysterious beast has invaded the car engine that's under Abbrekt's supervision. Help him track down the invader and put a stop to its shenanigans before the car is destroyed.
A walkthrough is available here:
http://gamesolutions.efzeven.nl/elf-motors-inc-walkthrough-erenan2005/

Credits

659.name: AGS Chess!
659.description:
This is my version of chess made with AGS!  It has proper peice movement, castling, etc.  (No en passant, sorry).  It is two player, and has an turn-based clock starting at 30 minutes per player.
It has a few bugs, and cannot properly detect checkmate/stalemates, but that's stuff you can do yourself right?  Please enjoy and comment/vote!!!

Credits

658.name: EXIT
658.description:
you also need to download part 2 of the setup file
http://www.americangirlscouts.org/agsuploads/files/EXIT%20setup.part2.rar
Meet strange people in a bizarre house where everything is upside-down, like in an Escher painting.
One can say this is a game about the search for the reason of life. I made this for school; it took me about 4 months to learn ags an to make the game. You can send criticism to mars333@web.de
I wonder what you think about it.

Credits

657.name: Der Verschwundene Husky
657.description:
The game is currently only available in german.
---
Kinuk is an inhabitant of a small village on the verge of Greenland.
When having to realize his dog named BjÃ¶rn disappeared over night, he decides to follow a trace in the snow.
---
The game contains among other things voice output, midi music and a tutorial for beginners.

Credits

656.name: Princess Marian VIII: Snowfight
656.description:
Yes, Princess Marian is up to her adventures again. This time she fights the forces of evil in a two-player snowball fight!

Credits

655.name: AS Racing Manager
655.description:
This is non-adventure game.
It is racing team manager. In this game you make a racing team, find sponsors and buy car, engine, drivers, wheels.
THIS IS FULL VERSION

Credits

654.name: A Walk in Da Tomb
654.description:
My first ever game made in AGS!
getting straight to the point its the shortest game in history!

Credits

653.name: META
653.description:
The only real AGS game! Everything else is merely a game in AGS. Is it one room containing four rooms? Or twenty rooms containing one  room? Or both? Find out today, in one of the most surrealistic adventure games (or is that game adventures?) you've seen, where a bug truly is a feature.
The Awesmoe Quest (sic) has so many bugs that it's actually impossible to complete. Can you finish it anyway, with the help of everybody's favorite mascot, Cuppit? Can you keep your  inventory from burning you to cinders? Can you work the poorly-designed marvel known as BHT? If you're in for some serious confusion, download META here. It's the weirdest thing since sliced bread.
Warning: not for the faint of mouse.
[…]
NOTE: This is an UPDATED version, since the original was too tricky. There is more to it than the first room or the first joke, and it has several puzzles that are really quite surprising. Try it some time!

Credits

652.name: Legends Of Mardaram
652.description:
"Legends Of Mardaram" is a story about a planet far from earth. A homeless mardaramic finds himself on an unknown place of Mardaram and he has no idea, what was happened. He has to break out of a dark dungeon and to find his way to the next city. From other mardaramics he learns about the mysterious events of the last weeks - something strange is happening in this world.
LOM is a game full of story and dialogs, about 50 nice graphic scenes and some filmsequences. A brandnew Template and our own background music makes the game technically much better as my earlier games.
Only available in german language yet.

Credits

651.name: Javelin Catch
651.description:
Try to catch that javelin! But don't wait too long or try too early, or you'll be sorry!

Credits

650.name: The Paramecium Complex
650.description:
A mad scientist has invented a super cure to all the world's woes.  The problem is, it's unstable.  You must enter the Paramecium Complex and save the day!

Credits

649.name: MOTLPAA
649.description:
Maze Of Twisty Little Passages, All Alike
This is something that to my knowledge has never been done in AGS before. But of course AGS is versatile enough to make it possible. Welcome to the Biggest Maze Ever (and if you don't believe me, I can simply make it bigger - but it is already bigger than the one in Zak McKracken, or KQ5, or LSL3, or CQOTL, or Hugo5, so I believe it qualifies).

Credits

648.name: Hell's Satans
648.description:
This is a movie made using only scripting. It is not a full version but has some of it done.

Credits

647.name: Bob Goes Home
647.description:
You are Bob.
Your main mission in life is to vandalise a school for some reason. Only problem is... you'll have to play to find out!

Credits

645.name: Operation Novi
645.description:
This game is a small shooter game I made for the small exhibition SuperNovi that was arranged by a group of MultiMedia and Cand. IT stundents at Aalborg University.
You are Heroman. Sent by the president to stop an experiment that has gone wrong. You can only do this by killing everyone on the university...

Credits

643.name: The Winter Rose
643.description:
An evil ice-dragon has settled in once lush and forested land, blighting it with eternal winter.  Only a young archer has the determination -and the wits - to end his wicked reign of terror.  Help Rose through this epic quest.
This game features handpainted backgrounds, intriguing characters and over a hundred animations.  It is a fantasy adventure with a humorous undertone.

Credits

642.name: Lost In The Nightmare v1.1
642.description:
Are you ready for this? Then step into the dark world of Lost In The Nightmare and face your darkest dreams..
An 'interactive horror adventure' by Ahmet Kelesh, with pre-rendered 3D graphics and cutscenes with cinematical camera pitches.
Pre-rendered 3D backgrounds taken from the Half-Life engine are used in Lost In The Nightmare. I'm preparing the HL maps with Valve Hammer Editor by myself and using modified versions of the textures and models of the mods like They Hunger, Medieval World.
Story:
The main character is Burak Guney, a private dedective who used to work for the police. You are hired to find three university students who got lost in a forest near the Karabalta Town while cam
[…]
ping. They have been lost for 3 months and the police couldn't find any clue what happened to them. You'll stay in Karatas Hotel during your investigate. But soon you will learn that something is wrong with this cursed town....

Credits

641.name: Class Notes
641.description:
Mack has just seen that he has an exam tomorrow... but there is a small problem: he didn't go to the class and he doesn't have class notes.
The game consists on helping Mack to find some class notes at the school with some curious methods...
The game is in Spanish and a English translation is available.

Credits

640.name: Legend of Rovendale 2 Mystic Island
640.description:
This is full quest about young princess. Only on russian language.
REFRESH
http://depositfiles.com/files/f0534zbpw

Credits

639.name: Bunny Quest
639.description:
A simple little game made in 3 hours for Halloween. Don't play this game if you are easily scared. Trick or Treat? and yes you can get the carrot!

Credits

638.name: Deflus Technical Demo
638.description:
This is a technical demo for a sci-fi based adventure game Ralph Schaafsma and Aapeli Kutila were working on.
This demo was made for the Release Something 2 competition back in 2005.

Credits

637.name: Dark of Night
637.description:
Alone and lost in the Dark of Night during a storm... Our weary traveller explores his surroundings as he tries to find a way past various obstacles.  Game is a bit spooky, with a few surprises and some nice special effects as well(lightning, thunder, rain, etc)...  Best played with the lights down low, and the sound turned up a bit. ;)
Made for the October 2005 "Release Something - Halloween Edition" AGS event.
Light and Rain "plugins" are included with the zip download.
Game should run fine on most versions of Windows and on most modern computer systems.

Credits

636.name: Domestic Conspiracy Demo
636.description:
Try out the demo for Domestic Conspiracy!
Tubbsy needs to activate his overly-complex trap, but his lifetime of eating paintchips and living under power lines has left him without a viable memory.  Luckily, he's left a number of clues to help him remember how to work the contraption.
Good luck with these challenging puzzles!

Credits

635.name: Zugzwang
635.description:
Ever thought learning how to play chess was a bit of an adventure? Well now it really is.
Zugzwang gradually leads the player through the basic movements of all the pieces, how to setup the board, capturing, castling, check, checkmate and stalemate, the weird nature of pawns and even the obscure en passant rule. At the same time you get to help two little Pawns, one White and one Black, to reach their ultimate ambitions. To play in a real Battle. Meet and talk to all the Pieces ,Black and White, and solve numerous chess puzzles, some serious and some just silly.

Credits

633.name: Dance 'Til You Drop!
633.description:
Jump into the soft dancin' shoes of that paragon of dance aerobics workouts, Richard Simmons!  Trouble abounds for our plucky hero whe he discovers his money is running out and his plans for building a theme park for needy kids is in danger!  Become Richard Simmons and make Dance Til' You Drop a success!
Be aware that there are two versions.  Version 1 available on the first link is the midi only version, and while much smaller is nowhere near as fun as Version 2.  The mirror holds a 50 meg version with full ogg soundtrack full of 80s goodness, sound effects and a whole lot more!  Now get downloading and get dancing!

Credits

632.name: Adventure Game Demo
632.description:
"Adventure Game" is the ultimative Adventure Game Parody.
In this, I admit, very short demo, you can get an idea of the game.
Have fun!

Credits

631.name: Goose Quest 1 DEMO
631.description:
You are Otis, the Goosean superhero... complete with cape and everything.  However, you soon discover that some old monsters you've beaten before are coming back to haunt you, and a nearby castle has fallen to darkness.  Take up the meat tenderizing mallet, and prepare!  This is just an intro to Goose Quest 1, which will contain rooms inside the castle and a few more puzzles outside.
Recently updated downloads: download url is a .zip, mirror is a .rar of the even more updated demo I made for "Release Something!"

Credits

630.name: Force majeure II: The Zone
630.description:
You are the sole survivor of an unknown catastrophe, trapped in an air-raid shelter. Escaping your confinement, you face a delusional reality known only as the Zone – a place where your own mind is your enemy. The city is in ruins: explore a dreamy landscape through the eyes of a lone wanderer trying to piece together fragments of the past.
Force majeure II: The Zone is an audio-visual interactive story by Leo Nordwall set in a ruined city where everything seems uncertain. The Zone is experienced from a first-person perspective and is navigated by pointing-and-clicking. Photos, drawings, 3D renderings and live video footage have been integrated into a unique visual experience. The soundtrack is over 70 minutes long and featur
[…]
es new tracks in the tradition of electro-acoustic music, ambient and electronica.
While there are plenty of interactive works and games that entertain by providing puzzle solving, action and slapstick humour, the Zone is all about exploring the unknown territories of the mind. If you feel that issues such as philosophy, poetry, metaphysics and art is your cup of tea, the story might interest you. If not, the irreal meanderings of the Zone is best left alone.
Force majeure: The Zone is produced by Leo Nordwall in cooperation with Interacting Arts and Fabel FÃ¶rlag.
Features
- Enjoy an emotional, philosophical and metaphysical experience
- Explore more than 60 locations
- Listen to over 70 minutes of soundtrack in CD-quality
- See several minutes of live video footage
- Independently produced
Note: The download link will take you to the game web site, as there are several versions available.

Credits

629.name: Silent Knight: Chapter 2 - The Conscience of the King
629.description:
Second chapter in the Silent Knight series.
After escaping the prison Alcatrash our hero is sent out by King Arnold of Calithulhu to kill the dragon that killed his son in law. Unfortunatly King Arnold is running on a low budget so our hero has to make some preparations before he can leave  Calithulhu...

Credits

627.name: Power Unlimited boardgame
627.description:
Computer version of the PU boardgame.

Credits

626.name: Slug Princess
626.description:
You play a young girl who is about to marry the Prince, when an evil Witch materializes and kidnaps the Queen, sends the Prince into a 100 year sleep and then transmogrifies our heroine into a Slug. Your task is to find a fabled Gem and return it to the King so as to pay the Queen's ransom.
This game is also included as a sub-adventure-game in 'Crave'. It was supposed to be just a couple of screens and one puzzle. However, as things do, it grew and grew into a complete little adventure that stands up on it's own. For that reason I'm releasing it on it's own, and also for anyone who, for whatever reasons, don't wish to find it in 'Crave'.
The game is written in the style of mid 1980's early graphic adventures, and deliber
[…]
ately has some of the pitfalls games of that era were prone to.

Credits

624.name: Crave
624.description:
This is the story of Cacoe, a stick man made of chalk, with special X-Ray vision. Whilst reading a newspaper he comes across an article about someone called Fenelda, this triggers a very early memory in his life, and he sets off to the Hotel Carnaby to investigate.
Crave contains nude scenes and adult themes, and is not suitable for everybody, be warned.
There is also a complete 1980's parody sub-adventure game included within the main adventure called 'Slug Princess', in which a young girl is transformed into a slug and has to find a magical gem in order to save her love, the prince.

623.name: La Gran Castanya
623.description:
A boy goes out with his friends one night, his objective is to drink alcohol without stopping.
The problem is that it finished in a hospital without remembering anything, something logical on the other hand.
The game is in Catalan, soon the game in English.

622.name: Chalk's Quest
622.description:
This game was actually an entry for MAGS but I thought it would fit to this category better. :D
By the way, this game was made in about two hours so you know what to expect ;)

620.name: Alien Time Zone
620.description:
You play Ejak, an alien traveller who has crash landed and got himself stuck in a cave on Earth. Use your time travelling abilities to help him escape! The game is available to download as a ZIP or RAR and both include the MIDI music that features within the game.

Credits

619.name: The Dark Trial
619.description:
The Dark Trial is an adventure game that takes place in Hell.
You are Hilia Derole, who got a chance to become a real angel, but he must comlete a trial:
He must reach the very depths of hell, and have to look into the Mirror of Souls....
This is only the demo version, contains the first three stages of the whole game.

618.name: Horror Hospital Incomplete Demo
618.description:
Horror Hospital Incomplete Demo
Created with the AGS Engine, the DeusEx editor combined with 3d models taken from Half-Life, Max Payne and other games.
Taking place in a haunted hospital strange things happen to our hero Phil that would make most break down and cry. He, however, is determined to get him and other sane ones out of this damned hospital.
Unfortunately after filefront upgraded their services this file got deleted, unfortunately this was also the only place to get it from. I am currently unable to find it in my old back-ups so it might be gone forever.
However if you happen to find this old demo on your system or somewhere online please let me know so it can be put back
[…]
up on the net. The filename somewhat resembled: "horrorhospitaldemothingy.rar"

Credits

617.name: Frog Island
617.description:
Frog Island is a short adventure game about a creature stuck on an island with a gigantic frog, an unhappy banjo player and good rhythms!

616.name: Soviet Unterzögersdorf
616.description:
People of the world, you, who sit in your superficially secure third countries!
Soviet Unterzögersdorf (pronounced «oon-taa-tsee-gars-doorf») is the last existing appanage republic of the USSR. The enclave maintains no diplomatic relationship with the surrounding so-called «Republic of Austria» or with the Fortress «European Union». The downfall of her motherland -- the Soviet Union -- in the early 1990s had a particularly bad effect on the country's economic situation.
It is a great challenge to secure survival for the small but proud confederation. External reactionary forces put the country in danger. It's a lack of respect due to a morally corrupted and perhaps even non-existing u
[…]
nity of the peoples. The goal of a glorious future is almost unreachable.
But there are a handful of people who don't give up on a vision for a better tomorrow. Let us tell you the stories of the brave citizens in the beautiful little country of Soviet Unterzögersdorf.
It's a story that will go into history.
Game for IBM PC.
Windows or Linux/BSD.
Russian with English or German subtitles.
Appealing graphical game interface.
Creative Commons License.

Credits

615.name: Magsic II

The sequel to Magsic. Quaver and Ear get separated during a storm at sea. Help Quaver to find 9 magical tunes by solving numerous puzzles on a curious desert island.

614.name: Maniac Mansion Mania - Episode 9 - radioactive

Bernard gets the honorable task, to remove a radioactive threat in the foxcave.
The major of Ronville personally asks Bernard for help.
At first Bernard has to decontaminate the cellar, at the same time Bernard tries to improve his mark in chemistry.
Whether Bernard will have success?
Fortunately there is his helpful neighbor Hoagie, who is a good friend in hard times.

613.description:
You must fill the plucky shoes of Oswald West, famed treasure hunter. He's just managed to recover the long-lost Eggplant Emerald, but he has a problem: his expedition left for home without him. 610.description:
In ESPER: The Town on the Edge of darkness, you play as Ian McDermott, head investigator of the ESPER society, a group dedicated to the exploration and revelation of paranormal and occult activity. You have been called to the prison cell of one Mr. Frederick Stiles, who has been imprisoned for murdering a young girl. Stiles is your CLIENT, however, and he claims that the girl was already dead at the time he killed her! Investigate Noman Island, where perpetual night overshadows some strange and dangerous events, and see if you can help bring peace to a man who has visited...
THE TOWN ON THE EDGE OF DARKNESS
NOTE: The mirror site no longer functions.

609.name: C.U.T.E. The Marvellous Adventures of Princess Marian part VII

The FUTURE! The Constabulary for Universal Time Enforcement police the sphere of Time Travel, making sure that naughty people dont go back and kill other people's parents, etc. Top operative Sara is at thier headquarters, preparing for a new mission. Meanwhile, President of the Universe Alba prepares to make her inaugral address...

606.name: Magsic

605.name: Knight's Quest III - Tides of Merania
605.description:
Knight's Quest III is a story set between three different characters and three different realms. It tells the story of a King and his two best knights as they struggle to recover the three Pentagrams needed to defeat the mighty overlord, before he destroys all they hold dear.
Action is split between three countries: the freezing wastes of the Black Hand Republic, the quaint villages of Althador and the bizarre islands of Merania. YOU control the mighty King Althos, the useless Sir Frank and the overtly sexual Sir Roberto as they quest to save their beloved homeland.
Journey to amazing places, the ancient peak of the Guru, the canyon of a thousand Bandits and eve
[…]
n the lost city of Crackton...
The prequel to the legendary Knight's Quest IV, and sequel to two games that haven't been made yet, KQIII combines multi-character gaming with subtle humour and epic cliches.
Traverse the vast distances of the land and face the almighty terrors that lurk behind every corner. No one can be trusted, and everyone can be saved as Frank and his comrades fight for justice in a world where nothing is right, and one man can make a difference.

Credits

604.name: The Oracle (Demo)
604.description:
What are friends for?  That's precisely why you decide to help out a friend who's in over his head.  But you never expected this...
Your friend Alex goes missing, an array of notes and clues left behind, pointing to his possible whereabouts.  The story of an elusive mystical gate connecting our world to another may be more than simple lore.  An artifact so powerful you wish you had never laid eyes on it.  And the key to all three lies in--the Oracle.
The Oracle is a first-person perspective, photo-realistic adventure game, shot on-location in North America and Europe.
Comments are greatly appreciated!
UPDATE!!!
The full
[…]
length version has now been released!  See below...

584.name: Jessica Plunkenstein and the Düsseldorf Conspiracy

It's been a peculiar day for Jessica Plunkenstein. By a freak twist of fate and airline security, our heroine finds herself battling evil barons bent on world domination, evil headmistresses bent on pathological propriety, and evil yodelers bent on nothing in particular. Full of llamas, ninjas, French people, pickled herring, dubious German accents, yetis in heat, and musical theatre up the wazoo, Jessica's adventures bring her from the Amazonian Rain Forests to the Norwegian Alps with layovers along the Eastern seaboard. So tag along, and you, too, can unravel The Düsseldorf Conspiracy in what the New York Times calls the Best Adventure Game of 2005!
Features:
*  Zany intercontinental escapades wit
[…]
h absolutely no mammoths or talking robots

Welcome to the world of spacewar. You are Manaken Spacewalker the best young apprentice Medai counsil has ever had. 576.name: Valis - !!! Updated Demo !!! V1.10
576.description:
In the land of Valis, an evil force has released physical entities who use the Kundalini powers to steal human souls. They are called the Tamashii-seishin. Only those who have trained in their chakra powers can defeat them (the Ruahs). You play the role of two Ruah monks who are trying to restore order to Valis.
Valis is a RPG in the Final Fantasy mould.
The demo features a world map, 2 towns where you can visit bars, guilds, shops and other places of interest. You can equip various weapons and accessories to your characters. You fight monsters in turn-based battles and level-up your characters and their abilities (called chakras in the game).
The story is based on the Hindu mythology of Ku
[…]
ndalini. Kundalini is a condensed, primal force which lies dormant in us all. When released, it creates a vertical connection between 7 chakras located along our spine. Each chakra has a different property which in the game represents different powers for your characters (earth,water,fire,air,sound,light and thought).
In the land of Valis, an evil force has released physical entities who use the Kundalini powers to steal human souls. They are called the Tamashii-seishin. Only those who have trained in their chakra powers can defeat them (the Ruahs). You play the role of two Ruah monks who are trying to restore order to Valis.
This won't be easy because not only are the Tamashii very powerful but most Ruahs are corrupt. Knowing full well that the rest of the world depends on them, they have formed a guild which now controls everything and they are not about to let you ruin it for them!
The full game will feature:
- turn-based battles
- non-linear quests with a reward system which gives you money and items depending on how well the quest went.
- town to town trading system in the Elite mould
- 12 towns to visit each with unique locations
- upgradable powers: choose how you spend your experience points Do you improve an existing power or do you save up for a brand new one?
- 7 different types of monsters and each of them with varying levels of experience to match your own strength so battles are always a challenge.
- 4 playable characters
- a gripping storyline with tons of dialogues

548.name: Elevator, Rise from the Abyss
548.description:

This game should run fine on most versions of Windows.
=======
This game "Elevator - Rise From the Abyss" is in-complete, but it's a much improved-upon and expanded game based on the original "The Elevator" game concept ("Rise from the Abyss" probably has about 30 - 40 minutes of playtime). I don't think I'll ever get around to finishing that project, but as I had already put in a lot of time and work into it, I thought it would be a shame if no one ever got to see it, so, there it is
[…]
now, get it while you can :)
*** Warning: "The Elevator - Rise From The Abyss" is meant for adult players and may contain scenes of violence, gore, nudity, sex, profanity, etc... so, play at your discretion.
* Yes, I did "borrow" the graphics from other sources for these projects (Such as the Silent-Hill, Half-Life, Obscure games), which was supposed to be "place-holder" graphics (and in reflecting on it, I probably shouldn't have).  The game was just a free non-profit project I made for fun.

547.name: Knight's Quest IV - Here Today, Gone to Yesterday
547.description:
All is not well in the land of Althador, and as Chief Knight Sir Frank Ebeaut-Behab makes his way out to the forest for an urgent meeting with the King, he has no idea what awaits him. And when the King is mysteriously killed, it is up to him to save the realm from disaster...
And so Frank sets out on an epic journey across the regions of space and time. He searches high and low for the King in his past, desperate to know the secret for which he gave his life.
Along the way he meets old friends and mysterious strangers. And of course the beautiful princess, of whom Frank is forever in pursuit. Will he ever win her heart? What is the dark secret Althos died for? And how did a wimp lik
[…]
e Frank become Chief Knight? All will be revealed...

Credits

545.name: Hero of Infamous Kingdoms
545.description:
This is an April Fools game by the following teams (Hero6, IA, Crystal Shard, Code Name Entertainment, and Project Katrina). Hero of Infamous Kingdoms is an oldskool adventure game where you must save a Tomato-less kingdom in order to become a Hero!
This game features art and music from the original projects, funny dialogue and an optional voice pack. The entire game was completed in a month.

Credits

544.name: Ahmet's AGS Fight Game 2009 - Source Code
544.description:
Current version: 2009 v1.0
This is the 2009 version of Ahmet's AGS Fight Game, which was originally coded
for The Great Stroke-Off! in 2005. Instead of an update on the old scripts, I have
decided to re-make everything.
The main difference between the 2005 and 2009 versions:
2005 version was scripted by a highschool student,
2009 version is made by a 3rd grade computer sciences student ^^
Other important differences:
*Compatibility with the latest AGS
*Basic Newton physics in order to maintain a more fluent gameplay
(like acceleration and surface friction)
*Stamina system: The player won't be able to keep attack
[…]
buttons pressed and gain an unproportionate advantage
*Comprehensible variables: Easier to understand the codes
*Health and stamina bars
Usage notes:
*You need some basic AGS and coding knowledge in order to implement this source game  into your own AGS game. Variable and structure names are intelligible English words or
physics terms.
*Scripts are based on AGS room objects, instead of AGS characters.
*Appoint your fighting character views into 'int player_view' and 'enemy_view' variables
TO-DO's:
I believe this version is sufficient for a good fight scene in your adventure game,
because of its simplicity, but I guess there will be developers who would need more
advanced features like those;
*Jumping enemy
*Direction changes. Defaultly, player is on leftside and enemy is on rightside. It isn't possible yet player jumping over the enemy and the opponents changing sides.
*Combo system
*Crouchings
Terms of Use:
You may use this source game in your own (both freeware and commercial) projects,
just don't forget to mention my name in credits.

Credits

543.name: Stan's Revenge
543.description:
You play as Stan. He has been bullied all his life beacuse he got a big head, big eyes and a small body. It's time for action...

542.name: Lifeboat: Story of Cedrick: The Directors Ultimate Super Cut Edition
542.description:
What actually happened to the dread pirate, Black Peter? In this day of modern sea-faring, pirates are a rarity, hunted to extinction by the fierce... guys who don't like them or something or other. Black Peter, the most dreaded pirate in all of the seven and a half seas, went on his way, taking a vacation from his scurvy-lubbin' piratin' ways, aboard the cruise-liner HMS Titanic II during its maiden voyage. But the ship was lost with all hands.
What happens next? Are the rumours true about his untimely demise? Or did he survive? Is the story of Cedrick what really happened, or is it all, a lie?!

Credits

541.name: The 7th Sense
541.description:
The 7th sense is something far beyond intuition.....
This little game is based upon the popular anime "Saint Seiya", also known as "Knights of the Zodiac". It's not too related to the original story, and doesn't follow any of the episodes plot.
You play as Seiya of Pegasus, involved in a strange and apparently incoherent situation, with everything going wrong, and no apparent explanation.
The game is very short, you should be able to finish it in 20 minutes.
March, 15, 2005: Added an Italian translation and an Italian Manual, both in the main download.

540.name: Great Stroke Off!, The
540.description:
"The Great Stroke-Off" Adventure Game!
Brought to you by Team:
*** Old School Point n' Click ***
(ATC Deluxe Edition Winners)
------------------------------------------
This game is heavy on the "humor" side of things, with a variety of wacky characters, interesting scenes to explore, and an amusing, unique and interesting storyline.
The setting of the story takes place in a type of small "Amusement Park" called "Stickz & Ballz". The main attraction of the park is the Mini-Golf Course (thus the Stickz & Ballz name), as well as a Haunted House of Mirrors and a Video Arcade, plus a large shop with snacks and souvenirs as well as more areas to explore.
The mai
[…]
n character in the game that the player will control, goes by the name of Ned Flobolid.
Ned (who is around 16 years old) is working during his "summer-break" at the "Stickz & Ballz" amusement park, which is owned and operated by his Uncle Ernie. His parents gave him the choice to either work there for his Uncle during the summer, or to attend tutoring lessons at summer-school. So, Ned choose to work at the amusement park.
The story takes place during the day of "The Great Stroke-Off Competition", in which teams are competing to win the trophy. During the opening scenes of the game, Uncle Ernie will tell Ned "Half of a Proverb", and make it as a riddle for Ned to solve. So, in the course of the game, Ned will also find the "answer to the riddle of the proverb" as well.
Ned will have to do various tasks, solve various puzzles (some a bit bizarre), and interact with a few other characters in the game as the story unfolds.
At one point during the game, Ned can choose to help and befriend one of two opposing teams (One team being a group of "Nerds" and the other team a group of "Punks").  Deciding on which team Ned decides to help win the competition, will decide on what different puzzles Ned may have to solve as well as affecting the direction of the story.
*Note:  This game should run fine on most versions of Windows.

Short is our hero. He is also approximately 4 feet tall, and made of blue sticks. Help him to escape from the mysterious blue room that he finds himself trapped inside, in this year's epic adventure, ShortCUT!

508.name: Missing since Midnight
508.description:
"Missing since Midnight" is an entry for the February 2005 MAGS with the topic "Hotel".
MSM takes part in a more than 400 years old half-timbered house that the owner has made into a hotel. You are playing Tim Buktu, a private detective who just wanted to go for a holiday. But then someone is missing and you are asked to help searching for the missing person.

* more than 6000 words (40 kb of texts)
Since the game is very text-laden, so it will take about one to two hours to finish the g
[…]
ame when not cancelling the dialogs.
I don't know how long I've been working on this game but it must have been more than 40 hours.
I started the game on February 6th and finished it just two minutes before midnight (CET) on February 25th.
UPDATE (March 2nd) V 1.05:
* some typos and other text mistakes corrected
* some new animation phases: Tim can tip over the bucket now, and Freds eats and looks at Mel and Tim during supper
* sentences for unhandled events like talking to an object/hotspot added

* some minor bugs corrected, now Tim can't go outside on Day 1 and the starting of the scene with the talking radio set has been changed, so that it can't be cancelled mistakenly that easy
* during all cut-scenes that can be cancelled by ESC or a right mouse click the status bar is switched off
* the Intro sequence has been a bit refurbished
WARNING: Because of the new animation phases older savegames won't work with the new version.
For the future I've planned to maybe make a voice pack (depending on how much time I've got).

So, here's the lowdown: You play Supergirl, who just came into this town where the local superhero just happens to be, eh, Supergirl -- a musclebound, seven-foot-tall, neon-blue-haired Supergirl. Believe it or not, everyone in tow
[…]
n (except one person) thinks the fake is the real Supergirl, and that she's the greatest superhero ever. Why are they so convinced of this? Well, there hasn't been a crime in two months. And there isn't a single criminal to be found in the whole town either.
Your job as Supergirl is to expose the imposter Supergirl for what she is, put a stop to her plans, and find out what happened to the criminals of the city.

The Story:
The Company is an extremely powerful organization, and they believe they are the supreme force in the Galaxy. Anything that is unfortunate enough to draw their attention, becomes a new toy  for them to control.  All great power causes fear, and fear causes actions, and actions cause counter actions, and counter actions cause measures to be taken.  The Company, having enough of these petty
[…]
games, unleashed the final word in all Company affairs, The Company Man.
Floyd SB is the one and original Company Man.  The Company provides him with everything he desires.  All he has to do in return, is complete every damn fool mission they assign to him.  It's up to him to take out the trash, and it has never occurred to him to ask what's inside the garbage bag.
In this mission you play Floyd as he is ordered sneak onboard the Starship Longshot and remove the Prime Minister of Bubba Star Six from the picture.  This sounds like a walk in the park, and maybe it is, and maybe it's not.

* Christmas 2004 present for my wife
* Alba sings not once but twice in this game!
* Thanks to CJ again, Alba, and the rest of the FOY team for not minding me ripping off some of the stuff from the demo

Credits

478.name: Alba the Explorer: Princess Marian part V
478.description:
Alba, Princess Marian's eldest daughter, tries to make a mothers day card. You can help her!
# Mother's day 2004 present for my wife
# Including real artwork by Alba herself
# Parody of "Dora the Explorer", Alba's favourite TV show

Credits

477.name: The Paparazzi Prince
477.description:
Genre: Romantic Comedy
Very short game, but has three possible endings!
It's time for Prince Willy to get married. This could be his great chance to step out of the shadows of all the scandalous royal rascals of Europe, and become a hot target for paparazzis himself. Are you up to making a big scandal and unlocking the hardest ending, to become a Paparazzi Prince?

Credits

476.name: Barn Runner 4: The Prick Who Came In From the Cold
476.description:
It's snowing, you're freezing, you're a hundred miles from home and you're locked out of your flying car.
The future ain't what it used to be.
Barn Runner: The Prick Who Came In From the Cold is the fourth game in the Barn Runner series which began as terribly misguided spoof of Blade Runner / Escape From New York / and The Andy Griffith Show. It's the far future imagined through the filter of the 1980s!
The game has a Christmas theme (sort of) and centers around a lazy, egocentric policeman in the distant future tasked with hunting down and destroying runaway robots who have had it with lazy, overbearing humanity and finally vented their mechanical rage on their hapless owners and anyone els
[…]
e within easy reach.
Naturally, like all humanity in the future, the cop hates his job and doesn't really put a lot of effort into it. So it's up to you to make him accomplish anything.
Don't worry, this isn't an action-oriented game and there are no arcade sequences. It only sounds terribly exciting, but rest easy: It isn't exciting in the least.
I hope you enjoy my game. It isn't the greatest but I certainly could have done much, much worse. (And have on several occasions!)

Credits

475.name: The McReed Case: Interrogation BETADEMO
475.description:
Finally (speaking for myself that is) the first sort of official release concerning MRC2; this betademo that is.
No further commentary, apart from PLEASE report me the bugs and such, and give feedback on what you like and what you think I should change.
NOTE: Most of the inventory interaction replies are still missing.

Credits

474.name: The Legacy of Taft Demo
474.description:
A wonderful demo about William Howard Taft.
It's a happy day in FAttington when-Taft's family is taken away by aliens and eaten for dinner. Taft is sent into the future, and much mayhem ensues. This is the first program ever made by Eternia Games.

Credits

473.name: Lost In The Nightmare - Demo
473.description:
A horror adventure game with first person view by Ahmet "CoolBlue-Gord10" Kamil Keles with cut-scenes using cinematical camera pitches.
Pre-rendered 3D backgrounds taken from the Half-Life engine are used in Lost In The Nightmare. I'm preparing the HL maps with Valve Hammer Editor by myself and using modified versions of the textures and models of the mods like They Hunger, Medieval World.
Story:
The main character is Burak Guney, a private dedective who used to work for the police. You are hired to find three university students who got lost in a forest near the Karabalta Town while camping. They have been lost for 3 months and the police couldn't find any clue what happened to them. You'll stay
[…]
in Karatas Hotel during your investigate. But soon you will learn that something is wrong with this cursed town....
The game includes both English and Turkish translation.
Thanks to Ankara Ataturk High School 10-FL class :)

Credits

472.name: Project Xenophobe
472.description:
Game was updated to v1.1 (12. 6. 2005)
You are choosen for a mission to find out, what is happening in a top secret military base.

Credits

471.name: Other Worlds
471.description:
Other Worlds is a traditional game which took me 3.5 years to complete. It is a 3rd person, point & click adventure that looks and plays like the late 80s Sierra / LucasArts productions. My intention was to create the best amateur freeware game ever in terms of gameplay.
Features:
-More than 150 locations to explore
-More than 40 characters to interact with
-Dozens of inventory items
-The infamous A.L.K.I.S. interface (A.L.K.I.S. stands for Advanced Language Kit and Interface System)
-An intriguing, humorous story full of surprises and plot twists
-A large number of challenging puzzles
[…]
/>

Credits

470.name: James Bond - Who wants to live again?
470.description:
You are James Bond and someone kills you while you are in bed with Janine, you're current girlfriend. But you have luck. A man called A offers you the possibility to live again, but he wants you to do something on earth before you can live again. The only problem is that you're dead enemy Clawman has been offerd the same possibility to live again by a man called Z. And Clawman tries to kill you and to destroy the earth. Will you manage to give James Bond his life back?

Credits

469.name: The Hamlet
469.description:
A middle-aged bachelor receives a letter from a friend of his living in a small hamlet saying that he would like him to come for a visit. Not having anything to worry about, the protagonist accepts and immediately drives off to the hamlet. However, upon arrival he senses that something is not at all right...
The game features:
15 locations drawn in beautiful 320*200
Digital soundtrack featuring 7 haunting tracks
Story that will keep you playing till the very end
4 fully animated characters with close-ups
***Made for the AGS Team Challenge held in summer 2004***

Credits

466.name: PocketFluff.Yay!
466.description:
The Lucksmiths are a band from Melbourne.
Jasmine loves the Lucksmiths.
Satan Hates the Lucksmiths.
Need I say more?
How about pelican, lamington and Micorrhyza?

Credits

465.name: Constance the Barbarian
465.description:
Constance the Barbarian - A humourous take on Conan the Barbarian/Xena Warrior Princess, with a dash of Monkey Island.
Originally made for September 04 MAGS, and as a learning project. But decided to make it as a demo/teaser for a larger more involved game. I won't hazard a release date at this point. I'm mostly improving my artwork skills.

Credits

464.name: Box
464.description:
An Hour Game for which the theme was:
1. Game must feature worship in some way.
2. Game must feature breasts in some way.
3. Game should feature a box in some way.

Credits

463.name: Day of Darkness
463.description:
Marty is on his way home after a night drinking, when he is kidnapped. He wakes to find himself in a cellar. Obviously, the objective is to escape. It's only a small game

Credits

461.name: Lifeboat: Story of Cedrick
461.description:
This is the story of Cedrick. This is the story of an armless midget, lost at sea after the sinking of the sea-vessel he was aboard and his plea to survive.
Can you help him survive this ordeal?! FIND OUT!

Credits

460.name: Melrin: The Dragon Menace
460.description:
This is the third Melrin game. This time a rumour has reached the royal court that a dragon is pestering the country side. The king sends out Melrin to investigate.
To solve the many puzzles that exist in this game you need to create magic spells and combine many inventory items.
The GUI is simular to the earlier games. You have your magic bowl in which you mix items to create the spells that you can read about in your Book of Spells. You also have a magic map, look at it (right click) to use it.

Credits

459.name: Fortress of Wonders
459.description:
Join forces with a sexy barbarian against the evil that looms above the land.

Credits

458.name: Everlot-Demo
458.description:
Join the Knave on his quest to find out his identity and save the Emperor! (download the  file AND the mirror and expand it and put all the files in the 2 folders into a new folder because the @#^%ers at MSN wont let me upload anything more than a Megabyte)

Credits

455.name: Abducted: 10 Minutes!!!
455.description:
You play Detective Michael Ebb, from the City Police. Back in 1974, while working for the International Police, you sent a bunch of terrorists to jail.
One day, watching the news at home, the bulletin is interrupted with an important message for you: the terrorists are back to haunt you!!!
They've got your 20 year old daugther and threaten to kill her in ten minutes. As there's no time to assemble a rescue squad, you head over to the place where the terrorists were last seen in a desperate rescue attempt.

Credits

453.name: A Tale of Betrayal
453.description:
Betrayed by your own Ogres!
Bound to your own ship!
Destined to the very unknown!
What happened? Why? How will you save your soul of what is destined to be?
Do you posses the wit and wisdom to prevail over this fantasy adventure?
Play A Tale Of Betrayal now and unveil the answers yourself!
Featuring:
- Multiple Endings
- Verb Coin Interface
- (640 x 480) Hi-Resolution Scenes
- Lots of Animations and Challenging Puzzles
- More than 7,000 words in Dialogue and Descriptions

Credits

452.name: The Artifact - Demo
452.description:
Erik, a photographer from Sweden, has just got onboard the ship Victoria. Erik is heading to Great Britain to find out about an artifact he recently recieved. The trip seems more like a holiday at first...

Credits

451.name: Black Cauldron Remake
451.description:
A remake of the classic game Black Cauldron. You play the part of the young Taran, Assitant Pig-Keeper of the great sage Dallben. Your quest will be to keep the oracular pig Hen Wen safe from the forces of evil and to eventually destroy the evil Black Cauldron.

Credits

450.name: Escape From Evergreen Forest
450.description:
You go by the name of "Don".  You went for a walk in the woods to enjoy a nice day.
You day-dream of exciting adventures in far-off lands, and not paying attention as you should,
you soon end up deep in Evergreen Forest.
You remember old Folk-Tales about Evergreen Forest...
Some stories tell of strange creatures, magical things, as well as many dangers and hidden treasures.
But those are just stories made up to entertain... or are they?
Well, enough day-dreaming.. Time to find your way out of here.
Now which way to go?
A few highlights of my game to note:
*Currently the game has over 30 rooms to explore.
*The game display is design
[…]
ed for 640x400 mode in 16-bit color.
*GUI to select Game Speed and Music Controls settings.
*Hopefully easy-to-use interface (I also took advantage of the wheel-mouse functions too, but don't worry, players with a non-wheeled mouse still have all the same options).
*1 main player character with 7+ appearing (and mostly interactive) NPCs.
*A story that starts out simply enough, but turns into something deeper as the game is played through.
*Various puzzles to solve/overcome, some of which can be solved in different ways.
*I tried to avoid "pixel hunting" or "walking dead-man" scenarios.
*A couple of "Easter egg" type of surprises.
*Some "Guest Appearances" by some famous well known Adventurers.
*Possible "Player Can Die" scenarios if bad/incorrect choices are made.
*Use of a couple of fantastic Plug-Ins to great effect (Rain and Flashlight - well in my game it's a Lantern though).
* A detailed ReadMe.txt file will be included.
* Good vs. Evil, Magic, strange creatures, cool music and sound effects, drama, humor, action, a scantily-clad seductive temptress, Earthquakes, Lightning, Explosions, Destruction,  ... overall an action packed thrill ride   What more could ya want?
* Complete the game with a Perfect Score of 65 points, and unlock a "Bonus Adventure" in which you get to play as a certain famous "Archeologist".
Okay, Indy, hand me the whip please... *Crack!* Now go and play Escape From Evergreen Forest and get a perfect score.
*Note: It was brought to my attention of a problem in the game that I missed that can "crash/ lock-up" the game. If you open the Inventory window (your Back-Pack), and if you try to interact with the main playing area again before clicking the "OK" button of the Inventory window to close it first, the game may "crash / lock-up" on you. I'm sorry for this error, so for now, please keep in mind while playing to always click the "OK" button of the Inventory window to close it before trying to interact with the main playing area again. Thanks for understanding.
Tech Note: This game should run fine on most versions of Windows and on just about any modern computer system. If you have an older/slower computer, check out the "ReadMe.txt" file that comes included with the game's files for tips on how to improve the game's performance.

Credits

449.name: A Magic Stone
449.description:
You play as Nolan, a young man who is half human and half elve. He is send to find a magic stone, a dangerous magic object.
This game is half Point&Click Adventure and half RPG.

Credits

448.name: Exile source
448.description:
This is the source file of my game Exile, where you can see how all the scripting was done.

Credits

447.name: Dragon Tales
447.description:
It's a story about a newborn dragon looking for his parents who are locked in infamous Dungeons of Minestrola. Help this poor creature and use wisdom, might and magic to release his parents from evil wizards hands!

Credits

446.name: Asporia: Hidden Threat
446.description:
-NEWS-:
The source code of this game is released.
You can have it from the "Download mirror URL".
A RPG using pre-rendered 3D graphics by Ahmet (CoolBlue-Gord10) Kamil Keles. I've used the engine, textures and models of Half-Life and some mods for creating pre-rendered 3D backgrounds.
PREFERENCES
*2 different endings changed by your decisions in the game.
*Gaining exp. for weapons or magic.
*Random events.
*Turn-based fight system.
*FPS view
*Cut-scenes with cinematical camera pitches
STORY
We had been walking for a long time and we were too tired... I was going to the Flea Castle, an outpost of our kingdom in the Kreatia Forest
[…]
, with my knight friends fast. Because we had a very important report to give. The Black Poison (another name; the Armies of Darkness) was gathering again on the south of our kingdom according on the rumors, and we were sent to research it. The Black Poison was banished from Asporia by the human, elf and dwarf alliance 50 years ago. In these days, only a few mages who wears black robes and small groups of trovgs were left in Asporia.
But the things that we saw on the south was terrible. The evil rages like night elves, vampires had appeared again and an army, which includes the strong rages like trovgs, hartsies, was getting prepared. So, we were taking this report to the kingdom in a hurry. Because the country wasn't ready for such a big war, so the war preparations should be started immediately.
Our journey to the kingdom was hard. We had got lost our horses, goods and most of our friends in the small wars during our journey.
May them sleep in peace...
We had just entered the Kreatia Forest that night and we needed some rest.  Commander Scorth decided to have camp in the forest.
Commander Scorth...
I liked him as if he was my father. My real father was a soldier who works for the kingdom, too. He was killed by a magic user who wears the black robe.
We needed some wood for the camp fire, and it was my turn to collect wood that night. So I had set out to find some wood to the east.
You'll play as a knight called Arleon who can fight and use magic in the game.  If you use your weapons often, then you'll gain battle exp's. So you can play the game two times, as a mage or a fighter. There will be lots of events, but I don't want to spoil.
Check the web site for more screen-shots
A little note: The game's number is 446. It's also my school number. Nice change :)

Credits

445.name: Norbi's quest
445.description:
Norbi is a bassguitar player, and his amplifier has broken.  He has to find a way to fix it.
It was our first game made in AGS. Made in five days. The game has six rooms and easy puzzles.

Credits

444.name: Stranger By Night
444.description:
A serial killer known as 'The Stranger' has been butchering young women throughout the past months. Without any leads, authorities are at a dead end. One night, Katrina Rose, a reporter for the New York Times, receives a phone call from an informant, offering information about The Stranger. Katrina accepts, and agrees to meet in a specified location later. What happens next leads Katrina into a night of unspeakable terror. Katrina must outwit and outrun the crazed murderer in an attempt to get through the next day in one piece....

Credits

443.name: Sierra Quest 1: Roberta In Love
443.description:
You play the part of a young Roberta Williams who is trying to get her game company started.  She needs a loan to start Sierra-On-Line, but in order to do that, she must show the bank some solid game ideas.  Help her get some ideas that will eventually become classics.  This is a great short game that is amusing in concept.  Have fun.

Credits

442.name: Monster from the hounted hill
442.description:
Short and funny (hopefuly) tale about an ugly man living in a castle above the village and whom all of the villagers consider a monster, and his quest to find himself a woman of his dreams.

Credits

441.name: Ray and the Guitar
441.description:
You play as Ray Gunn, a rising guitarist who comes home early from work one day to play his guitar. He accidently trips and falls on it! When he plugs it in his amp, it doesn't seem to play. You need to help Ray get a new guitar!
This is my first entry for MAGS ,August 2004 .
I made this in literally a couple hours. Young me was not very responsible.

Credits

440.name: Petals around the Rose
440.description:
The Classic game of Petals around the Rose converted to AGS

Credits

439.name: Planet Xmas [MAGS]
439.description:
December MAGS - Planet Xmas
This is a small game made for the MAGS competition in December, starring Murray (from Monkey Island 3), the demonic talking skull, as the main character.
The game lands him (literally) on a planet inhabited by koalas and badgers, aswell as many other creatures, probably, who, not surprisingly, also possess the gift of speech.
Will Murray succeed in his quest to return home to earth, and will he be able to save the earth (well, the planet) on his way?
Guest stars: Manny Calavera (from Grim Fandango) and Largo LeGrande (from Monkey Island 2).

Credits

438.name: Nightmare Demo
438.description:
You are Martin, a young college graduate. One day, a letter from your grandmother comes in the mail. Using the directions inside the letter, you reach her cabin. You open the door, but you hear someone else. Then, nothing is as it seems...
This is a demo I made in 2004... 17 years ago.

437.name: The Mystery of the Art School
437.description:
The Art School, a legendary institute deep inside the city of Toledo, a peaceful place until a promising pupil gets desappeared. Play as Willtif Smothson, a student of the Art School who gets involved into an adventure that will never forget.
In Spanish only... in English soon.
The install program of game is divided into eight minor files wit the program known as Hacha (available in .zip at my website too)
Lycos doesn't allow to download from another websites... (they're bad) so better go directly to game's website. Sorry
Walk through the classes of the Art School, meet the students, and the teachers that makes this place unique. The Mystery of the Art School is based on the real Art Schoo
[…]
l of Toledo in Spain, most of characters are based on real partners and teachers I had at the Art School (I forgot to tell, I studied at the real Art School), but the story is NOT based on real facts. Discover what happens at the mysterious Art School.

436.name: Melrin: The Pendant Quest
436.description:
Our hero Melrin returns. This time he has the find the royal pendant that has been stolen or a curse will destroy his land by fire and water.
Unlike in the first game, Melrin: The Disciple Ordeal, you can't die in this one. You must however create a lot of magic spells using you magic book and your portable couldron.

434.name: Virtual Piano 1.0

A Piano for your Pc.
But its a jokegame, because it is not very professional...

431.name: Second Moon Adventure VOL. I

The first Volume contains the parts I - VII of the SMA-series. The mystery of the green meteor which landed on earth becomes a problem: Every alien, who tries to solve the death of Noxi and the other killed aliens get also killed. But they figure out more and more... there are time travels, there is a mysterious sea snake........ play it and have fun!
(complete in german language!)

429.name: Locked Out
429.description:
Ben has been locked out of his house, but he needs to buy a birthday present for his girlfriend! Help him get inside the house so he can get his money and buy a present.

Credits

428.name: what is that

this is my first game submitted on agsforums.
that is all.

427.description:
You are a german shepherd dog called Rex who wants to go for a walk. There is a car crash and you must save Norah's life (your human friend) and find the driver of the car that hit her.
This game's graphics are made with MS Paint and the music is taken from RPG Maker 2000

426.description:
In this game you play the role of Frank who is a cat who just happens to be a burglar. He gets caught by the police and tells them about one of his jobs. The game is viewed like a flashback with frank talking in the past tense.

422.description:
Basically you play a crook who prints funny money, going by the name of Kevin Sanders, disguised a photocopying agency.
One day you get an anonomous call from some guy, warning you the cops are coming to bust your ass.
So what do you? Gather your stuff, fool some cops, a little GTA while you're at it, and you're a free man!

Play a board game with all your favorite game characters from demo quest. Roger, Ego and erm... Toadie, they're all in it.

419.name: Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator Case 2 - The Lost Galleon of the Salton Sea
419.description:
Ben Jordan is called out to the small California town of Dunesberg to investigate a man's disappearance while searching for the Lost Galleon - a legendary treasure ship said to be buried out in the middle of the desert.

418.name: The Chronicles of Max and Maggie
418.description:
This game was made in 14 days.
And that's not including most of those days when I was preparing for my English final project.  So I really did this in a bout 9 days.
I got a 94 on my project, but if this game was being graded, I would get a lot less than that.
You can choose to play as Max, or Maggie.  They each have different paths.  I think I put more effort into Max, but try both!
Here is a tip, talk to a lot of stuff, especially if you are playing as Max.  There are some pretty funny things I threw in there, including MY VOICE AS A SOUND EFFECT!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Also, READ the readme file.
The story is pretty clear in the intro, by the way.  Max
[…]
has to become a better actor to win the spot at the MAGS award wideos, and Maggie has to kill the guy who dosen't like him.
It is kind of a parody of "American Idol", or "Canadian Idol", or "(insert country here) idol."  Stupid reality shows...
(Just incase you don't know about the american one, the guy Maggie hates is the one known to be a very critical one, who hates everyone.);
Have fun playing.

417.name: Death and Transfiguration
417.description:
A short, disturbing game cataloguing the
journey of a sinner through the gates of Hell.
I don't know if I would call it an artistic game,
but it's certainly not mainstream.

Photo-realistic quality graphics (heh)
Digital music
Voice Acting

416.name: Totaskalan
416.description:
The game takes place millions of year before the birth of Earth... but not the birth of man. It is time of Barahas, the Great War- humanity (Aharlan, or Free Ones) and Yankasamyarutay (Sword and Wages) clash with the forces of North. You are a pilot on a war ship Allomena Ora, that have been summoned to Archaia system to defend its inhabitants.

415.name: Sword: The first remake

414.name: King Of Rock
414.description:
story:
Your name is Brian. Brian is a eager young boy that likes music and wants to become big one day.
Next weeks battle of the bands is your big break. There's just one problem. You have no band.
Well then. GET THEM TOGETHER! The band is missing a singer, a bass player and a drummer.  But that isn't the only obstacle. Let that be a surprise.

413.name: Integer Battleship
413.description:
This is a game I made for teaching students about Integer addition and subtraction. Nice guessing game for you to try out.  As before with the other ones, this was made for sixth graders during my student teaching semester.

410.description:

Carrot Bob's Spectrum has been stolen, you have to help him to get it back!

Comments welcome.

400.description:
Deat is going out for a walk:D

399.name: No-Action Jackson
399.description:
Help Jackson get his game on!
... c'mon!

398.name: Brad Bradson I: Key Quest
398.description:
Brad has lost his key and must find a way to get into his house... you control Brad through this daring, and treacherous journey!

397.name: Boyd's Music Mixer
397.description:
Now YOU can mix music just like a professional!

396.name: Monkey Island 5 : The Return of LeChuck Demo
396.description:
Guybrush Marley-Threepwood is on top of the world.
He's married to Elaine Marley, H.T. Marley is governing again, and best of all LeChuck is dead - well deader than before anyway - reduced to a smouldering crater on the front lawn.
Nothing can ruin his happiness now.
Or can it?
Join Guybrush once again, as he battles to rescue his wife, save the Carribean, and end the scourge of LeChuck once and for all in a final showdown.
And this time - he's finishing the job...
The game has changed drastically, so this is more to give you the flavour, rather than the taste.

[…]
download mirror contains a patch that the game may need to run on your computer.
--------------------------

395.name: Proof of Fiction

An american soldier is ordered to build a fake missile in Iraq.

393.description:
This game takes part in the future. Your task is to save the Universe from a lunatic professor. You'll do this by learning and using special abilities during the game.

IT IS THE YEAR 103752 AD.

FOR THOUSANDS OF YEARS THE UNIVERSAL GUILD OF MUSIC HAS PERFECTED THESE ABILITIES, WHICH DEPEND NOT ONLY ON THE INSTRUMENT BUT ALSO ON THE PL
[…]
AYER.
THEY USED THEIR ABILITIES TO INFLUENCE THE UNIVERSE POSITIVELY. BUT THEY ALSO KEPT THEM IN SECRET IN ORDER TO AVOID ANY FORM OF ABUSE.
THE PUPILS OF THE GUILD MUST FACE DIFFICULT TESTS AND STUDY FOR YEARS BEFORE THEY BECOME MASTERS. THESE MEASURES ARE NECESSARY TO DISALLOW EVIL-MINDED PERSONS FROM GETTING ACCESS TO THE GUILD.

UNTIL NOW.

392.name: The Alien and the Hick
392.description:
This is a very long cinematic and nothing else.
I got this idea while listening to Trapezoid's midis, playing with poser, and recording lines..
This was the end result..

391.name: Crap Quest
391.description:
This was made as a sort of satire/mock of the rush of craptacular "test" games that were being released back in late 2002.
Yea.. So I'm an ass.. Who cares?

390.name: Kidnapped
390.description:
This was made as a birthday present to my friends now ex-girlfriend.
Holly's boyfriend has gone missing. She wakes up with an empty house, and she must go find the evil fiends that did this to her.

389.name: The Holocaust Museum
389.description:
This was spawned from a Language Arts project in 8th grade. It's a "museum" of doors that open into a different picture from the holocaust.
There are voice-overs in each room flawlessly recorded by Grundislav.

388.name: Awakening of the Sphinx  DEMO
388.description:
Guide General Horemheb to explore 18th Dynasty Egypt and discover secrets and his destiny ...
The 18th Dynasty of Egypt is one of the most eventful. Tuthmoses IV had a dream as a boy that if he uncovered the Sphinx he would become Pharoah. Later in the dynasty, Akhenaten rejected the traditional polytheistic religion of Egypt and turned to workship Aten. He built a new capital at Amarna and the period of him and his two successors is known as "The Amarna period". Many, however, were angry at this blasphemy against the old gods and seceretly fought against it.
The game starts as our character, General Horemheb, a lowly born man who has worked his way up through the army, talks with Ay, Lord
[…]
Vizier to the Pharoah, but secretly against his new religion.  They discuss their feelings and Ay mentions that if the Pharoah was got rid of, he would become regent of the heir, Tutankhaten (Tutankhamun's name at the time) and could make Horemheb more powerful and grant him nobility if he helped him.
So, with this in mind, he returns to the army camp near the Sphinx and goes to sleep. In his dream, he has a vision of getting up and the Sphinx talking to him, just as happened with Tuthmosis before him. The Sphinx tells him that the power of the Great Pharaoh Khafre, a great magician and builder of the second pyramid of Giza, will be his to command if he does as the Sphinx says. The Sphinx says that it is angry at the blasphemy of the Pharaoh and wishes to destroy him. It tells of a secret chamber in the second pyramid, never found by any thief who long since stripped the main chamber bare. So the adventure begins as Horemheb sets off to find the secret chamber and the secrets of power that lie within.

Credits

387.name: 5- O'Clock Lock
387.description:
The codephrases for disaster:
-Telephone and computer being fixed...
-No Intercom...
-Door locked from inside...
-5:00 PM (17:00)...
-Evening deep-sea fishing trip at 5:30...
You pooped out after a long day's work.  The only thing that kept you through was your love for fishing, and the fact that you have a big fishing trip in 30 minutes.
Everything seems to be perfect.  All you need to do is open the door, and leave...
But life isn't always perfect...
...
...
(On the edge of your seat yet?).
Every download comes a free game!

Credits

386.name: Trapped In A Building
386.description:
One day Dave Gibbons finds himself in a room trapped in a building. You got to help him get out of there..

Credits

384.name: Scythe Island
384.description:
Inspired by, but not soullessly ripped off of, the classic Monkey Island games, "Scythe Island" is a short, enjoyable pirate romp.  You play the role of Sprite Longbottom, a simple courier who's latest delivery isn't as simple as it first seemed...

Credits

383.name: Red Room
383.description:
Ever walk into some room in space cause the door is open and then it closes and traps you in? Nah, I didn't think so!
This was made around 2004-2005. It's a rip-off of Crimson Room, a flash game.

382.name: Everlight Forest Demo v1.1
382.description:
You play Khargan, who lives in the forest with master Kinn, a student in history and magic of runes, the magic of "becoming" powers instead of casting them.
One day, his master receives a strange message from the Prince, ruler of the Forest.
Khargan has to go to the castle, and will have a lot of surprises and epic moments on his journey before he gets there...
DEMO v1.1: You need to take the boat and leave the place for the village of Hearn. You have past it when you get the "Well Done, to be continued..." screen. ;)

381.name: Demon Day
381.description:
Waking up from a weird dream, much like Zak McKraken used to do, our hero finds himself involved in a strange scenario involving demons, a walk in the park, and lots of bad behaviour.

379.description:
The most amazing thing about this amazing game is that it was amazingly the first AGS game to be released made with the amazing WinRoomedit! 378.description:

Special thanks to all involved with those groups (especially Chris Jones, Ton, and Carston).

a traditional presentation.  Students can map out the layers as they play.  I built the game for
use with my High School Cisco Networking Academy.

377.name: Cirque De Zale
377.description:

All Alexander Zale wants now is to start his own circus, exploit a few innocent people and avoid being some sort of fate-driven hero. Yeah, damn that fate and its crazy ideas! We'll show it, won't we?

373.name: Equilibrium - Out of Time
373.description:
(Any problems downloading, paste the following link into your browser: http://www.equilibriumfans.com/downloads/EQGame.zip)
EDIT: The download link has now been fixed; the person running the fansite and hosting the download didn't bother telling me she'd changed her URL. I am so sorry it's taken me this long! Tested it now and it works great.
There are bugs (described below). Unfortunately I no longer have the acrdata file and so I can't fix them (this was the first game I ever made and the PC I made it on was replaced some time ago). The best I can do is tell you how to get around them here.
Ever wondered what it might be like if you could enter the world of your favourite movie, knowing what was goin
[…]
g to happen to the people there?  Don't such things usually only happen in movies and computer games?
Rosaline Shaw is about to find out otherwise.  Thrown into a not-so-strange, somewhat familiar world, her one goal is to stay alive long enough to get home, though if that Preston guy's available for a date, she might consider staying slightly longer.
(Author's Note: This game was written as a fangame to the movie Equilibrium.  If you haven't seen this, one or two things may not make immediate sense to you, though the story should be pretty much intact ;))
Saving Problems: The Save before Quitting GUI has a bug in it; if you save by this method, you'll most likely have problems restoring at a later date.  To avoid it, simply save BEFORE clicking on the Quit button and that should sort it :) Will try and get this fixed for the sequel.
Also, make sure to save the game EVERY TIME before leaving the tunnel system.  I don't know why-it's not a scripting bug-but sometimes the game crashes. It will work eventually, but can be frustrating. (Edit: if you go through the tunnels as Rosaline, this seems to iron out that bug; thanks to Maggie for pointing this out :D)

Two archaeologists are exploring the tomb of Pharao Ramses III. Could the curse they have heard of be true? Will the Pharao's mummy rise and walk the earth again, spreading evil an terror?

It's 1982,
In a ghetto far far away...
Welcome to Brookside County! Brookside is a thriving overpopulated community consisting of drunks, junkies, pimps, gangs, and whores. Oh yeah! Did I forget to mention? Brookside County has a very busy police department.
