On a ordinary saturday night Knox and his friends may have crossed the line a little too far. Okay! Maybe they REALLY crossed the line! Will Knox get busted? Will he get away? Maybe, he will he go postal instead on the local police department? Find o

ut what happens to Knox and his friends in this AGS adventure Razors In the Night!

ICQ: 331068195

356.name: Leisure Suit Larry 2 Point and Click (Final version)

Ah, Larry, life seemed so perfect, didn't it? A beautiful woman, a nice house, in a rich city... but then, dreams usually are perfect. February MAGS:  2004

[…]
k, and I also changed a few things.  For Example, now the only way for the speech to go away is to click it away (something I should've done a looong time ago)

354.name: Duzz Quest: An Egotistic Adventure
354.description:
Join Duzz in this glorified n00bie test game, as he goes on a fantastic journey of tragedy, adventure, and monotomy.
Duzz Quest is a once in a lifetime experience for all the family.
Huzzah for Duzz Quest. Yeah!
The Speech pack is ready, you can download it by clicking the 'mirror' link, it's 14meg. (To install it, download it to the folder where you installed DuzzQuest.
Features:
- One and a Half years in the making
- 16bit color
- Sometimes 320x240, sometimes 640x480 resolution.
- 12 characters
- 20 playable r
[…]
ooms
- An INTENSE action sequence
- 540 spoken lines of dialog
- Original music by The Midnight Express, and Mr. Clean.
- Craptacular in every sense of the word
History/Explanation/Disclaimer:
DuzzQuest was started to try out this program I'd found on the internet, called Adventure Game Studio. I used a picture I had of my back yard, and put it in the program, making the default character, Roger, walk around. I was all like "Cool! I can walk around my back yard, like those old sierra games I used to love", so I showed Tim, and he was also all like "Cool! You can walk around your back yard, like those old sierra games you used to love", and it was coool.
So then I added some stuff to it, and then some more stuff, and it became DuzzQuest, and it was cool. People said I walked funny in it, but "Bah!" I said. "Humbug!" I said. "That's what they told picasso!" I said.
Still more things I added, and still more things, bits and pieces, odds and ends, one day a room, the next a plot element, sometimes deluding myself that it would be a decent, playable game, other times just experimenting with AGS. I added a lot of things just temporarily, but never did I remove any of them. And the result is a hodgepodge of meandering, aimless plot, nonsensical, gameplay, and schizophrenic graphic resolution.
There's a story (however banal), behind every little thing in DuzzQuest, from Bamptons Rescue Remedy to Tims terrible secret. I doubt anyone but me will understand all the references, but it is MY egotistic adventure after all.
Any bugs, typos or spelling errors you may encounter were left in intentionally to add to the general ambience of unprofessionalism, any lack in speech quality is the fault of stu's 21st party, and any offence taken at lewd verbalisations of the word kumquat rests entirely on the heads of Helen Clark and Katie Ward.
enjoy.

353.name: The Spoons

A reality on the Norm Game.

352.name: MI5 Bob: The Uplift Mofo Party plan

You are MI5 Bob, sent on a mission to get the Uplift Mofo Party Plan album by the Red Hot Chilli Peppers. Unfortuantly, you don't have enough money to pay for it and the secret organization you work for is to cheap to foot the bill.

"An adventure so engaging, you're going to want to fall asleep, too!"
You're not gonna believe this. But I'm gonna tell you anyway. Okay, so my name is Ian. I'm an adventurer. I know, original, huh? So anyhoo, I just finished this one, other, UNRELATED story, and I kinda got lost. Which was okay because I got lost near this big motel. So anyhoo, I was there bartering for overnight board, right, and this monster comes in. He's as big as an elephant, and blood is dripping from his jaws, and he grabs up this Kid.
She starts screaming, "Help me! Help me!" So I ran over and beat this thing up. I was all like, "Pichowww! Pichowww! Mmmrrwwaaaoo!" And it was all like, "Ahh! No! No!" And then I totally beat it. But then, ju
[…]
st as I was rescuing the kid, like 20 more of them showed up. And I was all like, "Grrrrrr, psfsshhhhk!" But they had all these awesome magic spells and, oh man, I didn't stand a chance. So they took the kid and disappeared in this AWESOME flash of light and special effects! At that moment, a gorgeous babe came along and begged me to help her find the lost child. "Babe," I said to her, "I'm an adventurer. Leave it to me." And then I set off on this really awesome and cool adventure, that you will love and enjoy and have fun playing. Especially the part with me and these foxy ladies in the sauna.

Please leave a message, with your opinion about the game!

202.description:
Hit stuff with a ball.  This was the first non-adventure game made in AGS back in August of 2000.

Credits

201.name: Ace Duswell: Where's the Ace?
201.description:
Join aging driving school instructor Ace Duswell on his mission to save the world.
**special note: This game was created in the year 2000 and having just played it I found some of the "humor" to be dated.  Any resemblence to actual secret agent driving school teachers is purely coincidental.

Credits

195.name: MOOSE RAGE -- PART 2
195.description:
Following on from the last game, Father moose discovers that the U.F.O has finally left his garden.  However, the Military have completely devastated his backyard looking for it!!
HE IS NOW A MOOSE ON THE EDGE!!!!

Credits

194.name: Moose Rage -- part 1
194.description:
Moose Rage, centers around a young Moose who
witnesses a U.F.O land in his fathers marigolds
He must get rid of the alien visitors before
his dad wakes up!

Credits

189.name: AGS JukeBox
189.description:
This is an easy to use utility that allows you to listen to all the digital music from your favorite AGS game. It requires a "music.vox" file from any AGS game in order to run. This utility is great for listening to all your favorite songs from soundtracks like KQ2VGA.

Credits

184.name: Butcher Stanys
184.description:
Nice game, which tooks place in Friday, 13 day.
You're butcher, ad you're looking for components to "Human Soup"...

Credits

183.name: Rode Quest 2: The Sweet Smell of Stenchie
183.description:
Another heroic adventure for Rodney Kill!
A deadly currosive is melting it's way through the ships hull and now it's all up to Rode to stop it!
Will you be able to save the crew? Will you get in trouble for causing the problem in the first place? Will you be able to out run the Puke-O-Meter? Download now and find out!
This game contains no text parser.

Credits

182.name: Timeline: The Iraqi Paradox
182.description:
100 years after the apocalyptic war of 2012 that destroyed most civilization, the new government manages to fully develop time travel, because of the work of 1000 cloned Mr T's.  Only one agent can be trusted to fulfill this mission, but he's on assignment, so the duty is left to you..
Somewhere in Iraq, a secret bunker holds the information describing the location of every single unauthorized launch site in the Eastern hemisphere..
The Mission : Get this data, and then return to the future
There are many bugs, so save your game continously to avoid frustration...
I will soon make a Redux 'Director's Cut' edition with full mp3 music and no b
[…]
ugs, and put the URL in the mirror section as soon as it's ready, but remember you have to judge my game on the 1st one...

Credits

180.name: Saddson Issein
180.description:
You play Saddson, innocent son of a terrible man, you have to save the world from your father, Well something like that anyway........
Winner of February MAGS 2003

Credits

179.name: Module Tester
179.description:
This is a little test platform useful for creating and testing AGS scripts.  It features non-blocking value and led displays, and event log, and test buttons that can be bound to script functions. Both beginner and experienced  AGSers will find this a useful test platform.

Credits

178.name: Insta Game: The Strange Planet v1.0
178.description:
Seven hundred years after the extinction of the human race on the desolate planet arrived a group of peaceful aliens and they maked a small village.
One day Sam Davidson, young pilot of the Burron race was flying over one unknow desert planet but suddenly he ran out of fuel. His ship crashed and the story begins here.
After some playing Sam will find the true: this desert planet is The Earth. What happened to the people? You will have to find...

Credits

177.name: Instagame: Grok
177.description:
It's my crazy 9 room insta game

Credits

176.name: pSyCHo!@!
176.description:
No, I don't do drugs.

Credits

174.name: Slime Quest 2 Demo
174.description:
I have been busy as a bee and now I bring you the demo of the sequel to Slime Quest for Pizza. Slime doesn't want pizza anymore-it wants something new and exiting. It wants burgers! However, things are not as simple as they seem. Slime's creator, Dr. Jackulla creates an even better slime or "zlime" which is a huge hit on the pet market. Everyone wants to capture slime to get the formula...
This game features better graphics than Slime Quest 1 and has better music. I am also planning on making it long enough to fit into the medium-lenght games category. It will be released as soon as possible.

Credits

173.name: Gil: The Trillion Dollar Journey DEMO
173.description:
A 30 room demo of my first full length game, Gil and The Trillion Dollar Journey.  You are Gil, a computer repairman, who gets sucked into a space vortex.  You are given a quest, a quest that will pay you: ONE TRILLION DOLLARS! And no.. that quest is not to assassinate Rosie o Donnell.  Thank you, and enjoy the demo! :P

Credits

172.name: Slime Quest for Pizza
172.description:
This is my first ever game. It's about a piece of slime that comes alive in an experiment and gets real hungry. For some reason all it wants is pizza. Guaranteed to put you off softdrinks for life!

Credits

171.name: EventTimer
171.description:
Handy little timer useful in conduting fixed time events.  The timer is initiall set to the time allocated for the event and ten counts down to zero, at which time the event should be over.  Alarm indicatiors are activated as the timer approaches zero. The exact times can be adjusted from the interface.  Source code can be obtained from the website.
This application was created with AGS 2.53 at 800x600 resolution.

Credits

170.name: Soldier: Demonstartion
170.description:
this is the demo of seargent williams carrer as a soldier.
you may find little things that will help get the picture of this game

Credits

169.name: Just Another Point n Click Adventure
169.description:
Follow Andrew, and his brother Alistair as they go on a quest... to get a life.

Credits

168.name: Keptosh I: The Search for junc
168.description:
It is the year 2084.
You live in ServaCor city. The city is ruled by the massive corporation called ServaCor. Humans have come to rely on electricity and data to sustain their lives. The slang term of "junc and flow" has been given to these two vices. ServaCor supplies junc to the entire city, while flow is gathered from a Lunar based computer network.
Most citizens of ServaCor and the millions of other cities just like it hate their rulers. The corporations provide the citizens with free food, beer, shelter, junc, and flow in exchange for what is almost slave labor in huge robot factories. Most people are not happy with their situation, they see these "free" provisions as thinly masked ways to keep the citizens in line
[…]
.
Welcome to the future.
You are Adis Keptosh.

Credits

167.name: The Adventures of Princess Marian
167.description:
Escape from the castle and rescue your husband.
This was a 6th-anniversary-of-first-meeting present for my wife, so the graphics are amateur, there's no sound or music and its full of private jokes you won't get.
However, my wife loves it and I hope someone can geta laugh from it: its my return payment for AGS getting me very much into my wife's good books!
Default AGS/Sierra interface and no manual, sorry!

Credits

166.name: FIFA International Football 2004
166.description:
FIFA International Football 2004 - The most realistical soccer game EVER!
A one or two player hotseat soccer game that I made in a week in the holidays of 2003. A single player version of it appears in DuzzQuest.
I was recording for 'The Moonlight Run' with Balsa in the holidays, and he kept rambling on about FIFA 2003, I made this while he was recording vocals on the 'inside computer'.  The only real merit of this game is it's 'unique' commentary, voiced mostly by Balsa.
The source code is also available on this site.

Credits

165.name: Hood
165.description:
Life sucks for Hood, a strange, purple-robed entity who lives on a separate Plane from Earth. Hood works for "Visionaries Inc.", a mysterious company who makes its livelihood by providing life-changing visions to the citizens of Earth. Hood is eager for the big time, glamour-filled jobs (ie religious awakenings and artistic inspiration) but because of his appearance, he ends up getting shoved with all the crappy "Ghost of Christmas Future" visions.
Needless to say, when Hood is offered the job of steering a Mafia Don from his life of crime, he leaps at the chance to change his mundane life.
This is a short demo to let you get a feel of the game.

Credits

164.name: Quest for Colours
164.description:
A wierd game involving a kid and his problems with pale colours, both at his painting class and somewhere else. Warning: save-the-world plot concerned.

Credits

163.name: The Ugly Files
163.description:
Help Kyle Blumpen on his first case as a detective. Meet the town of Silent Peek and its characters. Defeat one bad cop and save the day.

Credits

162.name: The Uncertainty Machine
162.description:
In a near future, in a unnamed city of the western world,you play Susan Gant, young and curious newspaper reporter.
After a slow start, she will begin to unravel a plot with several "factions" involved on a search for a power that may totally change society.
Note1: the game is still available at my site so get it here:
http://www.freewebs.com/ratracer/The Uncertainty Machine.zip
or here:
http://www.reloaded.org/redirect.php?GID=203
Note2: I wonder if there is still anyone playing my only game; if there is and wants to drop me a line, you're more than welcome: send an email to gatogorka at gmail.com (don´t forget to change the " at " by @)
thanks, all!

Credits

29.name: Bob's Quest
29.description:
The very first game by Matthew Brown (Stinkysoftware) and for some reason, has had a sudden surge in popularity. The game has that great, retro-n00b feeling that we all love to hate.
Its about a chap named Robert (bob) who was on his way to marching band camp. Then His Bus breaks down. Then, later, his roommate is killed. Help Bob get to camp! Help Bob catch the killer! HELP BOB SAVE BANDKIND!!1!1!!

Credits

157.name: A Xmas Eve Tale
157.description:
Help FBI agent Vince Plumper to do the bust of his life on Christmas eve!

Credits

156.name: SECOND MOON ADVENTURE 3
156.description:
Noxi is dead. Maompf Lugug has to find out, if he has been killed. The third part in german language.
The third contains absolutely new features: Photographs as backgrounds everywhere. Check it out.

Credits

154.name: Season Greetings 2002 ENG
154.description:
ENGLISH VERSION - Just a very very short adventure to wish you a Merry Christmas!

Credits

153.name: Good Santa, Bad Santa
153.description:
Find out if you would make a Good Santa, or a Nasty Santa, in this (hopefully) humourous XMAGS game
This is my first game, for the December 2002 MAGS comp. I hope you enjoy it =)

Credits

152.name: Mimis the rat
152.description:
Well, this is the game i made when i first got into ags, all made by ms paint, simple puzzles and no music. This game took me 4 hours, and i will never finish it.

Credits

150.name: The Warp
150.description:
Short little 1-hour game.. Nothing really to explain, just play it.

Credits

149.name: Desktop Adventures: The 11 Minute Game
149.description:
Well, they were making Hour Games in IRC one day.. And I came in too late.. So I decided to make an 11 minute game so I could beat them all to the finish..
This is the outcome.

Credits

148.name: Greg's Mountainous Adventure [MAGS]
148.description:
This is a MAGS game that was disqalified because not all of the inventory items were green.. Which is BS..
It's about a guy that goes hiking and gets stuck at the top of a mountain. And it's the wrong one in the first place..
Be warned, the last puzzle is a bit dodgy. And it IS a talkie, so 56kers beware.

Credits

147.name: A Day In The Future
147.description:
The story takes place in the future, in 2024.
You are a worker. You must go to work, but the "talking door" wants to be paid, or it will not let you get out of your room. The problem is that you don't have money...
The game is in French & English

Credits

146.name: the lord of the bytes
146.description:
This is a 45 mn movie (not playable, just like a movie should be then) made of 13 episodes:
It's about old video games like double dragon, golden axe, final fight.... here's the real story behind it!

Credits

145.name: Inferno: The Demo Of A Rotten Bastard
145.description:
Gac presents the game Inferno: the demo of a rotten bastard.
Made by the Butcher and Spyros.
A political history game about Luxemburg's imperialism during the 14th century.
Download now or be damned for a lifetime!

Credits

42.name: The Journey Home: Part 1
42.description:
The first in the epic three part adventure charting Derek Strange's accidental zapping across the galaxy and subsequent capture by the leader of one of two waring continents.
So far it has recieved a lot of positive comments from the amateur community (aside from the few bugs in the game *cough*)... but please be aware that the background art is a little naff this time around.

Credits

143.name: Intergalactic Space Pancake!
143.description:
Intergalactic Space Pancake! is about a crew onboard a spaceship called the Kyropractor. The game starts as the crew encounter a mysterious reactor malfunction which kills the ships engineer and science officer. Only you can help FenderQ unravel this mystery and save the galaxy.

Credits

141.name: Search for Sanity (Demo)
141.description:
Have you ever happened to overhear a conversation between two customers at your local pub, that revealed to you the secret to wealth extraordinaire? Well, that doesn't mean the penniless lowlife and the unlikely protagonist of a forthcoming adventure extravaganza,  mr. Doug Gimbrone, wouldn't have - why, that's just what he did! And now it's up to you to guide him to the very foundation of the secret of the local asylum - a task less simple than it might appear...

Credits

139.name: Quikstrike89's Stupid Test Game
139.description:
A test game.  My first one.  Give me comments.

Credits

140.name: Mourir en Mer
140.description:
A poor ugly boy sick to death has a dream: He wants to contemplate the sea ones before his last breath...but his cruel father has kept him in the attic since his wife's death, wich turned him crazy.
This game is in french & in english.

Credits

137.name: EBI - Elimination by Improvisation (fixed version)
137.description:
Stu is a hitman who has just got a job to kill a Willy who is bullying the people of Crooklyn.  However, all is not well since Stu has just realized he has lost his handgun.

Credits

138.name: Lazarus Wants Pants
138.description:
Lazarus is a delightful old man in Y - fronts suffering from dementia.  He has forgotten where he placed his pants, and has to buy a new pair.  But he has also forgotten where he put his money.  He has to get new pants before the cold weather gets to him.

Credits

134.name: Aliens Inc.
134.description:
In Aliens Inc, you play the role of Ed Willis, an innocent young fellow, who gets a sudden visit from Biggie, an alien from the planet 'paso', who was sent to earth to act in an upcoming Sience-Fiction film.
Biggie took an audition, and failed, and the producer of the film decided it's too expensive to bring Biggie back to his planet. Instead, he uses the services of an undeground company to solve the situation in alternative ways.
What is this underground company? It's your job to figure it out...

Credits

128.name: Chez Apa
128.description:
L33T-Pete is on a quest for coolness. He needs to get into the new bar in town, Chez Apa, and get himself a drink. On his wacky adventure he'll encounter more adventure game cliches and bad jokes than you can shake a stick at.

Credits

75.name: BlueGui v2.5  (updated 10-27-02)
75.description:
This is an open source Sierra style GUI that you can use to build your own game. Updated to be compatible with AGS V2.5. Includes source code, documentation and sprites to use in your own creation.
The BlueGui implements the following features in a fully scripted, open source GUI that can be taylored to your needs.
Sierra style interface
ASCII text browsers
Object/Character property display
Debug display and functions
Animation engine
Object controllers
The source code was updated 10-27-02 to be compatible with AGS V2.5. A couple o
[…]
f new AGS features required some changes be made to maintain compatibility.  In addition a few minor refinements to the comments and script header definitions were also made as well as reducing the file sizes.
The tutorial is a large download because it is extensive and it demonstrates the use BlueGui's many features. There is also a very nice user's manual, prepared by Silvia, that can be downloaded seperately.
If you wish to dive straight into the source code then just click on the download button on this page. Go to the website to download the tutorial and the manual.
Any comments are welcome.  Enjoy...

Credits

118.name: Aaaaah!! La Porte Noire
118.description:
EDIT (24 april 2007) new W.I.P!!
un jeu français qui promet de déchirer le ku
a french game with good graphics and mysterious plot as boring as sam and max
new !!main link aims to the latest version ( WIP, new iventory screen ctrl + s to get all the inventory items ) in debug mode (ctrl + X to see all the bg from 0 to 29) mirror not working anymore

Credits

135.name: Compensation
135.description:
A violent game which lacks the cutting edge of graphical wizardry, but is quite fun to play. You play as Brad, a stick man in his quest to become rich, his chosen method: wasting himself with things and then claiming compensation

Credits

111.name: The Next Curse
111.description:
A new adventure game by LongLife Software.
One man's journey to a cursed island, in search of his lost friend.
Help Bill find his friend and bring him back home in one piece.

Credits

117.name: The Digital Spell
117.description:
If I remember correctly, because I wrote the story a while back, you play as a pair of mages sent to find this powerful enchantment called The Digital Spell. As the title suggests, this has something to do with magic and technology, but the take is not like we've seen in games like "The Longest Journey", and such. Here magic and technology coexists, harmoniously (I believe... as I told you, I don't remember).
It is a kind of universe like the ones found in the pages of Heavy Metal magazines, but without the adult situations. I've been meaning to write a game like that, but despite my intentions, they always end up being PG, or PG-13 at the most. Anyway, I'm rambling. The thing is that the game has an atmosphere that reminisces
[…]
those sci-fi European comics, but it has a slight irreverent tongue I cheek humor. A mixture I'm sure you are not used to, but one I hope you'll enjoy.
The game itself is not like most adventure games. The idea came after re-playing Lucasart's "Loom". In particular, getting to figure out how to play it is the first puzzle. But don't worry, it's not that hard (nor is the game nearly as hard as Exile).

Credits

114.name: DemonSlayer 3: Hotel and Alley
114.description:
Bert must save Tile town from hordes of roving zombies and flatulant demons by blasting them to hell with his faithful shotgun....
Theres really not much more to it...

Credits

113.name: Doc.Death in Rock Burgers & Tree Houses
113.description:
This is my first and only game - Not Great- :-)
::::::STORY LINE::::::
You (Doc.Death) want to buy a caravan.
But have no money.
This is a Short, very EZY game.
In case you were wondering you can't get passed the Traffic Jam.
Description last updated 8/Sept/04
:Mirror 1 leads to the RBTH page on caiman.us also includes quite a few more screenshots

Credits

82.name: AGS Background Editor v1.4
82.description:
Program for making raster black&white backgrounds for use with AGS.
New in v1.4:
* Added Save/Load project option
* Added option to fill the image with color  (currenly a bit buggy)
* Made the program in anti-glide mode
* Updated BgEdit CD Player to v1.1
* Optimized the script for faster loading
* Changed some texts
* Changed the way of inserting text
* Changed the Display Brush Bar key to Tab
* Fixed some minor bugs
The next version will be v1.4a and will fix some bugs.

Credits

97.name: Exile
97.description:
You've been in exile for way too long, and a chance to leave your prison has arisen.
This game has movies, 3D rendered graphics, and it's very own graphic user interface.

Credits

112.name: Men In Brown
112.description:
This game consists of 25% stolen ideas, 75% bad ideas and 0% Men In Black. It's my first real AGS game; I made some crap games too but they're not here.

Credits

90.name: Teamwork Tutorial
90.description:
A small, opensource tutorial for doing teamwork in AGS, covers:
*Sam & Max style character usage.
*Maniac Mansion style character switching. I hope to add more stuff in later versions.
-Egg Head Cheesy Bird

Credits

100.name: Demonslayer 2: DemonSlayer vs. Vegetable Vampires
100.description:
Bert is a Demonslayer with a talking sandwich....He's found himself in yet another predicament involving vampires...This is a short game I've mad for the august MAGS competion, just for fun. Check it out...
Download the windows version below, if anybody wants it, I'll upload a dos version...

Credits

24.name: Little Jonny Evil
24.description:
Little Jonny has been sent to his room by his mom for making a habit of playing with dangerous toys... now he needs to get out.

Credits

85.name: P.D.
85.description:
Here's my first little AGS game. Ok, it's not really a game - more of a little learning project, to try out interface, interaction scripting, and generaly to grasp the basics of the program; however there's also one easy puzzle for you to solve (the game has its ending, so you'll know when you'll done everything there is).
Main download includes voice pack, mirror does not.

Credits

80.name: Ernie's Big Adventure II
80.description:
The adventure continues for Ernie and his alien friend. This time however they meet up with a group of aliens that have evil plans for Mittens. You must help Ernie save Mittens.

Credits

52.name: Granny Zombiekiller in Mittens Murder Mystery
52.description:
Part homage to "Who Killed Kenny Rogers?" part shameless plug, this game finds Granny Zombiekiller, soon to star in her own adventure, investigating the murder of Old Man Macouzski at the campsite where Mittens is being held.
A voice pack is available here: http://grundislav.agagames.com/games/magspeech.zip

Credits

66.name: Moose Wars: Desire For More Cows 1.5
66.description:
Gorillas clone done in AGS. Starring two moose, random and destructible terrain, wind, gravity and more.

Credits

43.name: Gaea Fallen
43.description:
The world of Gaea is falling into darkness. Eve, a seamstress who loves leg-of-rat, really doesn't want to take on the daunting task of saving the world. No matter what she wants, she's going to have to do it.
Her one worry about setting off on a quest? Her Aunt Mildred filling her cottage with junk furniture while she's away.

Credits

79.name: Firewall Demo
79.description:
Just a couple of rooms with one puzzle to solve..
Basically a little preview of what the game will be like.. Music is subject to change.
(Game has been cancelled, sorry)

Credits

99.name: Bert the Super Demon Slayer Guy
99.description:
This game was made for the june MAGS competition. I tried a lotta crap out in this game...Like a new graphics style that didn't quite do as good as I wanted, and a combat system, that, just like the graphics, didn't quite do what I wanted.
Anyways, its a short game about a Demon slayer named bert, check it out...

Credits

67.name: Anton Ulvfot's Superdisk
67.description:
Might just be the first two player game and so far the only real time two player game made with AGS.
It's actually a clone of a little game I had on the Amiga where you were supposed to kill your opponent with a boomerang. In this game you use the Superdisk(TM), but for the same purpose.

Credits

50.name: Ernie's Big Adventure
50.description:
Ernie has been abducted by aliens through his TV! He must now escape....YOU must help him escape!
This title is rated R for language...so kiddies don't download this one....or at least wait until your parents aren't around. ;-)

Credits

51.name: Bert - The Newsreader
51.description:
Bert has been a newsreader at ICU for a long time and this morning he gets out of bed to go to work as usual... Winner of the June MAGS.

Credits

86.name: TV Quest
86.description:
2015 EDIT: I thought this game was lost but it turns out Archive.org had a copy so... posterity and all that.
I was 13 when I made this. It's very old and bad and takes a lot of effort to get running for a two-room game!
Why not... play... something else by me??

Credits

26.name: The Island
26.description:
You leave your home and go on a vacation, but your planes motors catch fire and your plane crashes on a small island in the Pacific. You must help Bob to get off that island in this SHORT game by Dima Software.

Credits

106.name: Mr. Grey's Greyt Adventure
106.description:
It's late, and Mr. Grey is bored.
This is a very short game from the hour games thread from the old forums. It's grey, rather surprisingly.

Credits

131.name: The Second Moon Adventure Part One: Night
131.description:
Small, short and a bit silly game as the start of a series with four or five parts planned. Play it, if you want, it`s funny, but just an old game of me.
If you have problems to download, copy the link into the adress line and press ENTER...!
To get the german version use the link: http://de.geocities.com/toschmitt/moondt.zip

Credits

28.name: Bluecup on the Run
28.description:
Bluecup seems ignored on IRC, and runs away. You control Chris Jones (the creator of AGS) through the game to find Bluecup and get her (but it's a he in this game) back.
An update will be due in the future.

Credits

96.name: Bob's Quest II
96.description:
BQII: The quest for an AGS blue cup award, was the second, and unfished game by Matt Brown and StinkySoftware. Bob is back again, an unwilling pawn of hiis creator, Matt, to get a blue cup award, which have been placed in both the real world and the world of AGS. Interesting story, if it were ever finished.

Credits

63.name: WaitKey(); v1.0
63.description:
Cool game about the WaitKey(); command.
You will need ACDOS.EXE or ACWIN.EXE to run it. (Only ac2game.dat available)

Credits

57.name: Little Willie's Shotgun Fun Zone!
57.description:
What a horrible game! You fire at a picture of a little fat kid with spiky hair and get points for it! Who comes up with this crap!? What would your parents think if they saw you playing this? If I ever met the guy who made this game I'd give him a good talking to, I tell you what! It's shameful what they let our children do these days! When I was a boy we didn't play games like this, that's for sure! No sirree! We had good wholesome fun! Not garbage like this!

Credits

83.name: Lupo Inutile
83.description:
Demo of my adventure game, Lupo Inutile. Since i'm Italian, the game is in Italian... i think i'll release also an English version when finished.

Credits

39.name: The Glorious Realm of Thendor
39.description:
This is the third and final chapter of the Tulle's World-tale. It shows the greatest of Artram's heroic deed, where he has to save the once glorious Thendor from a devastating war, and in the end has to do the ultimate decision, as he finally finds out who Tulle really is.

Credits

25.name: The Park
25.description:
Just a short little game that raises ideas on life..

Credits

65.name: Porn Quest
65.description:
You can't sleep! You need porn! Go get some in this hilarious romp!

Credits

12.name: Rode Quest
12.description:
A tribute to the grand tradition of square heads with no eyes and frustrating "guess what word the developer was thinking of" games made famous by Sierra Online.

Credits

41.name: Rode Kill: A Day in the Life
41.description:
Help Rode survive his day off! It's crazy madness!

Credits

20.name: Mom's Quest
20.description:
Meet Laura Soft, mother and housewife. Meet Timmy, Laura's adored little son. Meet Miss Miao, much admired housecat. Follow them in their great big adventure...

Credits

64.name: Captain Muchly Drinks Bleach
64.description:
This is a RLBAT fan game. My computer went insane and created this after I played it. It is crap.

Credits

62.name: Raymond's Keys: A Tragedy
62.description:
This isn't exactly a game. It's more like interactive poetry for the tortured soul in all of us.. or something. NOTE: You might need to disable download managers for this link to work.

Credits

73.name: 'Adventure Game' demo
73.description:
It involves a TV studio, a tropical island, a fat director in pink pants, homosexual cannibal soccor players, and something about pirates thown in to a mad mad coctail of puzzles all crammed into one clumsily drawn point and click adventure game.

Credits

4.name: Novo Mestro
4.description:
Inspired by the pioneering feats of Cap'n Mostly, AGS is taken in a daring new direction.
It's like German Expressionist Cinema, except without the Cinema bit.
Or the Germans

Credits

14.name: SOL
14.description:
SOL is the fifth adventure game by me, Helm, and the second one that has any serious obligation towards the person downloading it to be an enjoyable gaming experience. The setting this time is confined sci-fi, toppled with the omni-present selective amnesia cliche. Download and see.

Credits

58.name: The Quest for my Raincoat (aka DickBoy)
58.description:
Oh, what a crappy 2 room game which some people actually enjoy. It's teaches kids to always practice safe sex. Includes a walking penis as the main character who is looking for his um... 'raincoat'

Credits

68.name: A Christmas Tale DEMO
68.description:
Ever wondered what would happen if Santa were to crash in a strange city, with dancing men and no Christmas spirit? Ever wondered how he'd figure out a sabotage? No neither did we. But if you want to explore these bizarre events, why not play this game :D It's got beards... and, some other stuff too :D

Credits

3.name: Ace Quest
3.description:
Join Ace Quest in a vulgar comedy. Filled with mirth and girth, as you protect our hero from being killed by Mr. X, a man bent on killing you because your fat is causing a flux in gravity pulling the earth towards the sun. Updated to a windows editor for better compatability, and added production notes. Have fun!

Credits

2.name: Pirate Fry and Volcano Island
2.description:
Pirate Fry and Volcano Island is basically about a young pirate's quest to keep his beloved occupation. Fry journeys to Volcano Island and there he battles the evil bowling ball worshippers  and attempts to pass the test of three in order to earn his pirates license.

Credits

46.name: Jingle Bells [MAGS]
46.description:
Very short with very few puzzles, but a great festive laugh! EDIT: 09/08/07 Fixed link (although I think it crashes in XP)

Credits

1780.name: Reality-on-the-Norm: Davy Jones C'est Mort
1780.description:
Captain Mostly's second RON game is even more strange and Dadaist
than "Nihilism." Long lost in digital limbo, it definitely has a unique
vision and supposedly depicts the death of Davy Jones. You will have to
decide for yourself.
This game contains a scene of rape.

Credits

27.name: Lassi & Roger: Venture a Bit
27.description:
Small no-interactive movie based on Visy's script.
Scenes: 7
Characters: 8
Playing time: 6 minutes

Credits

1782.name: James Bondage
1782.description:
DOS only, requires DOSBox or similar emulator to run!

Credits

78.name: El Burro
78.description:
Imagine being a scientist in a huge complex and testing some unknown chemichals about 50 stories under ground. Imagine, that it the chemichals accidentally evolve into living beings and starts attacking the complex and then eventually the world. This is basically a run for you life and kill some monsters on the way game... and of course a good laugh.

Credits

15.name: The Crown Of Gold
15.description:
At first a collaborative project, this one was supposed to be actually a rewarding gaming experience. I dunno if it is really, I just gave it my best. This should be the download of primary interest for you guys out there that want some real adventure games from this Helm dude for a change. Can't promise I'll deliver though, cause I have mixed feelings about how good this one is. Judge for yourselves. I still like SQ1 better...

Credits

1783.name: Eyes of the Jade Sphinx
1783.description:
A beautiful woman named Loretta Devore comes into Max's office and asks him to look for her missing father. Max accepts, even though he is sure that there is more to her than meets the eye. His investigation leads him into a story of mobsters, lost jewels, and murder.

Credits

49.name: Who killed Kenny Rogers?
49.description:
Well who did? It's up to you to find out, while interrogating the most twisted party you've ever seen.. the AGS-bar regulars!!

Credits

104.name: Mid-Town Shoot-Out
104.description:
A little one screen shoot'em'up made with AGS. The goal is to get to the other side of the screen without getting shot at too many times.
This was made as a test to see what could be done with AGS so don't expect anything fancy.

Credits

94.name: Stickmen
94.description:
Join Doug and Toby, two badly drawn stickmen, as they search for Pirate Jack's treasure! YAY!... In the process, you'll spank and destroy so many wonderful things!

Credits

105.name: Nicholas Wolfe Part I: Framed - Demo
105.description:
Demo of a never finished game. The demo is great, but I never had ambition enough to finish it...

Credits

87.name: AGS Black Jack
87.description:
AGS Black Jack is a black jack game made with Adventure Game Studio. The game was only made to check out the possibilties of the AGS engine. Download if you're interested. If you want the source code (would only be interesting for AGS users), you can send me a request by e-mail. Unfortunately there are a few rule bugs in this game, but as I said it's just for testing.

Credits

1.name: VonLudwig
1.description:
A humorous game in a fantasy setting.  Help Unilin VonLudwig escape the tedium of small town life.

Credits

48.name: Sam the Pirate Monkey
48.description:
One of two first place winners in an AGS monthly contest held in August. The main character is a monkey who wants to be a pirate. With the help of a wise Leopard, Sam takes on three trials in order to claim the pirate fate we all dream of.

Credits

89.name: Little Willy's darts game
89.description:
It's a joke dart game about little willy.
Just to show the ability of AGS to make small arcade games.

Credits

53.name: Monkey Plank
53.description:
Embark on a great adventure with a fearsome pirate!!! Arrrrrrr!

Credits

13.name: Slacker Quest
13.description:
Imagine waking up one morning with about the worst hangover you've ever heard of. Well, that's normal life for Andy, full time Slacker and currently in deep trouble. He really shouldn't have thrown that party last night...

Credits

6.name: Calsoon
6.description:
Tork is a perfectly normal guy, well, almost normal atleast. He loves to collect underwear. But one day, as he was about to actually put on some trousers for a change, Tork was sucked into the wardrobe and was teleported to a peculiar island which he'd never heard of before. Tork must now help the inhabitants of the island by defeating an evil witch so that he may return home to his precious underwear collection.

Credits

7.name: Tulle's World I, Roving in Candale
7.description:
A fantasy adventure game, featuring the heroic thief Artram and his struggles to save the king of Candale.

Credits

45.name: Wet
45.description:
The winner of the first MAGS competition!!!You play a fish in his everlasting struggle to escape from a fish-bowl

Credits

38.name: Quest for Glory 4 1/2
38.description:
All is not well in the valley of Spielburg. Elsa has disappeared (again) and the sheriff has been murdered. The rest of the valley is in chaos and the influx of heroes has done little to calm the valley. Your job is not done. It's time to go back to Spielburg.
WARNING: This game is rated R for strong language, extreme violence and sexual situations. Don't play it if you are easily offended.

Credits

133.name: Aaron's Epic Journey
133.description:
This is one of the AGS classics, with a superb gameplay and a truly epic plot. Very original handmade graphics and puzzles that will keep you awake a few nights.

Credits

61.name: Snail Quest 3
61.description:
The astonishing conclusion to the Snail Quest saga. The final chapter to end all final chapters. Or just another load of crap. Same thing, really. This one was coded the day after SQ2 and released the day after that day which would mean it was apparently released the day after the day after the day the second one which was in turn conceptualised the day before the day before the day before the day bef... Okay, I'll shut up now. Lots of purty graphics and no plot. The same old thing. Realising that this is a milestone in utter stupidity, I stopped making gag games and sat down to make a regular pirate game, as anyone involved in the adventure game scene is obliged to make, at one point or another. The snail is dead, I promise!

Credits

60.name: Snail Quest 2
60.description:
The tragic depiction of the fate of the snail. Again. Still a cult classic in certain circles(hey, it's avant-garde to call oneself a circle).

Credits

74.name: Max: The Dark Hero
74.description:
Max returns home from the worst day of his life to discover that things can, and will, get worse, when he needs to find rent money for his landlady or get turfed out of his flat.

Credits

88.name: Pizza Quest
88.description:
This was just a test to see what could be accomplished in AGS.  It turned out quite nicely.  Special thanks to Mark (MODS) Lovegrove of  Screen 7 for the title track.
I have recently revamped this game and given it an ending, and also added a windows version.  Sorry at this time there are no plans for a sequel.

Credits

84.name: RON: Reality-on-the-Norm
84.description:
The RON game series formed when some members of the AGS community decided to do a group project - although RON can best be described as a concept, rather than as a project in itself. It involves the creation of a central environment - in our case, the Reality-on-the-Norm town. Each author creates his or her own game as a chapter to be added to all the previously achieved ones, thus creating a diverse "book" of several independent yet coherent chapters.
Currently, over 30 games have been made by over 20 different creators.

Credits

59.name: Snail Quest 1
59.description:
The original expressionistic game from acclaimed
author, Helm.

Credits

1784.name: Dirk Chafberg
1784.description:
A demo by Ben Pettengill.

Credits

10.name: Rob Blanc III - The Temporal Terrorists
10.description:
Something sinister is going on in the universe. Strange sightings have been reported; it seems that clones of ships, people and even planets have been appearing; clones that apparently echo both the future and the past. The governments of the universe have all drawn a blank - so they pass the buck onto Rob Blanc. Control both him and his sidekick Paul as you get to the bottom of the problem, visit four different interstellar locations and travel to a parallel universe...

Credits

34.name: Larry Vales II: Dead Girls are Easy
34.description:
Larry Vales is about to endure the longest day of his life. His patrol car is about to break down. His girlfriend is about to be pushed out of a window at the Gates Motel. He is about to lose his job. A long-missing co-patrolman is about to be discovered. His sideburns are about to grow another quarter-inch. And Larry Vales himself will uncover a disturbing conspiracy against the town that will shake Stagnant, Tennessee to its core.
Or at least it would, if anybody paid any mind to the traffic division.

Credits

8.name: Rob Blanc I - Better Days of a Defender of the Universe
8.description:
A chip shop worker from England has been selected from millions of bored but adventurous people to become an intergalactic hero.
The first proper game to be made with AGS 2.

Credits

9.name: Rob Blanc II - Planet of the Pasteurised Pestilence
9.description:
Rob is ready to take his new ship and begin his crusade. However, the High Ones insist he take a short holiday on Earth for a month, just to say goodbye. Not because they care for his feelings, but because they haven't actually built the ship yet.

Credits

125.name: Star Trek Explorer - Strange New World
125.description:
The following sequel to the incomplete trashed STTNG game. Made a month later. VERY short, bad utter crud.

Credits

5.name: Richard Longhurst and the Box that Ate Time
5.description:
The most sorely underappreciated epic from the folds of AGS and yet the greatest storyline told within it.
Captain Mostly's work has remained underappreciated except within a cult circle.

Credits

16.name: Space
16.description:
Just another game where you have to save the Earth

Credits

124.name: Star Trek The Next Generation
124.description:
The Lassi of Sci-Fi AGS games. Made sometime in Summer 2000.

Credits

93.name: Grandfather's Treasure
93.description:
This is the first thing I ever created with AGS and it is pretty old... yet it is my longest one so far, even though it is just a demo.. nevertheless it features heaps of fun and challenging puzzles. The story evolves around a sorry excuse of a pirate who just wants to collect the treasure, that his passed away grandfather hid on a distant island.. In the demo he has to get off the first island in search of an old companion the his grandfather... hopefully someday I will finish this game.

Credits

30.name: The Book of Spells
30.description:
It is 1384 A.D. in a small village on small island lived Aarh, the mighty warrior, with his people. One day the truth that was hidden from him had to be unveiled. He was the last one chosen to complete a mission, a mission for which thousands tried and died before him. He had to find the last 12 pages of the Book Of Spells.

Credits

71.name: Lassi Quest 2 Teaser Demo
71.description:
Well, you are Lassi and standing in the Zak 1 set.
Not much to play here.

Credits

95.name: Ultimerr
95.description:
A satire on the Ultima RPGs (Which I couldn't be bothered to play anymore since all I did was just spend my time stealing everything that wasn't nailed down... I'm such a dirty thief)!
Join Abitar on his quest to find the legendary White Gem of Anthrax in order to defeat the evil Prince Foreskin.

Credits

130.name: Soldier of Misfortune
130.description:
Welcome to today's Army. We don't yell at you, we don't push you hard, in fact it's like a vaccation. It's free money. We even welcome women and homosexuals. Today's Army: caring, sensitive, relaxed. Join now. PRETTY PLEASE!
Johnny Doe finds himself the only guy duped by this commercial and arrives at the gates of Fort Purgatory - a base in the middle of the Nevada Desert. A base in deep trouble.
So far, only a demo is available, consisting of the first mission. But the game is progressing nicely.

Credits
